meta.title: BC Practical Exam Scenarios - EMR Medical Set 1
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice scenarios modeled on EMALB exam format. Clinical content follows the BC Provincial Examination Guidelines (current to June 15, 2026) and is written to EMR scope of practice.

scenarios.titleEn: Witnessed Collapse in a Gym - Adult Cardiac Arrest, CPR and AED
scenarios.titleZh: 健身房目击倒地——成人心脏骤停，CPR 与 AED
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0715 hrs. Code 3 to a community recreation centre gym in Kamloops. A 68-year-old man has collapsed mid-workout. Staff are performing CPR and the wall-mounted AED is being brought over. Fire first responders are 4 minutes out. Royal Inland Hospital is 10 minutes away; the nearest PCP car is 8 minutes behind you.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 07:15，Code 3 前往 Kamloops 一家社区活动中心的健身房。一名 68 岁男性在锻炼中倒地。工作人员正在做 CPR，墙上的 AED 正被取来。消防第一响应人员 4 分钟后到达。Royal Inland 医院距离 10 分钟车程；最近的 PCP 车在你之后 8 分钟到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the collapse was witnessed by staff at 0710, bystander CPR started within about a minute, and the caller states the patient is not breathing normally. His wife is on scene.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：工作人员于 07:10 目击其倒地，旁观者约一分钟内就开始了 CPR，报案人称患者呼吸不正常。他的妻子在现场。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan resuscitation equipment to the patient's side: AED, oxygen, BVM, oropharyngeal airways, suction, and the stretcher
expected.actionZh: 确认出车信息，并规划把复苏装备直接带到患者身边：AED、氧气、BVM、口咽通气道、吸引器和担架。

expected.actionEn: Assign crew roles before arrival - who takes compressions, who manages the airway and AED - and plan to rotate compressors every 2 minutes
expected.actionZh: 到场前先分好组员角色——谁负责按压、谁负责气道和 AED——并计划每 2 分钟轮换一次按压者。

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch that this is a witnessed arrest with early bystander CPR - a potentially shockable rhythm - and plan to run the resuscitation on scene rather than moving the patient early
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息判断这是有目击、且旁观者早期就做了 CPR 的骤停——很可能是可除颤心律——并计划在现场原地进行复苏，而不是过早搬动患者。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Bright, open gym floor with equipment pushed aside; no hazards. One patient: a 68-year-old man supine on a rubber mat. A staff member is doing chest compressions; another arrives with the AED. The patient's wife stands nearby, distraught, saying 'he grabbed his chest and went down'. Fire is 3 minutes out.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：健身房场地明亮开阔，器械已被推开，无危险源。只有一名患者：68 岁男性，仰卧在橡胶垫上。一名工作人员正在做胸外按压；另一名刚把 AED 拿到。患者的妻子站在旁边，情绪崩溃，说「他抓着胸口就倒下去了」。消防 3 分钟后到达。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment (indoor, dry), nature of illness (witnessed medical collapse with chest pain - suspected cardiac arrest), people (one patient, bystanders performing CPR) and resources (fire for CPR manpower, PCP car en route)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无）、环境（室内、干燥）、疾病性质（目击到的内科性倒地，倒地前抓胸口——怀疑心脏骤停）、人员（一名患者，旁观者正在做 CPR）以及资源（消防协助按压人力，PCP 车在途中）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection before taking over patient contact
expected.actionZh: 在接手患者之前戴好手套和护目镜。

expected.actionEn: First look: older man, motionless, skin grey, no chest movement apart from compressions; direct the bystander to continue CPR until your crew is positioned to take over without a gap
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：老年男性，一动不动，肤色灰暗，除按压外胸廓无起伏；指示旁观者继续 CPR，直到你的组员就位、可以无缝接手为止。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER (give only when assessed): the patient is unresponsive to voice and pain. When compressions are paused for your check he has occasional gasping (agonal) breaths and NO carotid pulse - the breathing and pulse check must be done simultaneously and take no more than 10 seconds. Airway: clear, no vomit. Modified rapid body survey during CPR: no hemorrhage, no medical-alert jewelry on the wrists, a chain with a medic-alert tag on his chest reads 'CAD - stents'. UNSTABLE: cardiac arrest.
phases.infoZh: 考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：患者对言语和疼痛刺激均无反应。暂停按压检查时，他只有偶发的喘息样（agonal）呼吸，且颈动脉搏动消失——呼吸和脉搏必须同时检查，总时长不得超过 10 秒。气道：通畅，无呕吐物。CPR 期间的改良快速体格检查：无出血，手腕无医疗警示手环，胸前挂链上的医疗警示牌写着「冠心病——支架植入」。不稳定判定：心脏骤停。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC: unresponsive to voice and pain - U on AVPU
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平：对言语和疼痛刺激均无反应——AVPU 评级为 U。

expected.actionEn: Confirm cardiac arrest correctly: assess breathing and the carotid pulse simultaneously, taking no more than 10 seconds, and treat gasping breaths as not breathing
expected.actionZh: 正确确认心脏骤停：同时评估呼吸和颈动脉搏动，总时长不超过 10 秒，并把喘息样呼吸当作没有呼吸来处理。

expected.actionEn: Take over high-quality compressions with no gap: rate 100-120 per minute, depth 5-6 cm, full recoil after each compression, interruptions kept under 5 seconds
expected.actionZh: 无间断接手高质量按压：频率 100–120 次/分，深度 5–6 厘米，每次按压后完全回弹，任何中断控制在 5 秒以内。

expected.actionEn: Open the airway, insert an oropharyngeal airway, and keep suction within reach; ventilate at a 30:2 ratio with a BVM without over-ventilating
expected.actionZh: 开放气道，置入口咽通气道，吸引器放在触手可及处；用 BVM 以 30:2 的比例通气，避免过度通气。

expected.actionEn: Attach oxygen to the BVM as soon as practical, but never delay compressions or the first ventilations to connect oxygen
expected.actionZh: 在可行时尽快把氧气接上 BVM，但绝不能为了接氧气而延误按压或最初的通气。

expected.actionEn: Position the AED and analyze as soon as it is available - CPR continues while the pads go on and while the AED charges
expected.actionZh: AED 一到就立即贴片分析——贴片期间和 AED 充电期间按压都不停。

expected.actionEn: Complete a modified rapid body survey during CPR: check for hemorrhage and medical-alert identification, and report the 'CAD - stents' tag
expected.actionZh: 在 CPR 进行的同时完成改良快速体格检查：查看有无出血和医疗警示标识，并报告「冠心病——支架」的警示牌。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: grey, cool, diaphoretic
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：灰暗、发凉、大汗。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. First analysis: SHOCK ADVISED. Deliver a single shock and resume CPR immediately, including during the charging phase. CPR is more effective while stationary: this adult arrest is worked on scene - intra-arrest transport is reserved for paediatric, hypothermic, traumatic, or treatable-cause arrests. After the second analysis and shock (about 8 minutes in) the patient coughs and moves: signs of ROSC. A carotid pulse is present. From this moment he is a post-ROSC unstable patient: Rapid Transport Category, packaged and ready to load within 15 minutes, AED left attached, PCP intercept en route.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。第一次分析：建议除颤。给一次电击后立即恢复 CPR，充电期间也要持续按压。原地不动时 CPR 质量最高：这类成人骤停应在现场进行复苏——按压途中转运只保留给儿科、低体温、创伤或存在可逆病因的骤停。第二次分析和电击后（约第 8 分钟），患者咳嗽并出现肢体活动：这是 ROSC（自主循环恢复）的迹象，颈动脉搏动恢复。从这一刻起他是 ROSC 后的不稳定患者：按 RTC 处理，15 分钟内打包完毕达到可装载状态，AED 电极保持连接，与 PCP 车在途中会合。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the on-scene resuscitation decision: adult arrest is worked where he lies because moving the patient degrades CPR quality; state the exceptions (paediatric, hypothermia, trauma, treatable causes)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出「原地复苏」的决策：成人骤停就在患者倒下的位置进行抢救，因为搬动会破坏 CPR 质量；并说出例外情形（儿科、低体温、创伤、可逆病因）。

expected.actionEn: Deliver single shocks with CPR resumed immediately after each, and continue compressions while the AED is charging
expected.actionZh: 每次只给单次电击，电击后立即恢复 CPR；AED 充电期间按压不停。

expected.actionEn: Recognize ROSC from signs of life, confirm the carotid pulse, and re-categorize as an unstable post-ROSC patient: RTC, ready to load within 15 minutes, AED still attached
expected.actionZh: 从生命迹象识别 ROSC，确认颈动脉搏动，并将其重新归类为 ROSC 后的不稳定患者：按 RTC 处理，15 分钟内达到可装载状态，AED 电极保持连接。

expected.actionEn: Arrange the PCP intercept en route instead of waiting on scene
expected.actionZh: 安排在途中与 PCP 车会合，而不是留在现场等待。

phases.infoEn: Collateral history from the wife (the patient is unresponsive): he complained of chest heaviness while warming up at 0700 and collapsed at 0710. WIFE'S TRAP: 'He always said he wouldn't want machines keeping him alive.' There is NO written DNR or No-CPR order on scene - resuscitation continues unless a verifiable DNR document is produced. PMHx: heart attack in 2021 with two stents, hypertension, high cholesterol. Meds: metoprolol, atorvastatin, low-dose Aspirin daily. Allergies: none known. LOI: toast and coffee at 0630.
phases.infoZh: 旁证病史来自妻子（患者无反应）：他 07:00 热身时诉胸口发沉，07:10 倒地。妻子设下的陷阱：「他总说过不想靠机器维持生命。」现场没有任何书面 DNR 或「不做 CPR」的指令——除非出示可核实的 DNR 文件，否则复苏必须继续。既往史：2021 年心肌梗死并植入两枚支架、高血压、高血脂。用药：metoprolol、atorvastatin、每日小剂量 Aspirin。过敏史：无已知过敏。最后进食：06:30 吐司和咖啡。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint from collateral sources: witnessed collapse with cardiac arrest, preceded by chest heaviness
expected.actionZh: 通过旁证确定主诉：目击倒地并心脏骤停，倒地前有胸口发沉。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C from the wife: exact time of collapse, symptoms before it, whether CPR was immediate, and any down time without CPR
expected.actionZh: 向妻子采集现病史：确切倒地时间、倒地前的症状、CPR 是否立即开始、有没有无人按压的空窗时间。

expected.actionEn: Handle the DNR statement correctly: a verbal recollection is not a verifiable DNR - state that resuscitation continues, respectfully, and ask whether any written order exists
expected.actionZh: 正确处理 DNR 说法：口头转述不构成可核实的 DNR——礼貌地说明复苏将继续进行，并询问是否存在书面指令。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (immediately post-ROSC, completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 3 (E1 V1 M1); BP 92/58; carotid and weak radial pulse 108, regular; respirations 6, agonal and inadequate - ventilations are being assisted with a BVM at 10-12 per minute; skin grey, cool, diaphoretic; pupils equal, sluggish; SpO2 91% during assisted ventilation on 15 L, rising; BGL 7.2 mmol/L (indicated - unconscious patient); temperature not indicated. As a priority patient the second set is due within 7-8 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（ROSC 后立即测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 3（E1 V1 M1）；血压 92/58；颈动脉及微弱桡动脉搏动 108 次/分，规则；呼吸 6 次/分，喘息样、不足——正在以 BVM 按 10–12 次/分辅助通气；皮肤灰暗、湿冷、大汗；瞳孔等大、对光反应迟钝；15 L 氧辅助通气下 SpO2 91% 并在上升；血糖 7.2 mmol/L（有指征——患者昏迷）；体温无测量指征。作为优先患者，第二组生命体征应在 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation - a systolic of 92 post-ROSC needs close tracking
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压——ROSC 后收缩压 92，必须密切追踪变化。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality at the carotid and radial
expected.actionZh: 在颈动脉和桡动脉分别评估脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate and adequacy - 6 agonal breaths per minute is inadequate and assisted ventilation must continue
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率与是否足够——每分钟 6 次喘息样呼吸属于通气不足，必须继续辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Skin colour, temperature and moisture assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤的颜色、温度和干湿。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 monitored continuously during assisted ventilation, target 94% or above
expected.actionZh: 辅助通气期间持续监测 SpO2，目标 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - indicated in every unconscious patient
expected.actionZh: 血糖——对所有昏迷患者都有测量指征。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, taken from the wife en route and kept brief. General - well until this morning; CNS - no seizures, no strokes; respiratory - no complaints; cardiovascular - angina since 2021, episodes more frequent this past week, saw his GP two days ago; GI/GU - nil; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，途中向妻子简要采集。全身情况——今晨之前一切正常；中枢神经——无癫痫发作史、无卒中史；呼吸——无不适；心血管——2021 年起有心绞痛，最近一周发作变频繁，两天前刚看过家庭医生；消化/泌尿——无异常；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (worsening angina this week is the key positive)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统（最近一周心绞痛加重是关键阳性发现）。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head - small abrasion on the occiput from the fall onto the mat, no depression; neck - trachea midline, no JVD, medic-alert chain documented; chest - crepitus over the sternum consistent with CPR, equal air entry with BVM ventilations, no wounds; abdomen - soft, slightly distended (air from ventilations); back - checked during the transfer to the stretcher, nil; upper extremities - nil, radial pulses now present bilaterally; lower extremities - nil, pedal pulses present.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚检查：头部——倒在垫子上时枕部留下小片擦伤，无凹陷；颈部——气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，记录医疗警示挂链；胸部——胸骨处有与 CPR 相符的骨擦感，BVM 通气下双肺呼吸音对称，无伤口；腹部——柔软、轻度胀气（通气进气所致）；背部——移上担架床时检查，无异常；上肢——无异常，双侧桡动脉搏动已恢复；下肢——无异常，足背动脉搏动可及。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined, including the occiput for injury from the collapse
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部，包括查看倒地时可能撞伤的枕部。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with auscultation during ventilations; document the CPR-related sternal crepitus without stopping compressions-quality care
expected.actionZh: 通气期间听诊检查胸部；记录 CPR 造成的胸骨骨擦感，且不因此降低照护质量。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants; note gastric distension and keep suction ready
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查；注意胃胀气，吸引器保持随手可用。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the stretcher transfer
expected.actionZh: 移上担架床时一并检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities examined with pulses reassessed
expected.actionZh: 检查上肢并复评脉搏。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities examined with pulses reassessed
expected.actionZh: 检查下肢并复评脉搏。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: high-quality CPR with operator rotation every 2 minutes, AED applied and used with single shocks, oropharyngeal airway, suction (10-15 seconds per pass in an adult), BVM ventilation with oxygen, and post-ROSC care - continued assisted ventilation at 10-12 per minute to keep SpO2 at or above 94% without hyperventilating, supine positioning, warmth, AED left attached for re-arrest, and rapid transport. OUT OF EMR SCOPE and verbalized: supraglottic airway insertion, IV access and IV medications - the PCP intercept provides these. Continue resuscitation until ROSC, transfer of care, or the stopping rule: 30 minutes with no ROSC and no defibrillations, or 40 minutes if there was ROSC at any time or any defibrillation.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：高质量 CPR 并每 2 分钟轮换按压者、贴用 AED 并按单次电击原则除颤、口咽通气道、吸引（成人每次 10–15 秒）、接氧 BVM 通气，以及 ROSC 后处置——以 10–12 次/分继续辅助通气、把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上且不过度通气、仰卧位、保暖、AED 电极保持连接以防再次骤停，并快速转运。超出 EMR 范围、需要口头说明的：置入声门上气道、静脉通路和静脉药物——这些由途中会合的 PCP 提供。复苏应持续到 ROSC、移交，或达到终止标准：全程无 ROSC 且未除颤满 30 分钟；若曾有 ROSC 或曾除颤，则为 40 分钟。

expected.actionEn: CPR/AED skill performed to standard: correct hand position, rate 100-120, depth 5-6 cm, full recoil, operators switched every 2 minutes, compressions continued while the AED charges
expected.actionZh: CPR/AED 技能达标：按压位置正确，频率 100–120 次/分，深度 5–6 厘米，完全回弹，每 2 分钟换人，AED 充电期间按压不停。

expected.actionEn: Airway management: OPA sized and inserted, suction used correctly for no more than 10-15 seconds per pass
expected.actionZh: 气道管理：选对尺寸并置入口咽通气道，吸引操作正确、每次不超过 10–15 秒。

expected.actionEn: Breathing management: two-person BVM technique with visible chest rise confirmed, 30:2 during the arrest, then 10-12 per minute after ROSC without hyperventilation
expected.actionZh: 呼吸管理：双人 BVM 手法并确认胸廓起伏，骤停期间按 30:2，ROSC 后改为 10–12 次/分，避免过度通气。

expected.actionEn: Post-ROSC bundle: AED left attached, oxygen titrated to SpO2 at or above 94%, patient kept supine and warm, and the crew briefed to restart CPR immediately if the pulse is lost
expected.actionZh: ROSC 后处置一揽子：AED 电极保持连接，氧滴定至 SpO2 94% 及以上，保持仰卧并保暖，并向组员交代——一旦脉搏消失立即重启 CPR。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that supraglottic airways and IV medications are outside EMR scope; transport with the PCP intercept en route
expected.actionZh: 口头说明声门上气道和静脉药物超出 EMR 授权范围；立即转运并在途中与 PCP 会合。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after every move and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1): GCS 4 (E1 V1 M2); BP 104/64; pulse 96, stronger, regular; spontaneous respirations 8, still assisted; skin pale, warmer; pupils equal, reacting; SpO2 96% assisted on 15 L. He is trending up but remains at high risk of re-arrest: continuous pulse monitoring, suction in hand, AED attached. If the pulse is lost at any reassessment, CPR restarts immediately and the AED analyzes.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已做的处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟）：GCS 4（E1 V1 M2）；血压 104/64；脉搏 96 次/分，较前有力、规则；自主呼吸 8 次/分，仍在辅助通气；皮肤苍白、转暖；瞳孔等大、有对光反应；15 L 辅助通气下 SpO2 96%。趋势在好转，但再次骤停的风险仍然很高：持续监测脉搏，吸引器拿在手边，AED 保持连接。任何一次复评发现脉搏消失，都要立即重启 CPR 并用 AED 分析。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes, with the carotid pulse specifically re-checked
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和全部处置，并特别复查颈动脉搏动。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes of the first, with the improving trend interpreted out loud
expected.actionZh: 在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读好转的趋势。

expected.actionEn: Continue assisted ventilation while spontaneous respirations remain inadequate at 8 per minute
expected.actionZh: 自主呼吸仍只有 8 次/分、尚不足够时，继续辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: State the re-arrest plan: if any reassessment finds no pulse, compressions restart immediately and the AED analyzes
expected.actionZh: 说出再骤停预案：任何一次复评发现无脉搏，立即恢复按压并让 AED 分析。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - hospital notification en route with the arrest summary. The hand-off must state the collapse time, bystander CPR, the number of shocks, the time of ROSC, and the vital sign trend. PCR within 5 minutes, including exact event times.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中向医院预报骤停概要。交接必须说明倒地时间、旁观者 CPR、除颤次数、ROSC 时间以及生命体征趋势。5 分钟内完成 PCR，并写清各事件的确切时间。

expected.actionEn: En-route hospital notification with the arrest and ROSC summary
expected.actionZh: 途中向医院预报，内容包含骤停与 ROSC 概要。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off with times: collapse, CPR start, shocks, ROSC, and both vital sign sets
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接并带时间点：倒地、CPR 开始、除颤、ROSC，以及两组生命体征。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR 书面记录。

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 7 minutes later - improving but high re-arrest risk

criticalPitfallsEn: Taking longer than 10 seconds to confirm pulselessness, or treating agonal gasps as breathing and never starting CPR - determining absent pulses and failing to intervene immediately is a 100% deduction
Performing chest compressions on a patient with a pulse (e.g., continuing after clear ROSC without a pulse check) - an act that may jeopardize the patient is a 100% deduction
Stopping compressions while the AED charges, pausing longer than 5 seconds for ventilations or pad placement - CPR quality errors are deducted under the CPR/AED skill
Accepting the wife's verbal 'he wouldn't want machines' as a DNR - only a verifiable written DNR or No-CPR order stops resuscitation

Loading and transporting during the active arrest without a reversible cause - CPR is more effective while stationary; intra-arrest transport is for paediatric, hypothermic, traumatic, or treatable causes
Hyperventilating after ROSC or ventilating without confirming chest rise - failing to assess ventilation effectiveness is a breathing management deduction
Prioritizing oxygen hookup before starting ventilations, or delaying the AED to finish another task - early CPR and early defibrillation must coexist
criticalPitfallsZh: 确认无脉搏用时超过 10 秒，或把喘息样呼吸当成正常呼吸而始终没有开始 CPR——判断出脉搏消失却不立即干预，扣 100%。
对有脉搏的患者做胸外按压（例如 ROSC 已很明确却不查脉搏、继续按压）——做出可能危及患者的行为，扣 100%。
AED 充电期间停止按压、通气或贴片造成超过 5 秒的中断——CPR 质量问题按 CPR/AED 技能项扣分。
把妻子口头的「他不想靠机器活着」当成 DNR——只有可核实的书面 DNR 或「不做 CPR」指令才能终止复苏。
在没有可逆病因的情况下于骤停抢救期间装车转运——原地不动时 CPR 质量最高；按压途中转运只适用于儿科、低体温、创伤或可逆病因。
ROSC 后过度通气，或通气时不确认胸廓起伏——未评估通气效果按呼吸管理项扣分。
先忙着接氧气才开始通气，或为了做别的事推迟 AED——早期 CPR 和早期除颤必须并行，互不拖延。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR owns every life-saving intervention in this call: confirming arrest with a simultaneous breathing-and-pulse check under 10 seconds, uninterrupted high-quality compressions with 2-minute rotations, OPA and suction, 30:2 BVM ventilation with oxygen, the full AED sequence with single shocks and compressions during charging, and the post-ROSC bundle - assisted ventilation at 10-12 per minute titrated to SpO2 94% or above, warmth, AED left attached, and rapid transport with a PCP intercept. Supraglottic airways and IV access are outside EMR scope; nothing about them changes the on-scene priorities.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一场里所有真正救命的操作都在 EMR 授权范围内：10 秒内同时查呼吸和脉搏确认骤停、无间断的高质量按压并每 2 分钟轮换、口咽通气道加吸引、接氧 BVM 按 30:2 通气、完整的 AED 流程（单次电击、充电期间按压不停），以及 ROSC 后处置——以 10–12 次/分辅助通气并把 SpO2 滴定到 94% 及以上、保暖、AED 保持连接、快速转运并与 PCP 途中会合。声门上气道和静脉通路超出 EMR 范围；它们的缺位不改变现场的任何优先级。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds a supraglottic airway once high-quality arrest management is established, switching to continuous compressions with asynchronous ventilations, plus vascular access en route after ROSC. The AED sequence, compression standards, stopping rules and post-ROSC ventilation targets are identical to EMR.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在高质量骤停管理建立后追加置入声门上气道，改为不间断按压配合非同步通气，并在 ROSC 后于途中建立静脉通路。AED 流程、按压标准、终止标准和 ROSC 后的通气目标与 EMR 完全一致。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 68-year-old male who suffered a witnessed cardiac arrest at a gym at 0710 after complaining of chest heaviness. Bystander CPR started within one minute. We confirmed pulselessness and continued CPR; the AED advised shocks twice, and we delivered two shocks with ROSC at approximately 0722 - total downtime about 12 minutes with continuous CPR. He remains unresponsive, GCS 3 improving to 4, with spontaneous but inadequate respirations assisted by BVM at 10-12 per minute on 15 litres. Post-ROSC vitals: BP 92/58 rising to 104/64, pulse 108 settling to 96, SpO2 96% assisted, BGL 7.2, pupils equal and reacting. History from his wife: MI in 2021 with two stents, hypertension, high cholesterol, worsening angina this past week; medications metoprolol, atorvastatin and daily low-dose Aspirin; no known allergies; last ate at 0630. Treatments: OPA, suction ready, two-person BVM, AED still attached, kept warm and supine. Sternal crepitus from CPR is documented. No verifiable DNR exists; his wife raised a verbal recollection only.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 68 岁男性，07:10 在健身房诉胸口发沉后目击倒地、心脏骤停。旁观者一分钟内开始 CPR。我们确认无脉搏后继续 CPR；AED 两次建议除颤，共给两次电击，约 07:22 恢复自主循环——总停跳时间约 12 分钟，期间按压未中断。他目前仍无反应，GCS 3 升至 4，有自主呼吸但不足，正以接 15 L 氧的 BVM 按 10–12 次/分辅助通气。ROSC 后生命体征：血压 92/58 升至 104/64，脉搏 108 回落到 96，辅助通气下 SpO2 96%，血糖 7.2，瞳孔等大、有对光反应。妻子提供的病史：2021 年心肌梗死并植入两枚支架、高血压、高血脂，最近一周心绞痛加重；用药为 metoprolol、atorvastatin 和每日小剂量 Aspirin；无已知过敏；06:30 最后进食。我们的处置：口咽通气道、吸引器备好、双人 BVM、AED 电极保持连接、保暖并仰卧。已记录 CPR 造成的胸骨骨擦感。现场不存在可核实的 DNR，妻子只提到口头说法。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Witnessed cardiac arrest at 0710, preceded by chest heaviness
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Chest heaviness at 0700 while warming up, witnessed collapse 0710, bystander CPR within 1 minute, no down time without CPR; two shocks delivered, ROSC approximately 0722; worsening angina over the past week per wife
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: MI 2021 with two stents, hypertension, hyperlipidemia
treatments: Pulselessness confirmed with simultaneous breathing and carotid check under 10 seconds
High-quality CPR 30:2, operators rotated every 2 minutes, interruptions under 5 seconds
AED applied, two single shocks with compressions during charging, CPR resumed immediately after each
OPA inserted, suction ready, two-person BVM with oxygen
Post-ROSC: assisted ventilation 10-12/min titrated to SpO2 94% or above, AED left attached, warmth, supine
No verifiable DNR - resuscitation continued; wife's verbal statement documented
RTC transport with PCP intercept en route, hospital notified
findings: Unresponsive, agonal respirations, no carotid pulse on arrival
ROSC at approximately 0722 after two shocks, total downtime about 12 minutes
GCS 3 improving to 4, spontaneous respirations 8/min still inadequate
BP 92/58 to 104/64, pulse 108 to 96, SpO2 96% assisted
Medic-alert tag: CAD - stents; sternal crepitus from CPR; occipital abrasion from the fall

scenarios.titleEn: Six-Year-Old With Severe Asthma Exacerbation - Pediatric Respiratory Distress
scenarios.titleZh: 六岁儿童哮喘急性发作——儿科呼吸窘迫
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1930 hrs. Code 3 to a townhouse in Langley. A 6-year-old girl with known asthma is having severe difficulty breathing. Her mother says she 'can barely talk'. Langley Memorial Hospital is 12 minutes away. No fire response tonight; the nearest PCP car is 10 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 19:30，Code 3 前往 Langley 一处联排住宅。一名已知患哮喘的 6 岁女孩出现严重呼吸困难，母亲说她「几乎说不出话」。Langley Memorial 医院距离 12 分钟车程。今晚无消防出动；最近的 PCP 车 10 分钟后到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the child has had a cold for two days and her puffer 'is not working tonight'. She is conscious. Mother is alone with her.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：孩子感冒两天，今晚「吸入器不管用了」。她意识清醒。家里只有母亲和她。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan pediatric-sized equipment: pediatric BVM and masks, pediatric oxygen delivery, MDI spacer with a pediatric mask, and suction
expected.actionZh: 确认信息，并规划儿科尺寸的装备：儿科 BVM 和面罩、儿科给氧用具、带儿科面罩的 MDI 储雾罐，以及吸引器。

expected.actionEn: Plan the pediatric approach in advance: assess from the doorway, keep the child on her mother's lap, get to her eye level, and never force interventions that will agitate her
expected.actionZh: 提前规划儿科接触方式：进门先远观评估，让孩子留在母亲腿上，蹲到与她平视的高度，绝不强行做会让她哭闹挣扎的操作。

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a Rapid Transport Category call: a child in respiratory distress whose home salbutamol is failing
expected.actionZh: 预判这将是一场 RTC：呼吸窘迫的儿童，且家用 salbutamol 已经不起效。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Tidy townhouse living room, no hazards, good lighting. One patient: a small girl sitting bolt upright on her mother's lap, leaning forward on her hands. From the doorway - Pediatric Assessment Triangle: APPEARANCE - anxious, tired, but interactive and clinging to her mother; WORK OF BREATHING - audible wheeze, nasal flaring, visible intercostal and subcostal retractions; CIRCULATION TO SKIN - pale, no cyanosis. Mother is frightened but cooperative. A used salbutamol MDI sits on the table.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：整洁的联排住宅客厅，无危险源，光线良好。只有一名患者：小女孩直挺挺坐在母亲腿上，双手撑膝、身体前倾。从门口远观——儿科评估三角：外观——焦虑、疲惫，但仍有互动、紧紧贴着母亲；呼吸做功——可闻及喘鸣，鼻翼扇动，可见肋间及肋下凹陷；皮肤循环——苍白，无发绀。母亲很害怕但配合。桌上放着一支用过的 salbutamol 吸入器。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment, nature of illness (asthma exacerbation on top of a cold), people (one patient plus mother) and resources (PCP car en route)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无）、环境、疾病性质（感冒诱发的哮喘急性发作）、人员（一名患者加一位母亲）以及资源（PCP 车在途中）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves; use a mask given the child's infectious respiratory symptoms
expected.actionZh: 戴手套；因孩子有呼吸道感染症状，同时戴上口罩。

expected.actionEn: Complete the Pediatric Assessment Triangle from the doorway and state the conclusion: abnormal work of breathing with a still-interactive child - respiratory distress, sick, move quickly
expected.actionZh: 在门口完成儿科评估三角并说出结论：呼吸做功异常但孩子仍有互动——属呼吸窘迫，是重症，必须加快节奏。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (child): speaks 2-3 words at a time - 'can't... breathe...'. Alert, clinging to her mother. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway patent, no stridor, no drooling, no barking cough - this is lower airway, not croup or epiglottitis. Breathing: rate 40, prolonged expiration with diffuse expiratory wheeze in all fields, intercostal and subcostal retractions, nasal flaring. Radial pulse 132, strong, regular; capillary refill 2 seconds; skin pale, warm, dry. RAPID BODY SURVEY toe-to-head for this age: no hives or rash anywhere (helps rule out anaphylaxis), no swelling of lips or tongue, no injuries, eczema patches in the elbow creases. SpO2 89% on room air. UNSTABLE: respiratory distress with accessory muscle use.
phases.infoZh: 演员（儿童）表现：一次只能说两三个字——「喘……不上……」。清醒，紧贴母亲。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，无喘鸣音（stridor）、无流涎、无犬吠样咳嗽——问题在下气道，不是哮吼也不是会厌炎。呼吸：40 次/分，呼气相延长，双肺满布呼气相哮鸣音，肋间及肋下凹陷，鼻翼扇动。桡动脉搏动 132 次/分，有力、规则；毛细血管再充盈 2 秒；皮肤苍白、温暖、干燥。针对该年龄段采用从脚到头的快速体格检查：全身无风团无皮疹（有助排除过敏性休克），唇舌无肿胀，无外伤，肘窝有湿疹斑。室内空气下 SpO2 89%。不稳定判定：呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌参与。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC age-appropriately: alert, interactive with her mother - and recognize that agitation or drowsiness in this child would signal deterioration
expected.actionZh: 用适合年龄的方式评估意识：清醒、能与母亲互动——并认识到这孩子一旦出现烦躁或嗜睡就是恶化的信号。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and actively differentiate: no stridor, no drooling, no barking cough - lower airway bronchospasm, not croup or epiglottitis
expected.actionZh: 评估气道并主动鉴别：无喘鸣音、无流涎、无犬吠样咳嗽——是下气道支气管痉挛，不是哮吼也不是会厌炎。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing fully: rate 40, prolonged expiration, diffuse expiratory wheeze on auscultation of both sides, retractions and nasal flaring - inadequate and worsening
expected.actionZh: 完整评估呼吸：40 次/分，呼气相延长，双侧听诊满布呼气相哮鸣音，伴凹陷征和鼻翼扇动——通气不足且在加重。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse 132 strong with capillary refill 2 seconds - perfusion still adequate
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动 132 次/分、有力，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒——灌注尚可。

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey done toe-to-head for a young child, specifically checking for hives, lip or tongue swelling to rule out anaphylaxis
expected.actionZh: 按幼儿习惯从脚到头完成快速体格检查，特别查看有无风团、唇舌肿胀，以排除过敏性休克。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: pale, warm, dry, no cyanosis
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：苍白、温暖、干燥，无发绀。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen for SpO2 89% with respiratory distress, delivered the least frightening way - mother holds the mask, or blow-by if the mask is refused; target SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: SpO2 89% 且呼吸窘迫，给高流量氧，并用最不吓着孩子的方式——由母亲扶面罩，孩子拒绝就改用吹拂式给氧；目标 SpO2 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Position of comfort: leave her sitting upright on her mother's lap - never force her supine and never separate her from her mother
expected.actionZh: 舒适体位：让她继续直坐在母亲腿上——绝不强行放平，也绝不把她和母亲分开。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Respiratory distress with accessory muscle use makes this child unstable: Rapid Transport Category, ready to load within 15 minutes. Destination is the closest emergency department. Treatment starts on scene (first salbutamol course) and continues en route; the mother rides in the ambulance holding the child's hand.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌参与，这个孩子属于不稳定：按 RTC 处理，15 分钟内达到可装载状态。目的地是最近的急诊。治疗在现场开始（第一轮 salbutamol），途中继续；母亲随车、握着孩子的手。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC out loud: pediatric respiratory distress with accessory muscle use and failing home salbutamol
expected.actionZh: 明确口头判定为 RTC：儿科呼吸窘迫，辅助呼吸肌参与，且家用 salbutamol 已失效。

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes, transported sitting up, with the remaining assessment done en route
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内达到可装载状态，保持坐位转运，其余评估留到途中完成。

expected.actionEn: Bring the mother in the ambulance: she is the child's consent-giver, historian, and the best tool for keeping the child calm
expected.actionZh: 让母亲上救护车：她既是孩子的监护同意人和病史来源，也是让孩子保持安静的最好办法。

phases.infoEn: MOTHER ANSWERS: asthma diagnosed at age 4; two ER visits last winter, one of which needed an overnight admission - never intubated, never in ICU. A cold started two days ago; the wheeze began this afternoon and got worse tonight. She gave the home salbutamol MDI twice this evening - two puffs each time, no spacer - with little effect. Triggers: colds. PAIN: none - 'it's hard to breathe, it doesn't hurt'. PMHx: asthma, eczema. Meds: salbutamol MDI as needed; fluticasone inhaler daily but 'we've been forgetting it lately'. Allergies: none known - no food or drug allergies. LOI: small dinner at 1800, drinking poorly today. Weight: about 21 kg.
phases.infoZh: 母亲回答：4 岁确诊哮喘；去年冬天去过两次急诊，其中一次留院过夜——从未插管、从未进过 ICU。两天前开始感冒；今天下午开始喘，入夜加重。今晚她给孩子喷过两次家里的 salbutamol 吸入器——每次两喷、没用储雾罐——几乎没有效果。诱因：感冒。疼痛：无——「只是喘不上气，不疼」。既往史：哮喘、湿疹。用药：salbutamol 吸入器按需使用；fluticasone 每日吸入，「但最近老忘」。过敏史：无已知过敏——无食物或药物过敏。最后进食：18:00 吃了一点晚饭，今天喝水也少。体重：约 21 公斤。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: severe shortness of breath in a known asthmatic with a two-day cold
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：已知哮喘患儿感冒两天后出现的严重呼吸困难。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C: onset and progression, what home treatment was given (doses, times, spacer or not) and its effect, plus the severity markers - prior admissions, ICU stays or intubations
expected.actionZh: 采集现病史：起病和进展过程、在家用过什么治疗（剂量、时间、有没有用储雾罐）及其效果，再问严重度标志——既往住院、进 ICU 或插管史。

expected.actionEn: Ask the child's weight - every pediatric drug dose depends on it
expected.actionZh: 询问孩子的体重——所有儿科药物剂量都依赖这个数字。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications, including tonight's salbutamol doses and adherence to the daily preventer
expected.actionZh: 用药史，包括今晚已用的 salbutamol 次数，以及每日预防药的依从情况。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake, noting poor fluid intake today
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮，并注意她今天饮水很少。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (on scene, completed in under 3 minutes, done gently on mother's lap): GCS 15; BP 98/64; pulse 132 strong regular; respirations 40, laboured, with expiratory wheeze; skin pale warm dry; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 89% on room air, 92% once oxygen is accepted; BGL not indicated (alert, no altered LOC); temperature 37.9 C (indicated - two days of infectious symptoms). As a priority patient the second set is due 7-8 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（现场测量，3 分钟内完成，在母亲腿上轻柔进行）：GCS 15；血压 98/64；脉搏 132 次/分，有力规则；呼吸 40 次/分，费力，伴呼气相哮鸣音；皮肤苍白温暖干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 89%，接受吸氧后 92%；血糖无测量指征（清醒、无意识改变）；体温 37.9 摄氏度（有指征——感染症状已两天）。作为优先患者，第二组生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure with a pediatric cuff
expected.actionZh: 用儿科袖带测血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality - and note 132 as the pre-salbutamol baseline for later comparison
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱——并把 132 记为用 salbutamol 前的基线，供之后对比。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character with both lung fields auscultated
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双侧肺野。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 monitored continuously, on and off oxygen values recorded
expected.actionZh: 持续监测 SpO2，分别记录吸氧前后的数值。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated with two days of infectious symptoms
expected.actionZh: 体温——感染症状已两天，有测量指征。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, from the mother en route, kept brief. General - cold for two days, no other illness; CNS - nil; respiratory - cough and wheeze since this afternoon, no stridor at any point; cardiovascular - nil; GI/GU - drinking poorly today, no vomiting, fewer wet trips to the toilet; integumentary - eczema, no new rashes; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - nil; EENT - runny nose, no ear pain, no sore throat.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，途中向母亲简要采集。全身情况——感冒两天，无其他疾病；中枢神经——无异常；呼吸——今天下午起咳嗽和喘，全程无喘鸣音；心血管——无异常；消化/泌尿——今天喝水少，无呕吐，小便次数也变少；皮肤——湿疹，无新发皮疹；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——流鼻涕，无耳痛，无咽痛。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (no stridor at any point keeps the diagnosis in the lower airway)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统（全程无喘鸣音，支持病变位于下气道）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (poor intake and fewer wet diapers or toilet trips flag dehydration in a child)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（进水少、小便次数减少提示儿童脱水）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe, kept gentle and mostly observational: head/neck - nasal flaring, mild tracheal tug, no stridor, no drooling, moist lips; chest - intercostal and subcostal retractions, expiratory wheeze in all six auscultation sites, equal air entry, no crackles, no silent zones; abdomen - soft, moving with respiration; back - posterior fields auscultated, wheeze throughout; upper extremities - nil, capillary refill 2 seconds; lower extremities - nil, no cyanosis or clubbing.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚检查，动作轻柔、以观察为主：头颈——鼻翼扇动，轻度气管牵拉征，无喘鸣音，无流涎，口唇湿润；胸部——肋间及肋下凹陷，六个听诊点均有呼气相哮鸣音，双侧呼吸音对称，无湿啰音，无「安静区」；腹部——柔软，随呼吸起伏；背部——听诊后肺野，满布哮鸣音；上肢——无异常，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒；下肢——无异常，无发绀或杵状指。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined: work-of-breathing signs documented, airway red flags (stridor, drooling) rechecked
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部：记录呼吸做功的体征，并复查气道红旗（喘鸣音、流涎）。

expected.actionEn: Chest auscultated at all six sites, listening specifically for silent zones - a quiet chest in asthma means worsening, not improvement
expected.actionZh: 胸部六个听诊点全部听诊，特别留意「安静区」——哮喘患者胸音变安静意味着恶化，不是好转。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined
expected.actionZh: 检查腹部。

expected.actionEn: Back examined with posterior lung fields auscultated
expected.actionZh: 检查背部并听诊后肺野。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with capillary refill
expected.actionZh: 检查上肢并测毛细血管再充盈。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities checked for cyanosis
expected.actionZh: 检查下肢有无发绀。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: oxygen titrated toward SpO2 94% or above delivered in the least distressing way; salbutamol - MDI with spacer is strongly recommended because she has infectious respiratory symptoms; for a child over 20 kg the course is 10 x 100 mcg via MDI with spacer and pediatric mask, and it may be repeated up to 3 times; transport after the first course; verbalize the 6 rights; expect the pulse to rise after salbutamol. Position of comfort, mother beside her. BVM sized and ready: the trigger to ventilate is a tiring child with a falling respiratory rate, decreasing LOC, or a silent chest. OUT OF EMR SCOPE and verbalized: ipratropium, dexamethasone, IM epinephrine for severe unresolved bronchospasm, and CPAP - and CPAP is contraindicated in patients 12 and under regardless of provider level.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：以最不惊扰孩子的方式给氧、滴定到 SpO2 94% 及以上；salbutamol——她有呼吸道感染症状，强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐给药；体重超过 20 公斤的儿童每轮剂量为 MDI 100 微克 × 10 喷（经储雾罐和儿科面罩），必要时最多可重复 3 轮；第一轮给完即转运；口头核对给药 6 项；预期用药后脉搏会升高。保持舒适体位，母亲陪在身边。备好合适尺寸的 BVM：一旦孩子疲惫、呼吸频率下降、意识变差或胸音变安静，就立即开始辅助通气。超出 EMR 范围、需要口头说明的：ipratropium、dexamethasone、对难以缓解的严重支气管痉挛肌注 epinephrine，以及 CPAP——而且无论什么级别，CPAP 对 12 岁及以下患者本身就是禁忌。

expected.actionEn: Administer salbutamol by MDI with spacer and pediatric mask: 10 x 100 mcg for a 21 kg child, repeatable up to 3 times, with the 6 rights verbalized
expected.actionZh: 经储雾罐和儿科面罩给 salbutamol MDI：21 公斤儿童每轮 100 微克 × 10 喷，最多可重复 3 轮，并口头核对给药 6 项。

expected.actionEn: Choose MDI with spacer over the nebulizer and say why: infectious respiratory symptoms make aerosol-generating nebulization the wrong first choice
expected.actionZh: 选择 MDI 加储雾罐而不是雾化器，并说明理由：孩子有呼吸道感染症状，产生气溶胶的雾化不是首选。

expected.actionEn: Transport after the first course rather than staying on scene to finish all repeats
expected.actionZh: 第一轮给完就转运，而不是留在现场把三轮全部用完。

expected.actionEn: Keep the BVM sized and within reach, and state the triggers for assisted ventilation: tiring, falling respiratory rate, decreasing LOC, or a silent chest
expected.actionZh: 把合适尺寸的 BVM 放在伸手可及处，并说出启动辅助通气的触发条件：孩子疲惫、呼吸频率下降、意识变差或胸音变安静。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize what is outside EMR scope - ipratropium, dexamethasone, IM epinephrine, CPAP - and that CPAP is contraindicated at age 6 in any case
expected.actionZh: 口头说明超出 EMR 范围的项目——ipratropium、dexamethasone、肌注 epinephrine、CPAP——并指出 6 岁本身就是 CPAP 的禁忌。

expected.actionEn: Keep the child calm throughout: interventions delivered on mother's lap, nothing forced
expected.actionZh: 全程让孩子保持安静：所有操作都在母亲腿上完成，绝不强迫。

phases.infoEn: Reassess after every intervention and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1, after the first salbutamol course): GCS 15; BP 100/66; pulse 140 - up from 132, an expected salbutamol effect, not an alarm; respirations 32, less laboured; speaking 4-5 word phrases; wheeze still present but air entry improved; skin pale warm; SpO2 94% on oxygen; temperature unchanged. Interpret the trend out loud: improving. Repeat the salbutamol course en route as required, reassessing after each. If she instead becomes quiet, floppy or her chest goes silent - ventilate with the BVM immediately.
phases.infoZh: 每次干预后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟，第一轮 salbutamol 用完后）：GCS 15；血压 100/66；脉搏 140——比 132 升高，这是 salbutamol 的预期药效，不是警报；呼吸 32 次/分，费力程度减轻；能连说四五个字；哮鸣音仍在但进气量改善；皮肤苍白温暖；吸氧下 SpO2 94%；体温不变。口头解读趋势：在好转。途中按需重复 salbutamol，每轮后复评。反之，若她变得异常安静、松软或胸音消失——立即用 BVM 辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each salbutamol course and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每轮 salbutamol 之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已做的处置。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes, with the trend interpreted out loud as improving
expected.actionZh: 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读趋势为好转。

expected.actionEn: Attribute the pulse rise from 132 to 140 to salbutamol rather than deterioration, and keep treating
expected.actionZh: 把脉搏从 132 升到 140 正确归因于 salbutamol 的药效而不是病情恶化，并继续治疗。

expected.actionEn: State the deterioration triggers one more time: quiet child, silent chest, falling rate or LOC means BVM ventilation now
expected.actionZh: 再次说出恶化触发条件：孩子变安静、胸音消失、呼吸频率或意识下降——立即上 BVM 辅助通气。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - pediatric notification en route. The hand-off must state the severity markers (prior admission, tonight's failed home salbutamol), doses given with times, and the response. PCR within 5 minutes, including the weight the doses were based on.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中向医院做儿科预报。交接必须说明严重度标志（既往住院史、今晚家用 salbutamol 无效）、已给药物的剂量与时间，以及治疗反应。5 分钟内完成 PCR，并写明计算剂量所用的体重。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification to the receiving hospital for a pediatric respiratory patient
expected.actionZh: 途中向接收医院预报儿科呼吸系统患者。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off: severity history, treatment times and doses, and response to salbutamol
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接：严重度病史、治疗时间与剂量，以及对 salbutamol 的反应。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes, weight documented
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，并记录体重。

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 7 minutes later, after first salbutamol course - improving

criticalPitfallsEn: Forcing the child supine, tearing her from her mother, or fighting to strap a mask on - agitation raises oxygen demand and can tip a distressed child into failure

Reading a quiet chest or a sleepy child as improvement - silence and drowsiness in asthma are pre-arrest signs demanding BVM ventilation, and determining inadequate breathing without intervening is a 100% deduction
Withholding oxygen because the child resists the mask instead of switching to blow-by or a mother-held mask
Treating this as croup and withholding salbutamol - there is no barking cough and no stridor; failing to administer a medication indicated by the protocol is a 100% deduction
Panicking at the post-salbutamol pulse of 140 and stopping the bronchodilator - tachycardia is an expected side effect
Staying on scene to run all three salbutamol courses - transport follows the first course
Classifying her as non-RTC because she is alert - respiratory distress with accessory muscle use is an unstable finding, and a transport category error is a 25% deduction
criticalPitfallsZh: 强行把孩子放平、把她从母亲怀里抱走，或硬把面罩扣上去——哭闹挣扎会增加耗氧，可能把呼吸窘迫的孩子推向呼吸衰竭。
把胸音变安静或孩子变困倦当成好转——哮喘中的「安静」和嗜睡是骤停前兆，必须立即 BVM 辅助通气；判断出呼吸不足却不干预，扣 100%。
因为孩子抗拒面罩就干脆不给氧，而不是改用吹拂式给氧或让母亲扶面罩。
把本例当成哮吼处理而不给 salbutamol——她没有犬吠样咳嗽也没有喘鸣音；不给方案有指征的药物，扣 100%。
看到用药后脉搏 140 就慌了、停掉支气管扩张剂——心率升高是 salbutamol 的预期副作用。
留在现场把三轮 salbutamol 全部用完——第一轮结束就该转运。
因为孩子清醒就归为非 RTC——呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌参与属于不稳定表现，转运分类错误扣 25%。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR delivers the complete first-line treatment for this call: least-distressing oxygen titrated toward 94% or above, salbutamol 10 x 100 mcg by MDI with spacer and pediatric mask (repeatable up to 3 courses) with transport after the first course, position of comfort on mother's lap, and a sized BVM ready with clearly stated triggers - a tiring child, falling rate, falling LOC, or a silent chest. Ipratropium, dexamethasone, IM epinephrine and CPAP belong to the PCP, and CPAP is contraindicated at this age regardless.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一场的全部一线治疗都在 EMR 手里：用最不惊扰孩子的方式给氧并滴定到 94% 及以上，经储雾罐和儿科面罩给 salbutamol MDI 100 微克 × 10 喷（最多重复 3 轮）且第一轮结束即转运，让孩子在母亲腿上保持舒适体位，并备好合适尺寸的 BVM、说清启动辅助通气的触发条件——孩子疲惫、呼吸频率下降、意识变差或胸音消失。ipratropium、dexamethasone、肌注 epinephrine 和 CPAP 属于 PCP 的范围，而且这个年龄本身就是 CPAP 的禁忌。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds ipratropium 250 mcg by nebulizer (single dose, co-administered with salbutamol when nebulization is appropriate), dexamethasone 0.5 mg/kg PO to a maximum of 16 mg - about 10.5 mg for this 21 kg child, mixable with juice - and, for severe bronchospasm unresolved by salbutamol with SpO2 below 90%, IM epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg to a maximum of 0.5 mg. CPAP remains contraindicated: she is under 13.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：雾化 ipratropium 250 微克（单次剂量，在适合雾化时与 salbutamol 同雾化罐合用）；口服 dexamethasone 0.5 mg/kg、上限 16 mg——21 公斤的孩子约 10.5 mg，可兑果汁改善口感；若 salbutamol 无法缓解严重支气管痉挛且 SpO2 低于 90%，肌注 epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg、单次上限 0.5 mg。CPAP 依然禁忌：她未满 13 岁。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 6-year-old girl, about 21 kilograms, with asthma diagnosed at age 4 and one overnight admission last winter, never intubated. She has had a cold for two days and developed severe wheeze this evening; her mother gave two untreated-response doses of home salbutamol MDI without a spacer before calling. On our arrival she was alert on her mother's lap, speaking 2-3 words, rate 40 with diffuse expiratory wheeze, retractions and nasal flaring, SpO2 89% on room air. No stridor, no drooling, no hives at any point. First vitals: GCS 15, BP 98/64, pulse 132, resps 40, SpO2 92% on oxygen, temperature 37.9. We gave salbutamol 10 puffs of 100 micrograms by MDI with spacer and pediatric mask at 1948 and transported after the first course. Following treatment: pulse 140 - consistent with salbutamol - resps down to 32, SpO2 94%, speaking longer phrases, air entry improved. She has had oxygen throughout, mother is with her, no known allergies, small dinner at 1800 with poor fluids today.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 6 岁女孩，体重约 21 公斤，4 岁确诊哮喘，去年冬天曾留院观察一晚，从未插管。感冒两天，今晚出现严重喘息；来电前母亲已在家给过两次 salbutamol 吸入器（未用储雾罐），效果不佳。我们到达时她清醒地坐在母亲腿上，一次只能说两三个字，呼吸 40 次/分，双肺满布呼气相哮鸣音，伴凹陷征和鼻翼扇动，室内空气 SpO2 89%。全程无喘鸣音、无流涎、无风团。首组生命体征：GCS 15、血压 98/64、脉搏 132、呼吸 40、吸氧下 SpO2 92%、体温 37.9。我们于 19:48 经储雾罐和儿科面罩给 salbutamol 100 微克 × 10 喷，第一轮结束即转运。治疗后：脉搏 140——与 salbutamol 药效相符——呼吸降至 32，SpO2 94%，能连说更长的句子，进气量改善。她全程吸氧，母亲随车陪同，无已知过敏，18:00 吃了少量晚饭，今天饮水少。

scenarios.titleEn: Imminent Childbirth at Home - Field Delivery and Newborn Assessment
scenarios.titleZh: 居家临产——现场接生与新生儿评估
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0155 hrs. Code 3 to a house in Squamish. A 31-year-old woman, 39 weeks pregnant with her second child, is in labour with contractions two minutes apart. Her partner says she is telling him 'the baby is coming NOW'. Squamish General Hospital is 20 minutes away; the nearest second crew is 25 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 01:55，Code 3 前往 Squamish 一处住宅。一名 31 岁女性，怀第二胎、孕 39 周，正在临产，宫缩间隔两分钟。她的伴侣说她一直在喊「孩子马上就要出来了」。Squamish General 医院距离 20 分钟车程；最近的第二辆救护车 25 分钟后到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: second pregnancy, first labour lasted only four hours. Her water broke about 30 minutes ago. She has a strong urge to push.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：第二次怀孕，头胎产程只有四个小时。约 30 分钟前破水。她有强烈的向下用力感。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan equipment: obstetrics kit, plenty of towels and blankets, infant-sized BVM, suction, oxygen, and a warm place to work
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并规划装备：产科包、足量毛巾和毯子、婴儿尺寸的 BVM、吸引器、氧气，以及一处温暖的操作场所。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the imminent-delivery pattern from dispatch alone: multipara with a fast previous labour, contractions two minutes apart, ruptured membranes and an urge to push - plan to assess for crowning, not to scoop and run
expected.actionZh: 仅凭派遣信息就识别出「即将分娩」的组合：经产妇、头胎产程快、宫缩间隔两分钟、已破水、有向下用力感——计划到场先评估是否着冠，而不是抬人就走。

expected.actionEn: Plan for two patients: request the second crew early so mother and newborn each have care
expected.actionZh: 按两名患者做预案：尽早申请第二辆救护车，让产妇和新生儿各有人照护。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Warm, clean bedroom, good lighting, no hazards. One patient for now: a 31-year-old woman on the bed, alert, mid-contraction, working hard. Her partner is anxious but helpful. Amniotic fluid on the towels is CLEAR. Contractions are every 2 minutes lasting about 75 seconds. During the next contraction she bears down involuntarily and the baby's head is visible at the perineum - crowning.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：卧室温暖整洁，光线良好，无危险源。目前只有一名患者：31 岁女性躺在床上，清醒，正处于宫缩中，非常用力。伴侣焦虑但肯帮忙。毛巾上的羊水是清亮的。宫缩每 2 分钟一次，每次持续约 75 秒。下一次宫缩时她不自主地向下屏气，会阴处可见胎头——已经着冠。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment (warm - keep it that way for the newborn), situation (active second-stage labour), people (one patient about to become two) and resources (second crew status)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无）、环境（温暖——为了新生儿要保持住）、现况（第二产程进行中）、人员（一名患者即将变成两名）以及资源（第二辆车的动向）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves, gown and eye protection - childbirth is a high fluid-exposure call
expected.actionZh: 穿戴手套、隔离衣和护目镜——接生是体液暴露量很大的一类出车。

expected.actionEn: First look: alert labouring woman, involuntary pushing, crowning visible during contractions, clear fluid, no visible hemorrhage
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：清醒的临产妇，不自主向下用力，宫缩时可见胎头着冠，羊水清亮，无可见大出血。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER (give when assessed): the mother is alert and oriented, GCS 15, speaking between contractions. Airway clear; respirations 22, deep with contractions; radial pulse 100, strong, regular; skin warm, pink, moist with effort. Modified rapid body survey: crowning confirmed, clear fluid, no abnormal bleeding, no cord visible at the perineum, abdomen consistent with term pregnancy. DECISION: with crowning, delivery happens HERE - do not move her, do not transport, do not let her go to the toilet.
phases.infoZh: 考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：产妇清醒、定向力正常，GCS 15，宫缩间歇能对答。气道通畅；呼吸 22 次/分，随宫缩加深；桡动脉搏动 100 次/分，有力、规则；皮肤温暖、红润，因用力而潮湿。改良快速体格检查：确认着冠，羊水清亮，无异常出血，会阴处未见脐带脱垂，腹部与足月妊娠相符。决策：已经着冠，就在这里接生——不要搬动她，不要转运，也绝不能让她去厕所。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC: alert and oriented between contractions
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平：宫缩间歇清醒、定向力正常。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse rate and quality
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动的频率与强弱。

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey: confirm crowning, check the fluid colour, look for abnormal bleeding and for a visible cord at the perineum
expected.actionZh: 完成改良快速体格检查：确认着冠、查看羊水颜色、检查有无异常出血以及会阴处有无脐带脱垂。

expected.actionEn: Make and state the field-delivery decision: crowning means the baby is delivered here - moving her now would risk delivery in the stairwell or the ambulance
expected.actionZh: 作出并说出现场接生的决策：已着冠就在原地接生——此时搬动她，孩子随时可能生在楼梯间或车里。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: warm, pink, moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：温暖、红润、潮湿。

expected.actionEn: Position her for delivery: semi-reclined on the bed, knees flexed, towels under the hips, a clear warm surface ready to receive the baby
expected.actionZh: 为接生摆好体位：床上半卧位，双膝屈曲，臀下垫毛巾，并备好一块干净温暖的地方接住婴儿。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Crowning = deliver on scene; attempting transport now is the classic failure. AFTER the delivery: the newborn responds to stimulation and brief ventilation (see interventions) and the mother remains stable with normal post-partum bleeding - both are then STABLE patients: non-RTC, ready for transport within 30 minutes, both transported to hospital. State what would upgrade the call to RTC: post-partum hemorrhage with a boggy uterus, a retained placenta with ongoing bleeding, or a newborn who still needs ventilation or compressions.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。已着冠 = 现场接生；此刻还试图转运是最经典的错误。分娩之后：新生儿对刺激和短暂通气有反应（见处置幕），产妇产后出血量正常、状态稳定——此时两名患者都属稳定：按非 RTC 处理，30 分钟内达到可转运状态，母婴一同送院。同时说出什么情况会升级为 RTC：产后大出血伴子宫松软、胎盘滞留伴持续出血，或新生儿仍需要通气或按压。

expected.actionEn: State the on-scene delivery decision out loud at the moment crowning is confirmed
expected.actionZh: 在确认着冠的那一刻，明确口头说出现场接生的决策。

expected.actionEn: After delivery, categorize both patients as stable non-RTC and be ready to transport both within 30 minutes
expected.actionZh: 分娩后把母婴都判定为稳定的非 RTC，并在 30 分钟内达到两人同时可转运的状态。

expected.actionEn: State the upgrade triggers: post-partum hemorrhage, boggy uterus, retained placenta with bleeding, or a newborn needing ongoing resuscitation
expected.actionZh: 说出升级为 RTC 的触发条件：产后大出血、子宫松软、胎盘滞留伴出血，或新生儿需要持续复苏。

phases.infoEn: MOTHER ANSWERS between contractions, partner fills in: due date is in 5 days - 39 weeks and 2 days. G2P1. Regular prenatal care; a single baby on every ultrasound; no gestational diabetes, no high blood pressure, no complications. First labour was 4 hours with a normal vaginal delivery. Membranes ruptured at about 0125 with CLEAR fluid. Contractions started around 2300. PMHx: none. Meds: prenatal vitamins only. Allergies: none. LOI: dinner at 1900, water since.
phases.infoZh: 产妇在宫缩间歇回答，伴侣补充：预产期在 5 天后——孕 39 周加 2 天。孕 2 产 1。规律产检；每次超声都是单胎；无妊娠期糖尿病、无高血压、无并发症。头胎产程 4 小时，顺产。约 01:25 破水，羊水清亮。宫缩约 23:00 开始。既往史：无。用药：只有孕期维生素。过敏史：无。最后进食：19:00 晚饭，之后只喝过水。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: active labour at term with an urge to push
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：足月临产，伴向下用力感。

expected.actionEn: Take the obstetric HxC/C: due date, gravida and para, singleton or multiples on ultrasound, prenatal complications, speed of the previous labour, time of rupture and the fluid colour
expected.actionZh: 采集产科现病史：预产期、孕产次、超声是单胎还是多胎、产检有无并发症、上一胎产程快慢、破水时间以及羊水颜色。

expected.actionEn: Ask specifically whether the fluid was clear or stained - meconium changes the newborn airway plan
expected.actionZh: 专门追问羊水是清亮还是被染色——有胎粪就要改变新生儿气道处理预案。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (mother, taken after the delivery is complete, in under 3 minutes): GCS 15; BP 118/76; pulse 96 strong regular; respirations 18; skin warm pink moist; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; BGL not indicated; temperature not indicated. The NEWBORN is assessed on his own track (see interventions): breathing, heart rate at the brachial artery or umbilical stump, colour, tone and cry, reassessed continuously. As stable patients, the mother's second set is due within 17-18 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（产妇，分娩结束后测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 15；血压 118/76；脉搏 96 次/分，有力规则；呼吸 18 次/分；皮肤温暖红润潮湿；瞳孔等大有反应；室内空气 SpO2 98%；血糖无指征；体温无指征。新生儿按自己的一套流程评估（见处置幕）：呼吸、肱动脉或脐带根部的心率、肤色、肌张力和哭声，并持续复评。作为稳定患者，产妇的第二组生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded
expected.actionZh: 记录 SpO2。

expected.actionEn: Assess the newborn's heart rate at the brachial artery or umbilical stump - never the carotid in a neonate
expected.actionZh: 在肱动脉或脐带根部评估新生儿心率——绝不在新生儿颈部摸颈动脉。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, from the mother while packaging, kept brief. General - healthy pregnancy; CNS - no headaches, no visual changes (pre-eclampsia screen negative); respiratory - nil; cardiovascular - no swelling beyond normal ankle edema; GI/GU - normal fetal movement until labour, no bleeding during pregnancy; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - pelvic girdle ache in the last month, normal; endocrine - no gestational diabetes; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，打包期间向产妇简要采集。全身情况——孕期健康；中枢神经——无头痛、无视觉改变（子痫前期筛查阴性）；呼吸——无异常；心血管——除正常的脚踝水肿外无肿胀；消化/泌尿——临产前胎动正常，孕期无出血；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——近一个月骨盆带酸痛，属正常；内分泌——无妊娠期糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (headache and visual changes would flag pre-eclampsia)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（头痛和视觉改变提示子痫前期）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (fetal movement, bleeding during pregnancy)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（胎动情况、孕期出血史）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: AFTER DELIVERY, focused examinations. MOTHER: head/neck - nil; chest - clear, breathing settled; abdomen - fundus firm at the level of the umbilicus after the placenta delivers; perineum - small first-degree tear, oozing controlled with a pad and gentle pressure; lochia moderate, not soaking pads; back - nil; extremities - nil. NEWBORN quick head-to-toe under a warm towel: fontanelles normal, palate intact, chest rising equally with a strong cry, cord clamped with no oozing, abdomen soft, limbs moving equally, hands and feet slightly blue (acrocyanosis - normal), trunk pink.
phases.infoZh: 分娩后做重点检查。产妇：头颈——无异常；胸部——呼吸音清、呼吸已平稳；腹部——胎盘娩出后宫底位于脐平面、质硬；会阴——一处小的一度撕裂，用产垫轻压后渗血已控制；恶露量中等，未浸透产垫；背部——无异常；四肢——无异常。新生儿在温毛巾下做快速从头到脚检查：囟门正常，上腭完整，胸廓随有力的哭声对称起伏，脐带已夹闭、无渗血，腹部柔软，四肢活动对称，手足稍发蓝（肢端发绀——属正常），躯干红润。

expected.actionEn: Mother: head and neck examined
expected.actionZh: 产妇：检查头颈部。

expected.actionEn: Mother: chest auscultated
expected.actionZh: 产妇：听诊胸部。

expected.actionEn: Mother: fundus checked and described - firm at the umbilicus is the goal; a boggy fundus gets massage
expected.actionZh: 产妇：检查并描述宫底——目标是脐平面、质硬；宫底松软就要按摩。

expected.actionEn: Mother: perineum and lochia assessed, pads counted as the bleeding measure
expected.actionZh: 产妇：评估会阴和恶露，用产垫数量估计出血量。

expected.actionEn: Newborn: quick head-to-toe under a warm cover, cord stump checked for oozing
expected.actionZh: 新生儿：在保暖覆盖下快速从头到脚检查，并查看脐带断端有无渗血。

expected.actionEn: Newborn: recognize acrocyanosis of the hands and feet as normal while central colour is pink
expected.actionZh: 新生儿：认识到手足肢端发绀在躯干红润时属于正常现象。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE - THE DELIVERY: support the head as it delivers, never pull; check for a cord around the neck - none here; support the body as it delivers at 0214. THE NEWBORN LADDER (BC sequence for a newborn who is floppy, limp, not breathing, or with a heart rate below 100): this baby is floppy and not crying, brachial heart rate about 90. Step 1 - dry, stimulate and keep warm for 30 seconds: still limp, HR about 90. Step 2 - ventilate with the BVM on ROOM AIR for 30 seconds: the baby cries, tone improves, HR 128. Had the HR stayed below 100: Step 3 - ventilate with 100% oxygen attached for 30 seconds; Step 4 - chest compressions with ventilations and 100% oxygen until the heart rate is above 60. Neonate CPR ratio is 3:1 and NO AED is used on a neonate. AFTER THE BABY RESPONDS: skin-to-skin on the mother's chest with a hat and warm blankets; clamp and cut the cord once pulsation has stopped; the placenta delivers spontaneously at about 0230 - never pull on the cord - and travels to hospital with the patients; massage the fundus after the placenta delivers.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围——接生本身：胎头娩出时用手托扶，绝不牵拉；检查有无脐带绕颈——本例没有；02:14 胎体娩出时顺势托住。新生儿处置阶梯（BC 规定：新生儿松软、无力、不呼吸或心率低于 100 时启动）：这个婴儿松软、不哭，肱动脉心率约 90。第一步——擦干、刺激并保暖 30 秒：仍然松软，心率仍约 90。第二步——用 BVM 以室内空气通气 30 秒：婴儿哭出声，肌张力改善，心率 128。假如心率仍低于 100：第三步——接 100% 氧继续通气 30 秒；第四步——胸外按压加通气加 100% 氧，直到心率超过 60。新生儿 CPR 按压通气比为 3:1，且绝不对新生儿使用 AED。婴儿反应好转后：与母亲肌肤相贴，戴帽、盖温毯保暖；脐带搏动停止后夹闭并剪断；胎盘约 02:30 自行娩出——绝不牵拉脐带——并随患者一起送往医院；胎盘娩出后按摩宫底。

expected.actionEn: Deliver correctly: support the head, check for a nuchal cord, support the body - no pulling at any stage, and note the time of birth
expected.actionZh: 正确接生：托扶胎头、检查脐带绕颈、托住胎体——全程不做任何牵拉，并记录出生时间。

expected.actionEn: Run the newborn ladder in order with 30-second steps: dry-stimulate-warm, then BVM on room air, reassessing the heart rate after each step against the below-100 threshold
expected.actionZh: 按顺序执行新生儿阶梯，每步 30 秒：擦干-刺激-保暖，然后 BVM 室内空气通气，每步之后对照「低于 100」这条线复评心率。

expected.actionEn: State the escalation steps had the HR stayed below 100: BVM with 100% oxygen for 30 seconds, then compressions with ventilations at 3:1 - and that no AED is used on a neonate
expected.actionZh: 说出心率持续低于 100 时的升级步骤：接 100% 氧通气 30 秒，然后按 3:1 做按压加通气——并说明新生儿不使用 AED。

expected.actionEn: Keep the newborn warm at every step: dried immediately, hat, warm blankets, skin-to-skin - cold stress is the most preventable newborn threat
expected.actionZh: 每一步都为新生儿保暖：立即擦干、戴帽、盖温毯、与母亲肌肤相贴——低体温是新生儿最可预防的威胁。

expected.actionEn: Manage the third stage correctly: cord clamped and cut after pulsation stops, placenta delivered spontaneously without cord traction, placenta transported with the patients, fundal massage afterwards
expected.actionZh: 正确处理第三产程：脐带搏动停止后夹闭剪断，胎盘自行娩出、绝不牵拉脐带，胎盘随患者送院，娩出后按摩宫底。

expected.actionEn: Control perineal oozing with a pad and gentle pressure, and monitor pad count
expected.actionZh: 用产垫轻压控制会阴渗血，并持续记录产垫用量。

phases.infoEn: Reassess both patients after every move and at regular intervals. MOTHER set 2 (17 minutes after set 1): GCS 15; BP 114/72; pulse 88 strong; respirations 16; skin warm pink; pupils equal; SpO2 98%; fundus remains firm, lochia moderate, one pad in 20 minutes. NEWBORN reassessed continuously: breathing well, strong cry, HR above 100 at the brachial, trunk pink, kept warm skin-to-skin. Both stable - continue non-RTC packaging of two patients.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动后并按规定间隔复评两名患者。产妇第 2 组（第 1 组之后 17 分钟）：GCS 15；血压 114/72；脉搏 88 次/分，有力；呼吸 16 次/分；皮肤温暖红润；瞳孔等大；SpO2 98%；宫底仍质硬，恶露中等，20 分钟用了一块产垫。新生儿持续复评：呼吸良好，哭声有力，肱动脉心率高于 100，躯干红润，肌肤相贴保暖中。两人均稳定——继续按非 RTC 完成两名患者的打包。

expected.actionEn: Reassess the mother's ABCs, fundus and pad count after each move and at regular intervals
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后并按规定间隔复评产妇的 ABC、宫底和产垫用量。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of maternal vitals within 17-18 minutes, trend interpreted out loud
expected.actionZh: 17–18 分钟内完成产妇第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读趋势。

expected.actionEn: Reassess the newborn continuously: breathing, heart rate, colour, tone, warmth - and restart the ladder immediately if the HR falls below 100 or breathing becomes inadequate
expected.actionZh: 持续复评新生儿：呼吸、心率、肤色、肌张力、体温——一旦心率跌破 100 或呼吸不足，立即重新进入处置阶梯。

expected.actionEn: Watch the mother for post-partum hemorrhage: a boggy fundus gets massage, soaking pads upgrades the call to RTC
expected.actionZh: 警惕产妇产后大出血：宫底一软就按摩，产垫被浸透就立即升级为 RTC。

phases.infoEn: Two-patient hand-off. Must state: time of birth, clear fluid, the newborn's initial floppy presentation with HR below 100, the ladder steps taken and the response, cord and placenta status, maternal bleeding and fundal tone. PCR within 5 minutes - one record per patient.
phases.infoZh: 两名患者的交接。必须说明：出生时间、羊水清亮、新生儿最初松软且心率低于 100 的表现、执行了阶梯的哪几步及其反应、脐带和胎盘的情况、产妇出血量与宫底张力。5 分钟内完成 PCR——每名患者一份记录。

expected.actionEn: Notification to the receiving hospital that a field delivery is coming in - two patients
expected.actionZh: 向接收医院预报现场分娩来院——共两名患者。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off covering both patients, including the newborn resuscitation steps and times
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接覆盖两名患者，包括新生儿复苏的步骤和时间点。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCRs completed within 5 minutes, one per patient
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，每名患者一份。

vitalsSets.timeHint: mother, 17 minutes later - stable; newborn reassessed continuously

criticalPitfallsEn: Trying to transport a crowning patient - the baby delivers in the stairwell; crowning means delivery happens where you are
Letting her walk to the toilet with an urge to push - the urge is often the baby on the pelvic floor

Skipping or shortening the newborn ladder steps: each step gets 30 seconds and a heart rate check against the below-100 threshold before escalating; failing to ventilate a newborn with HR below 100 after drying and stimulation is failing to intervene on inadequate breathing - 100%
Pulling on the cord to hurry the placenta - risk of uterine inversion and catastrophic hemorrhage
Letting the newborn get cold: a wet, uncovered newborn loses heat immediately; dry, hat, blankets, skin-to-skin
Using an AED or carotid checks on the neonate - HR is assessed at the brachial artery or cord stump, compressions run at 3:1, no AED
Forgetting this is now a two-patient call and having no one watching the newborn while packaging the mother
criticalPitfallsZh: 对已着冠的产妇强行转运——孩子会生在楼梯间；着冠就意味着在原地接生。
让有向下用力感的产妇自己去厕所——那种便意常常就是胎头压在盆底上。
跳过或压缩新生儿阶梯的步骤：每一步都要做满 30 秒，并对照「心率低于 100」这条线复评后再升级；擦干刺激后心率仍低于 100 却不通气，等于判断出呼吸不足而不干预——扣 100%。
为了催胎盘去牵拉脐带——有子宫内翻和灾难性大出血的风险。
让新生儿受凉：湿着身子没有覆盖的新生儿体温流失极快；必须擦干、戴帽、盖毯、肌肤相贴。
对新生儿使用 AED 或摸颈动脉——新生儿心率在肱动脉或脐带根部评估，按压通气比 3:1，不用 AED。
忘了现在是两名患者的现场，打包产妇时没有人盯着新生儿。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: The entire call sits inside EMR scope: recognizing imminent delivery, the hands-on delivery itself, the BC newborn ladder (dry-stimulate-warm 30 seconds, BVM room air 30 seconds, BVM with 100% oxygen 30 seconds, then 3:1 compressions with ventilations and 100% oxygen until the HR is above 60), third-stage management without cord traction, warmth for the newborn, hemorrhage watch for the mother, and non-RTC transport of two stable patients. There are no medications in this call at either licence level.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一整场都在 EMR 授权范围内：识别即将分娩、亲手接生、执行 BC 新生儿阶梯（擦干-刺激-保暖 30 秒，BVM 室内空气通气 30 秒，接 100% 氧通气 30 秒，然后按 3:1 做按压加通气加 100% 氧直到心率超过 60）、不牵拉脐带的第三产程处理、新生儿保暖、产妇出血监测，以及两名稳定患者的非 RTC 转运。本场无论哪个级别都不涉及任何药物。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry on the mother and would obtain vascular access en route if post-partum hemorrhage developed, treating hypotension with a 20 mL/kg fluid bolus to a maximum of 2 L, reassessing every 500 mL. The delivery steps and the newborn ladder are identical at both levels.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加产妇的 9 系统功能问诊；若发生产后大出血，则在途中建立静脉通路，按 20 mL/kg、上限 2 升处理低血压，每 500 mL 复评一次。接生步骤和新生儿阶梯在两个级别完全相同。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 31-year-old G2P1 at 39 weeks and 2 days who delivered a baby boy at home at 0214 after a precipitous labour - her first labour was 4 hours. Membranes ruptured at 0125 with clear fluid. The delivery was controlled, no nuchal cord. The newborn was initially floppy and not crying with a brachial heart rate of about 90: we dried, stimulated and warmed for 30 seconds without response, then ventilated with a BVM on room air for 30 seconds, after which he cried, tone improved and the heart rate rose to 128. He has breathed well since, trunk pink with acrocyanosis, kept warm skin-to-skin with a hat. Cord clamped and cut after pulsation stopped; the placenta delivered spontaneously at 0230 and is with us; the fundus is firm at the umbilicus. Mum has a small first-degree perineal tear with oozing controlled by pad pressure, one pad in 20 minutes. Her vitals: BP 118/76 then 114/72, pulse 96 then 88, resps 18, SpO2 98%. Pregnancy was uncomplicated, singleton on ultrasound, prenatal vitamins only, no allergies, dinner at 1900.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 31 岁孕 2 产 1 的产妇，孕 39 周加 2 天，因急产于 02:14 在家中娩出一名男婴——她头胎产程只有 4 小时。01:25 破水，羊水清亮。娩出过程顺利受控，无脐带绕颈。新生儿最初松软、不哭，肱动脉心率约 90：我们擦干、刺激并保暖 30 秒无反应，随后用 BVM 以室内空气通气 30 秒，之后他哭出声、肌张力改善，心率升至 128。此后呼吸一直良好，躯干红润伴肢端发绀，戴帽并与母亲肌肤相贴保暖。脐带在搏动停止后夹闭剪断；胎盘 02:30 自行娩出、已随车带来；宫底位于脐平面、质硬。产妇会阴有一处小的一度撕裂，产垫轻压后渗血已控制，20 分钟用了一块产垫。她的生命体征：血压 118/76 后为 114/72，脉搏 96 后为 88，呼吸 18，SpO2 98%。孕期无并发症，超声单胎，仅服孕期维生素，无过敏，19:00 晚餐。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Term labour with urge to push; field delivery at 0214
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: G2P1, 39+2, contractions from 2300, membranes ruptured 0125 with clear fluid, previous labour 4 hours, crowning on arrival - delivered on scene; newborn initially floppy, not crying, HR ~90
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Uncomplicated pregnancy, singleton on ultrasound, no GDM, no hypertension
treatments: Controlled delivery: head supported, nuchal cord check negative, no traction, time of birth 0214
Newborn ladder: dry-stimulate-warm 30 s (no response, HR ~90), BVM room air 30 s - cried, HR 128; escalation steps stated (BVM + 100% O2, then 3:1 compressions until HR > 60, no AED)
Newborn warmth: dried, hat, blankets, skin-to-skin; continuous reassessment
Cord clamped and cut after pulsation stopped; placenta delivered spontaneously 0230 without traction, transported with patients; fundal massage after delivery
Perineal oozing controlled with pad pressure; pad count monitored
Both patients stable: non-RTC transport, second crew for the newborn
findings: Crowning on arrival with clear fluid, no cord at the perineum
Newborn: floppy, apneic cry-less at birth, brachial HR ~90, responded to step 2 of the ladder; trunk pink with acrocyanosis
Mother: fundus firm at umbilicus, small first-degree tear, moderate lochia - one pad in 20 minutes
Maternal vitals stable across two sets; newborn breathing well, HR above 100

scenarios.titleEn: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning - Four Patients in a Townhouse
scenarios.titleZh: 一氧化碳中毒——联排住宅内四名患者
scenarios.dispatchEn: 2040 hrs, a cold November evening. Code 3 to a townhouse in Abbotsford. A family of four all feel sick with headaches and nausea that started after dinner. The caller mentions their carbon monoxide alarm has been 'chirping' since the evening. Abbotsford Regional Hospital is 15 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 20:40，十一月寒冷的傍晚。Code 3 前往 Abbotsford 一处联排住宅。一家四口晚饭后陆续感到不适，都有头痛和恶心。报案人提到家里的一氧化碳报警器从傍晚起一直在「叽叽叫」。Abbotsford Regional 医院距离 15 分钟车程。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the furnace has been running hard since a cold snap started two days ago. Dispatch has instructed the family to get out of the house. Fire has been dispatched with gas monitors.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：两天前寒潮来袭后，家里的燃气暖炉一直在满负荷运转。调度已指示全家离开住宅。消防已带气体检测仪出动。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the pattern from dispatch alone: an entire household sick at the same time with headache and nausea, a fuel-burning appliance, and a chirping CO alarm - suspected carbon monoxide until proven otherwise
expected.actionZh: 仅凭派遣信息就识别出这个组合：全家人同时头痛恶心、有燃气设备、CO 报警器在响——在排除之前一律按一氧化碳中毒对待。

expected.actionEn: Plan to stage outside and NOT enter the structure until fire clears it; confirm the family has evacuated
expected.actionZh: 计划在建筑外集结，消防确认安全之前绝不进入；并确认全家已撤出。

expected.actionEn: Request additional resources early: this is four patients - a second ambulance at minimum
expected.actionZh: 尽早申请额外资源：这是四名患者——至少再要一辆救护车。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: You stage on the street. The family of four is on the front lawn in coats: father 45, mother 43, and two children aged 9 and 7. All are walking and talking. Fire arrives, enters on air, and reports a reading of 380 ppm CO near the furnace closet; they shut the furnace down and begin ventilating. The house is NOT cleared for entry. The family dog is lethargic - the firefighters carry it out. The father says everyone felt better almost as soon as they got outside.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：你们在街边集结。一家四口穿着外套站在前院草坪上：父亲 45 岁、母亲 43 岁，两个孩子 9 岁和 7 岁。四人都能行走、能对答。消防到达后佩戴空气呼吸器进入，报告暖炉储藏间附近读数为 380 ppm CO；他们关停暖炉并开始通风。房屋尚未解除进入限制。家里的狗蔫蔫的——消防员把它抱了出来。父亲说大家一到室外几乎立刻觉得好些了。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (CO in the structure - do not enter until cleared), environment (cold - keep patients warm outside), MOI/nature (CO exposure over hours), people (FOUR patients) and resources (fire on air, second ambulance)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（建筑内有 CO——解除限制前不进入）、环境（寒冷——患者在室外要保暖）、暴露性质（数小时的 CO 暴露）、人员（四名患者）以及资源（佩戴呼吸器的消防、第二辆救护车）。

expected.actionEn: Stay out of the structure; treat everyone where the air is clean
expected.actionZh: 不进入建筑；所有人都在空气干净的地方接受处置。

expected.actionEn: First look at all four: walking, talking, no one unconscious; identify the father as the most symptomatic and note the lethargic dog as corroborating evidence of CO
expected.actionZh: 对四人做第一眼评估：都能走能说，无人昏迷；确定父亲症状最重，并把狗的萎靡记为 CO 的旁证。

phases.infoEn: PRIMARY PATIENT: the father, 45. ACTOR: alert, oriented, 'the worst headache of the evening, like a band', nauseated, vomited twice, dizzy when he stands. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 20, unlaboured, clear air entry both sides; radial pulse 104, strong, regular; skin normal colour to slightly flushed, warm, dry. Rapid body survey: nil - no trauma, no rash. SpO2 reads 99% on room air - RECOGNIZE THIS AS UNRELIABLE: pulse oximetry cannot distinguish carboxyhemoglobin from oxyhemoglobin. The other three patients: mother has a moderate headache and nausea - she volunteers that she is 12 weeks pregnant; both children have mild headaches. All alert, all walking. STABLE: no unstable criteria in any patient.
phases.infoZh: 主要患者：45 岁的父亲。演员表现：清醒、定向力正常，「今晚头痛越来越重，像一圈带子勒着」，恶心，吐过两次，站起来发晕。考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 20 次/分，不费力，双肺进气清晰；桡动脉搏动 104 次/分，有力、规则；皮肤颜色正常至略潮红，温暖、干燥。快速体格检查：无异常——无外伤、无皮疹。室内空气下 SpO2 显示 99%——必须认识到这个读数不可靠：脉搏血氧仪无法区分碳氧血红蛋白和氧合血红蛋白。其余三名患者：母亲中度头痛伴恶心——她主动说自己怀孕 12 周；两个孩子轻度头痛。四人都清醒、都能行走。稳定判定：四人均不符合任何不稳定标准。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC: alert and oriented - and note that any decreased LOC in a CO patient is an unstable finding
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平：清醒、定向力正常——并说明 CO 患者一旦出现意识下降就属于不稳定表现。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing with auscultation of both lung fields
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸，并听诊双侧肺野。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse rate and quality
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动的频率与强弱。

expected.actionEn: Perform the rapid body survey
expected.actionZh: 完成快速体格检查。

expected.actionEn: State that the SpO2 of 99% is unreliable in carbon monoxide poisoning and must not guide oxygen therapy
expected.actionZh: 明确说出：一氧化碳中毒时 99% 的 SpO2 读数不可靠，绝不能用它来指导氧疗。

expected.actionEn: Apply high-flow oxygen by non-rebreather at 15 L to the father immediately - a non-rebreather is specifically indicated for CO poisoning - and direct oxygen for all four patients
expected.actionZh: 立即给父亲戴上 15 L 非重复呼吸面罩高流量吸氧——非重复呼吸面罩正是 CO 中毒的指征用法——并安排四名患者全部吸氧。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: normal to slightly flushed, warm, dry
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：颜色正常至略潮红，温暖、干燥。

expected.actionEn: Position of comfort, seated, wrapped warm outside the house
expected.actionZh: 舒适体位：在屋外坐位休息，裹毯保暖。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. All four patients are alert with normal vitals: no unstable criteria - this is a non-RTC call, 30 minutes to be transport-ready. BUT all four exposed people are transported for evaluation - symptoms improving outside does not clear anyone, and the pregnant mother in particular needs hospital assessment after CO exposure. State the upgrade triggers: any decreased LOC, syncope, chest pain, or seizure makes that patient RTC immediately. Split patients across the two ambulances with an adult accompanying each child.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。四名患者都清醒、生命体征正常：不符合任何不稳定标准——本场属非 RTC，30 分钟内达到可转运状态。但四名暴露者必须全部送院评估——到室外后症状减轻不等于任何人可以不去医院，怀孕的母亲在 CO 暴露后尤其需要医院评估。同时说出升级触发条件：任何一人出现意识下降、晕厥、胸痛或抽搐，该患者立即转为 RTC。两辆救护车分载患者，每个孩子由一名大人陪同。

expected.actionEn: Correctly categorize as non-RTC: all patients alert with normal vitals and no unstable criteria
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC：所有患者清醒、生命体征正常，不符合任何不稳定标准。

expected.actionEn: Transport ALL four exposed patients for hospital evaluation, and explain to the family why feeling better outside does not mean they are safe
expected.actionZh: 四名暴露者全部送院评估，并向家属解释：到室外觉得好转不等于安全了。

expected.actionEn: State the upgrade triggers: decreased LOC, syncope, chest pain or seizure in any patient means RTC for that patient
expected.actionZh: 说出升级触发条件：任何一人出现意识下降、晕厥、胸痛或抽搐，该患者即按 RTC 处理。

expected.actionEn: Organize the multi-patient logistics: two ambulances, children each accompanied by a parent, oxygen for everyone during transport
expected.actionZh: 安排多患者转运细节：两辆救护车，每个孩子有一名家长陪同，转运全程人人吸氧。

phases.infoEn: FATHER ANSWERS: headache began around 1900, worse through the evening, band-like, 8/10 at worst; nausea with two vomits; dizziness on standing; everyone's symptoms started the same evening and everyone improved within minutes of going outside. The furnace has run constantly for two days; it was last serviced 'years ago'. The CO alarm started chirping at dinner - 'we thought the battery was dying'. No one has fever, cough or sore throat. PMHx: father - none. Meds: none. Allergies: none. LOI: dinner at 1830 - the whole family ate the same meal, but symptoms do not fit food poisoning because they improved with fresh air.
phases.infoZh: 父亲回答：头痛约 19:00 开始，入夜加重，像带子勒着，最重 8/10；恶心并吐了两次；站起来发晕；全家人的症状都在同一个晚上出现，而且所有人到室外几分钟内都见好转。暖炉已连续运转两天，上次保养是「好几年前」。CO 报警器晚饭时开始叽叽响——「我们以为是电池快没电了」。没有人发热、咳嗽或咽痛。既往史：父亲无。用药：无。过敏史：无。最后进食：18:30 晚饭——全家吃的同一餐，但症状不符合食物中毒，因为呼吸新鲜空气后都好转了。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: band-like headache with nausea and dizziness in a shared indoor environment
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：同一室内环境下出现的箍带样头痛伴恶心、头晕。

expected.actionEn: Take the exposure-focused HxC/C: who is affected, when symptoms started for each person, whether symptoms improve away from the house, what fuel-burning appliances are running, and the CO alarm history
expected.actionZh: 采集以暴露为核心的现病史：哪些人受影响、各自何时出现症状、离开住宅后是否好转、家里有哪些燃气设备在运转，以及 CO 报警器的情况。

expected.actionEn: Score the headache and track its trend on oxygen
expected.actionZh: 为头痛评分，并追踪吸氧后的变化趋势。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - and reason through why this is not food poisoning
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮——并说清为什么这不是食物中毒。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (father, outside, in under 3 minutes): GCS 15; BP 138/88; pulse 104 strong regular; respirations 20; skin normal to slightly flushed, warm, dry; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 99% - documented WITH the note that it is unreliable in CO exposure; BGL not indicated (no altered LOC); temperature 36.8 C (indicated - differentiates CO from a febrile household illness: no fever here). Quick vitals on the other three: mother pulse 92, children alert with strong regular pulses - documented by the second crew. Second set for the father is due within 17-18 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（父亲，室外测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 15；血压 138/88；脉搏 104 次/分，有力规则；呼吸 20 次/分；皮肤颜色正常至略潮红，温暖干燥；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 99%——记录时必须注明该读数在 CO 暴露下不可靠；血糖无指征（无意识改变）；体温 36.8 摄氏度（有指征——用于区分 CO 与全家感染性疾病：本例无发热）。其余三人快速测量：母亲脉搏 92，两个孩子清醒、脉搏有力规则——由第二组记录。父亲的第二组生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 documented with the unreliability caveat stated - and oxygen NOT titrated down because of it
expected.actionZh: 记录 SpO2 并同时注明其不可靠——绝不因为这个读数把氧调小。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated to differentiate CO exposure from a febrile illness affecting the household
expected.actionZh: 体温——有指征，用于区分 CO 暴露与全家感染性疾病。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, father, kept brief. General - well until tonight; CNS - headache and dizziness, no confusion, no weakness, no visual changes; respiratory - no cough, no SOB; cardiovascular - no chest pain or palpitations (important: CO can precipitate cardiac ischemia); GI/GU - nausea, vomited twice; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - no sore throat, no coryza beyond the family's mild winter sniffles.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，对父亲简要采集。全身情况——今晚之前一切正常；中枢神经——头痛和头晕，无意识混乱、无肢体无力、无视觉改变；呼吸——无咳嗽、无气促；心血管——无胸痛、无心悸（重要：CO 可诱发心肌缺血）；消化/泌尿——恶心，吐过两次；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无咽痛，除全家冬天常见的轻微鼻塞外无卡他症状。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统。
