expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (CO exposure can precipitate cardiac ischemia - ask about chest pain)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统（CO 暴露可诱发心肌缺血——必须问胸痛）。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe on the father, done in the ambulance: head/neck - no trauma, mucous membranes normal in colour; chest - clear and equal air entry throughout, no accessory muscle use; abdomen - soft, mildly tender epigastrium after vomiting; back - nil; upper extremities - normal strength and sensation bilaterally; lower extremities - normal strength, steady gait was noted before he was seated - no focal neurological deficit anywhere.
phases.infoZh: 在救护车内对父亲做从头到脚检查：头颈——无外伤，黏膜颜色正常；胸部——双肺进气清晰对称，无辅助呼吸肌参与；腹部——柔软，呕吐后上腹轻压痛；背部——无异常；上肢——双侧肌力和感觉正常；下肢——肌力正常，落座前观察到步态平稳——全身无局灶性神经功能缺损。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined including mucous membranes
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部，包括查看黏膜。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with full auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查并完整听诊。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查。

expected.actionEn: Back examined
expected.actionZh: 检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities: strength and sensation checked for focal deficit
expected.actionZh: 上肢：检查肌力和感觉，排查局灶性缺损。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: strength checked, gait observation documented
expected.actionZh: 下肢：检查肌力，并记录之前观察到的步态情况。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: evacuation confirmed, staging discipline, and high-flow oxygen by non-rebreather at 15 L for ALL FOUR patients regardless of their SpO2 readings - oxygen is the treatment for CO poisoning and displaces CO from hemoglobin. Do not titrate oxygen down by pulse oximetry in these patients. Warmth outside in the November cold. Position of comfort; airway watched in the vomiting father with suction available. Nobody re-enters the house for wallets, pets or coats until fire clears it. There are no medications indicated at any licence level; the definitive treatments (arterial blood gas with co-oximetry, possible hyperbaric referral) belong to the hospital - which is the argument for transporting everyone.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：确认撤离、恪守集结纪律，并给四名患者全部戴 15 L 非重复呼吸面罩高流量吸氧——无论他们的 SpO2 读数是多少——氧气本身就是 CO 中毒的治疗，能把 CO 从血红蛋白上置换下来。这类患者绝不按脉搏血氧仪读数下调氧流量。十一月的寒夜里在室外注意保暖。舒适体位；父亲有呕吐史，要盯住气道并备好吸引器。消防解除限制之前，任何人不得回屋取钱包、宠物或外套。本场任何级别都没有指征用药；确定性诊治（含碳氧血红蛋白测定的血气分析、必要时高压氧转诊）属于医院——这正是所有人都要送院的理由。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen by non-rebreather at 15 L applied to all four patients and maintained throughout transport
expected.actionZh: 四名患者全部戴 15 L 非重复呼吸面罩高流量吸氧，并在转运全程维持。

expected.actionEn: Never titrate the oxygen down based on the pulse oximeter - state the reason out loud
expected.actionZh: 绝不根据脉搏血氧仪读数下调氧流量——并口头说出原因。

expected.actionEn: Enforce scene discipline: no one re-enters the house until fire clears it
expected.actionZh: 执行现场纪律：消防解除限制前任何人不得回屋。

expected.actionEn: Keep all patients warm outside; suction available for the vomiting father
expected.actionZh: 让所有患者在室外保暖；为有呕吐的父亲备好吸引器。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that hospital evaluation - not symptom relief - is the endpoint, especially for the pregnant mother
expected.actionZh: 口头说明：终点是医院评估而不是症状缓解，怀孕的母亲尤其如此。

phases.infoEn: Reassess all four patients at regular intervals. Father set 2 (15 minutes after set 1, on oxygen): GCS 15; BP 132/84; pulse 96; respirations 18; skin normal; pupils equal; SpO2 99% (still documented as unreliable); headache down to 5/10; no further vomiting. Children and mother stable on oxygen. Continue oxygen for everyone through transport; if anyone's LOC dips, that patient becomes RTC immediately.
phases.infoZh: 按规定间隔复评全部四名患者。父亲第 2 组（第 1 组之后 15 分钟，吸氧中）：GCS 15；血压 132/84；脉搏 96 次/分；呼吸 18 次/分；皮肤正常；瞳孔等大；SpO2 99%（仍注明不可靠）；头痛降至 5/10；没有再吐。孩子和母亲在吸氧下均稳定。转运全程所有人继续吸氧；任何一人意识变差，该患者立即转为 RTC。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and oxygen delivery on all four patients at regular intervals
expected.actionZh: 按规定间隔复评四名患者的 ABC 和氧疗情况。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals on the father within 17-18 minutes, with the improving headache trend interpreted
expected.actionZh: 17–18 分钟内完成父亲的第二组完整生命体征，并解读头痛减轻的趋势。

expected.actionEn: Keep oxygen running on every patient for the entire transport - improvement is not a reason to remove it
expected.actionZh: 转运全程每名患者的氧都不撤——症状好转不是撤氧的理由。

expected.actionEn: Re-state the watch condition: any dip in LOC converts that patient to RTC
expected.actionZh: 重申监测条件：任何一人意识变差就立即转为 RTC。

phases.infoEn: Notification for a four-patient CO exposure so the ED can prepare. The hand-off must state the exposure duration, the fire department's CO reading, each patient's symptoms, that SpO2 readings were treated as unreliable, and that the mother is 12 weeks pregnant. PCR within 5 minutes for each transported patient.
phases.infoZh: 预报一起四人 CO 暴露，让急诊提前准备。交接必须说明暴露时长、消防测得的 CO 读数、每名患者的症状、SpO2 读数已按不可靠处理，以及母亲怀孕 12 周。每名转运患者的 PCR 在 5 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification: four CO-exposure patients including a pregnant woman
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：四名 CO 暴露患者，其中一名孕妇。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off with the CO reading, exposure timeline and per-patient findings
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接，包含 CO 读数、暴露时间线和每名患者的情况。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCRs completed within 5 minutes, one per patient
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，每名患者一份。

vitalsSets.skin: normal to slightly flushed, warm, dry

vitalsSets.timeHint: father, 15 minutes later on 15 L NRB - improving

criticalPitfallsEn: Entering the house before fire clears it - the crew becomes patients five and six
Trusting the SpO2 of 99% and withholding or titrating down oxygen - pulse oximetry cannot see carboxyhemoglobin; CO poisoning requires high-flow oxygen by non-rebreather regardless of the reading
Treating this as gastroenteritis or influenza and accepting refusals - the whole-household onset, the chirping alarm and improvement outdoors make the diagnosis
Transporting only the father and leaving the mildly symptomatic children and pregnant mother at the scene
Missing the additional-resources call: one ambulance cannot manage four patients
Letting family members re-enter for pets or belongings before the structure is cleared
Removing oxygen when symptoms improve - treatment continues through transport
criticalPitfallsZh: 消防解除限制前进入住宅——救护组自己变成第五、第六名患者。
相信 99% 的 SpO2 而不给氧或把氧调小——脉搏血氧仪看不见碳氧血红蛋白；CO 中毒无论读数如何都必须用非重复呼吸面罩高流量给氧。
把本例当肠胃炎或流感处理并接受拒诊——全家同时起病、报警器叽叽响、到室外就好转，这三条合起来就是诊断。
只转运父亲，把症状较轻的孩子和怀孕的母亲留在现场。
忘了申请额外资源：一辆救护车管不了四名患者。
在房屋解除限制前放家属回屋拿宠物或物品。
症状一好转就撤氧——治疗必须持续到转运结束。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR delivers the whole treatment: recognizing the household exposure pattern, staging discipline, evacuation confirmation, high-flow oxygen by non-rebreather at 15 L for every exposed patient with the SpO2 explicitly distrusted, warmth, airway watch on the vomiting patient, multi-patient logistics with a second ambulance, and transport of all four. No medication is indicated at any level - oxygen is the drug.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 全部治疗都由 EMR 完成：识别全家同时暴露的模式、恪守集结纪律、确认撤离、给每名暴露者 15 L 非重复呼吸面罩高流量吸氧并明确不信任 SpO2 读数、保暖、盯住呕吐患者的气道、用第二辆救护车完成多患者调度，并把四人全部送院。本场任何级别都没有指征药物——氧气就是药。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry and could treat the father's nausea en route (dimenhydrinate or ondansetron per the Nausea-Vomiting protocol) - noting ondansetron's relative contraindication in the first-trimester mother. Oxygen management is identical to EMR.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊，并可在途中按恶心-呕吐方案处理父亲的恶心（dimenhydrinate 或 ondansetron）——注意 ondansetron 对孕早期的母亲属相对禁忌。氧疗与 EMR 完全一致。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: These are four patients from a single carbon monoxide exposure in a townhouse - the furnace had run continuously for two days and fire measured 380 ppm near the furnace closet. The CO alarm had been chirping since dinner. This patient is the 45-year-old father, the most symptomatic: band-like headache to 8 out of 10 from about 1900, nausea with two vomits, dizziness on standing. Everyone improved within minutes of getting outside. He has been on 15 litres by non-rebreather since our arrival; SpO2 has read 99% throughout, which we have treated as unreliable in CO exposure. Vitals: GCS 15, BP 138/88 settling to 132/84, pulse 104 down to 96, resps 20 down to 18, afebrile at 36.8. No focal neurological deficits, no chest pain. No medical history, no medications, no allergies, dinner at 1830. Also incoming: the 43-year-old mother - who is 12 weeks pregnant - with moderate headache and nausea, and two children aged 9 and 7 with mild headaches, all on oxygen, all stable, arriving with the second crew.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是同一起联排住宅一氧化碳暴露中的四名患者——暖炉已连续运转两天，消防在暖炉储藏间附近测得 380 ppm。CO 报警器从晚饭起一直在响。本车患者是症状最重的 45 岁父亲：约 19:00 起箍带样头痛，最重 8/10，恶心并吐了两次，站立时头晕。所有人到室外几分钟内均见好转。他自我们到达起一直用 15 L 非重复呼吸面罩吸氧；SpO2 全程显示 99%，我们已按 CO 暴露下不可靠的读数处理。生命体征：GCS 15，血压 138/88 降至 132/84，脉搏 104 降至 96，呼吸 20 降至 18，体温 36.8 无发热。无局灶性神经缺损，无胸痛。无既往史、无用药、无过敏，18:30 晚餐。随后到达的还有：43 岁的母亲——怀孕 12 周——中度头痛伴恶心，以及 9 岁和 7 岁两个孩子，轻度头痛；四人全部吸氧、均稳定，由第二组转运。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Headache, nausea and dizziness in all four occupants of a CO-contaminated townhouse
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Symptoms from ~1900 in all occupants, band-like headache 8/10 in the father with two vomits; furnace running two days, CO alarm chirping since dinner, fire measured 380 ppm; all improved within minutes outside; no fever, cough or sore throat in the household
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Father: none. Mother: 12 weeks pregnant. Children: healthy
treatments: Staged outside; no crew entry until fire cleared the structure; family evacuation confirmed
High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather to all four patients, maintained through transport
SpO2 documented as unreliable in CO exposure; oxygen never titrated by oximetry
Second ambulance requested; patients split with a parent accompanying each child
Warmth outside; suction available for the vomiting father
All four transported for evaluation - pregnancy flagged to the receiving hospital
findings: Whole-household simultaneous onset improving with fresh air - consistent with CO, not infection or food poisoning
Fire department CO reading 380 ppm near the furnace closet; lethargic dog corroborates
Father: GCS 15 throughout, no focal deficits, afebrile, headache 8/10 improving to 5/10 on oxygen
SpO2 99% on room air - documented as unreliable
No unstable criteria in any patient; upgrade triggers stated and monitored

scenarios.titleEn: Confused and Hypotensive at 82 - Suspected Sepsis From a Urinary Source
scenarios.titleZh: 82 岁老人意识混乱伴低血压——疑似泌尿系感染引发的脓毒症
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1420 hrs. Code 3 to an assisted-living residence in Nanaimo. Staff report an 82-year-old woman is 'not herself' - confused since this morning, will not get out of her chair, and feels hot to touch. Nanaimo Regional General Hospital is 8 minutes away; the nearest PCP car is 15 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:20，Code 3 前往 Nanaimo 一处协助式养老公寓。工作人员报告一名 82 岁女性「整个人不对劲」——从今早开始意识混乱，不肯从椅子上起来，摸上去发烫。Nanaimo Regional General 医院距离 8 分钟车程；最近的 PCP 车 15 分钟后到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: staff say she was her usual self yesterday. She has been drinking very little for two days and has had one unwitnessed fall in her suite this morning. There is a full medication list at the nursing station.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：工作人员说她昨天还一切如常。近两天喝水很少，今早在自己房间里还摔过一次，无人目击。护士站有一份完整的用药清单。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan equipment: oxygen, suction, blood glucose meter, thermometer, blankets, stretcher taken to the patient's room
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并规划装备：氧气、吸引器、血糖仪、体温计、毯子，并把担架直接推到患者房间。

expected.actionEn: Plan to collect the medication list and, if available, the staff's baseline notes - in a geriatric altered-LOC call the baseline is the single most valuable piece of information
expected.actionZh: 计划取走用药清单，若有护理记录也一并带走——老年患者意识改变的出车中，「平时是什么样」是最有价值的一条信息。

expected.actionEn: Anticipate the differential before arrival: infection, hypoglycemia, stroke, occult head injury from the unwitnessed fall, medication effect, and dehydration
expected.actionZh: 到场前先想好鉴别诊断：感染、低血糖、卒中、无人目击跌倒造成的隐匿性头部损伤、药物作用，以及脱水。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Clean, warm suite, no hazards, adequate lighting. One patient: an 82-year-old woman slumped in her recliner, eyes half open, mumbling. A care aide is with her and has the medication list. There is a strong smell of urine and a soaked incontinence pad. Her walker is beside the chair. Full drink glasses sit untouched on the side table.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：套房整洁温暖，无危险源，光线充足。只有一名患者：82 岁女性瘫坐在躺椅里，眼睛半睁，含糊自语。一名护理员在旁，手里拿着用药清单。房间有很浓的尿味，失禁护垫已被浸透。助行器就放在椅子旁。边桌上几杯水一口没动。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment (warm indoor room), nature of illness (altered LOC of gradual onset), people (one patient plus a care aide who can give collateral history) and resources (PCP car en route)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无）、环境（温暖的室内）、疾病性质（逐渐出现的意识改变）、人员（一名患者加一位能提供旁证病史的护理员）以及资源（PCP 车在途中）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; add a mask given an undifferentiated febrile patient
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；面对病因未明的发热患者，再加戴口罩。

expected.actionEn: First look: elderly woman, drowsy and mumbling, flushed face, breathing fast, untouched drinks and a soaked pad pointing to poor intake and a urinary source
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：老年女性，嗜睡并含糊自语，面色潮红，呼吸偏快；一口没动的水杯和被浸透的护垫提示进水不足及泌尿系感染源。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: opens her eyes to voice, says 'I'm fine dear... I'm fine' and drifts off again; cannot say where she is or what year it is; the aide confirms she is normally fully oriented and does her own crossword every morning. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway patent, no vomit, secretions minimal; respirations 26, shallow, clear air entry both sides; radial pulse 116, weak, regular; skin hot and flushed centrally but the hands and feet are cool and mottled - delayed capillary refill at 4 seconds. RAPID BODY SURVEY: small bruise on the left hip from the morning fall, no head injury, no midline neck tenderness and she moves all four limbs on command, chest and abdomen non-tender, suprapubic area tender to gentle palpation, no external bleeding. SpO2 92% on room air. UNSTABLE: altered LOC plus cool clammy peripheries suggestive of shock.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：能被言语唤醒睁眼，说「我没事，亲爱的……我没事」，随即又昏睡过去；说不出自己在哪里、今年是哪一年；护理员确认她平时定向力完全正常，每天早上都自己做填字游戏。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，无呕吐物，分泌物很少；呼吸 26 次/分、浅表，双肺进气清晰；桡动脉搏动 116 次/分，细弱、规则；躯干皮肤发烫潮红，但手足发凉、有花斑——毛细血管再充盈延长至 4 秒。快速体格检查：左髋有今早跌倒留下的小片瘀斑，无头部外伤，颈椎中线无压痛，四肢均能按指令活动，胸腹无压痛，耻骨上区轻压有痛，无外出血。室内空气 SpO2 92%。不稳定判定：意识改变，加上四肢湿冷提示休克。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to voice but is disoriented - and compare it against her stated baseline of full orientation, because 'confused' means nothing without a baseline
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：能被言语唤醒但定向力障碍——并与护理员描述的「平时定向力完全正常」这一基线对比，因为脱离基线谈「意识混乱」毫无意义。

expected.actionEn: Apply the NEXUS criteria to the unwitnessed fall and state the conclusion: no midline tenderness, no focal deficit, no intoxication, no distracting injury - but her altered mental status means alertness is NOT normal, so spinal motion restriction is indicated and manual stabilization is taken
expected.actionZh: 针对这次无人目击的跌倒套用 NEXUS 标准并说出结论：颈椎中线无压痛、无神经功能缺损、无中毒、无分散注意力的损伤——但她精神状态已经改变、「意识正常」这一条不成立，因此有脊柱固定指征，需实施徒手固定。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and keep suction at hand - her LOC is decreased and she may vomit
expected.actionZh: 评估气道并把吸引器放在手边——她意识水平下降，随时可能呕吐。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: rate 26 and shallow, auscultate both sides - tachypnea in an elderly patient is an early and frequently ignored sign of sepsis
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：26 次/分、浅表，双侧听诊——老年患者呼吸增快是脓毒症最早出现、也最常被忽略的体征。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: weak radial pulse of 116 with cool mottled peripheries and 4-second capillary refill - state out loud that this is shock despite the warm flushed trunk
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动 116 次/分、细弱，四肢发凉花斑，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒——明确说出这是休克，尽管躯干还是又热又红。

expected.actionEn: Perform a full rapid body survey, including gentle abdominal and suprapubic palpation to look for the infection source, and check for injuries from the unwitnessed fall
expected.actionZh: 完成完整的快速体格检查，包括轻柔触诊腹部和耻骨上区以寻找感染源，并检查无人目击的跌倒造成的损伤。

expected.actionEn: Identify shock with an altered LOC as a life threat you cannot correct on scene and act on it by shortening scene time
expected.actionZh: 把「休克合并意识改变」认定为你在现场无法纠正的致命威胁，并据此缩短现场时间。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: trunk hot and flushed, peripheries cool and mottled
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：躯干发烫潮红，四肢发凉有花斑。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen to maintain SpO2 at or above 94%: she is at 92% with evidence of shock and an altered LOC, so high-flow oxygen is indicated
expected.actionZh: 给氧以维持 SpO2 在 94% 及以上：她只有 92%，且有休克表现和意识改变，因此有高流量给氧的指征。

expected.actionEn: Position supine to support blood pressure, and keep her covered - she is hypotensive and moves poorly on her own
expected.actionZh: 取仰卧位以支撑血压，并注意覆盖保温——她血压偏低，自己也几乎动不了。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Altered LOC and cool clammy skin secondary to suspected shock both appear in the unstable findings: this is a Rapid Transport Category call, ready to load within 15 minutes, secondary survey completed en route. Destination is the closest emergency department - she needs blood cultures, intravenous fluids and antibiotics, none of which exist in the prehospital EMR kit. Say the decision out loud and act with visible urgency, because a chatty confused elderly patient is the classic patient candidates under-triage.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。意识改变，以及怀疑休克引起的皮肤湿冷，都是官方列出的不稳定表现：本场属 RTC，15 分钟内完成打包达到可装载状态，二次评估在途中完成。目的地是最近的急诊——她需要血培养、静脉输液和抗生素，而这些在 EMR 的院前装备里一样都没有。请把决策口头说出来并用看得见的紧迫感行动，因为「还能说话的意识模糊老人」正是考生最常低估的一类患者。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC out loud, citing the altered LOC and the shock findings
expected.actionZh: 明确口头判定为 RTC，并说明依据：意识改变加休克表现。

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes, with the secondary survey completed en route
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内达到可装载状态，二次评估留到途中完成。

expected.actionEn: State that definitive care is intravenous fluid and antibiotics at hospital - transport now rather than waiting on scene for the PCP car
expected.actionZh: 说明确定性治疗是医院的静脉补液和抗生素——立即转运，而不是留在现场等 PCP 车。

phases.infoEn: COLLATERAL HISTORY from the care aide, with the patient adding fragments: normally fully oriented and independent with a walker; over the last two days she has been going to the toilet more often, complaining of burning, and eating and drinking almost nothing; last night she was up all night; this morning she was confused and had an unwitnessed fall in the bathroom - no one knows whether she hit her head. No cough, no shortness of breath complaint, no chest pain, no vomiting, no diarrhea. She has had 'water infections' twice before, and the aide says the last one also made her confused. PMHx: hypertension, atrial fibrillation, osteoarthritis, mild cognitive impairment at baseline but oriented. Meds: apixaban, bisoprolol, acetaminophen as needed. Allergies: sulfa - rash. LOI: a few sips of tea this morning, no solid food for 24 hours.
phases.infoZh: 旁证病史由护理员提供，患者偶尔补上零星几句：她平时定向力完全正常，靠助行器可以自理；近两天上厕所次数明显增多，诉排尿灼痛，几乎不吃不喝；昨晚整夜没睡；今早开始意识混乱，并在浴室里摔了一次，无人目击——没人知道她有没有撞到头。无咳嗽，未诉气促，无胸痛，无呕吐，无腹泻。她以前得过两次「尿路感染」，护理员说上一次她也是变得意识混乱。既往史：高血压、心房颤动、骨关节炎，基线有轻度认知障碍但定向力正常。用药：apixaban、bisoprolol、按需服用的 acetaminophen。过敏史：磺胺类——皮疹。最后进食：今早喝了几口茶，24 小时没吃固体食物。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: new confusion in a previously oriented 82-year-old, with fever and poor intake
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：原本定向力正常的 82 岁老人新近出现意识混乱，伴发热和进食进水不足。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C from the collateral source: time of onset and rate of change, the baseline mental status, urinary symptoms, oral intake, and the unwitnessed fall including whether the head was struck
expected.actionZh: 向旁证采集现病史：起病时间与变化速度、基线精神状态、泌尿系症状、进食进水量，以及那次无人目击的跌倒——特别是有没有撞到头。

expected.actionEn: Ask about pain despite the confusion: she localizes discomfort to the lower abdomen when asked directly - elderly patients under-report pain
expected.actionZh: 即使她意识模糊也要问疼痛：直接问时她能指出下腹不适——老年患者对疼痛的主诉往往偏轻。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history, including the two previous urinary infections that also presented as confusion
expected.actionZh: 既往病史，包括此前两次同样表现为意识混乱的尿路感染。

expected.actionEn: Medications - the anticoagulant matters twice over: it raises the stakes of the unwitnessed fall, and the beta blocker can blunt the tachycardia you would expect in sepsis
expected.actionZh: 用药史——抗凝药在这里有双重意义：它让那次无人目击的跌倒风险大增；而 β 受体阻滞剂会掩盖脓毒症本该出现的心动过速。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - almost nothing for 24 hours, which compounds the hypovolemia
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮——24 小时几乎没有摄入，这会加重血容量不足。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6); BP 88/52; pulse 116 weak regular; respirations 26 shallow; skin hot and flushed on the trunk, cool and mottled peripherally; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 92% on room air rising to 96% on 15 L; BGL 9.8 mmol/L - mandatory here because the LOC is altered, and it rules hypoglycemia out; temperature 38.7 C tympanic - indicated in every suspected infection. As a priority patient the second set is due 7-8 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（3 分钟内完成）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6）；血压 88/52；脉搏 116 次/分，细弱规则；呼吸 26 次/分、浅表；躯干皮肤发烫潮红，四肢发凉有花斑；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 92%，给 15 L 氧后升至 96%；血糖 9.8 mmol/L——本例意识改变，这一项是必查，结果也排除了低血糖；体温 38.7 摄氏度（耳温）——所有怀疑感染的患者都有测量指征。作为优先患者，第二组生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately and compared to her baseline of 15
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，分别说出三项得分，并与她平时的 15 分基线对比。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation - recognize 88/52 as hypotension in an 82-year-old whose usual pressure is high
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压——认识到对一位平时血压偏高的 82 岁老人来说，88/52 就是低血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality - and note that the beta blocker may be masking how tachycardic she should be
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱——并注意 β 受体阻滞剂可能掩盖了她本该有的心率增快程度。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character with both lung fields auscultated
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双侧肺野。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on centrally and peripherally - the split between a hot trunk and cold hands is the finding
expected.actionZh: 用手分别触摸躯干和四肢评估皮肤——「躯干烫、手脚凉」这种反差本身就是关键发现。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction, important after an unwitnessed fall on an anticoagulant
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应；她在服抗凝药且有无人目击的跌倒，这一项尤其重要。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded before and after oxygen, with the reading checked against the pulse on a cool peripheral finger
expected.actionZh: 记录给氧前后的 SpO2，并在手指发凉的情况下核对读数与实际脉搏是否一致。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - mandatory in any patient with a decreased level of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 血糖——所有意识水平下降的患者都必须测。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated in suspected infection; document the route used
expected.actionZh: 体温——怀疑感染时有测量指征；并记录测量部位。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, answers mostly from the aide. General - normally independent, sharp for her age, sudden change over 48 hours; CNS - confusion only, no one-sided weakness, no facial droop, no speech change beyond the confusion; respiratory - no cough, no sputum, no pleuritic pain; cardiovascular - no chest pain, chronic atrial fibrillation; GI/GU - burning on urination, going more often, strong-smelling urine, no vomiting, no diarrhea, no abdominal pain until pressed; integumentary - no rash, no pressure sores, small hip bruise; musculoskeletal - the morning fall, no deformity; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，在途中进行，答案主要来自护理员。全身情况——平时生活自理、头脑清楚，48 小时内急剧变化；中枢神经——只有意识混乱，无一侧肢体无力、无口角歪斜，除混乱外无言语改变；呼吸——无咳嗽、无痰、无胸膜性疼痛；心血管——无胸痛，慢性心房颤动；消化/泌尿——排尿灼痛、次数增多、尿味很重，无呕吐、无腹泻，不按压则不诉腹痛；皮肤——无皮疹、无压疮，髋部有小片瘀斑；肌肉骨骼——今早跌倒，无畸形；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (the 48-hour trajectory from independent to confused is the story)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况（48 小时内从生活自理变成意识混乱，这条时间线就是主线）。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (screen for stroke: no facial droop, no unilateral weakness)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（筛查卒中：无口角歪斜、无一侧肢体无力）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (pneumonia is the other common septic source in the elderly)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统（肺炎是老年脓毒症另一个常见来源）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (dysuria, frequency and strong-smelling urine point to the source)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（排尿灼痛、尿频、尿味重直指感染来源）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (look for cellulitis and pressure sores as alternative sources)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤（查找蜂窝织炎和压疮等其他感染来源）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - no scalp laceration or hematoma found, no blood or fluid from the ears or nose, tongue and lips dry, neck supple with no midline tenderness, no JVD; chest - equal air entry, no crackles, no wheeze; abdomen - soft, tender in the suprapubic region, no rebound, no distension; back - inspected during the transfer, no pressure sores; upper extremities - skin tenting on the forearm, cool hands, radial pulses weak but present bilaterally; lower extremities - bruise over the left greater trochanter with no shortening or rotation, both legs move on command, pedal pulses weak but present.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚检查：头颈——未发现头皮裂伤或血肿，耳鼻无血液或液体流出，口唇舌面干燥，颈部柔软、中线无压痛，无颈静脉怒张；胸部——双肺进气对称，无湿啰音、无哮鸣音；腹部——柔软，耻骨上区压痛，无反跳痛，无膨隆；背部——转移时视诊，无压疮；上肢——前臂皮肤捏起后回弹缓慢，双手发凉，双侧桡动脉搏动细弱但可及；下肢——左股骨大转子处有瘀斑，无肢体缩短或外旋，双腿均能按指令活动，足背动脉搏动细弱但可及。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined specifically for occult injury from the unwitnessed fall in an anticoagulated patient
expected.actionZh: 重点检查头颈部有无那次无人目击跌倒造成的隐匿性损伤——她还在服抗凝药。

expected.actionEn: Chest auscultated at all six sites, listening for the crackles of a pneumonic source
expected.actionZh: 胸部六个听诊点全部听诊，留意提示肺炎来源的湿啰音。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants with the suprapubic tenderness reported as the likely source
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查，并把耻骨上区压痛作为最可能的感染来源报告出来。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the transfer, checking for pressure sores as an alternative source
expected.actionZh: 转移时检查背部，排查压疮这一潜在感染来源。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with skin turgor and bilateral radial pulses documented
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查并记录皮肤弹性和双侧桡动脉搏动。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: assess the hip after the fall for shortening or rotation, and document pedal pulses
expected.actionZh: 下肢：评估跌倒后的髋部有无缩短或外旋，并记录足背动脉搏动。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: airway management with suction ready, oxygen titrated to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, supine positioning to support the blood pressure, blankets, spinal motion restriction because the altered mental status invalidates the NEXUS alertness criterion after an unwitnessed fall, blood glucose measurement, temperature measurement, and rapid transport with early notification. THE GLUCOSE TRAP: her BGL is 9.8, so hypoglycemia is excluded - oral glucose is not indicated, and it would be contraindicated anyway in a patient who cannot reliably protect her airway. Glucagon is likewise not indicated with a normal-to-high glucose. OUT OF EMR SCOPE and verbalized: intravenous access and a fluid bolus, and the antibiotics she really needs - these come from the PCP intercept and the hospital, and none of them justify a longer scene time.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：气道管理并备好吸引器、给氧维持 SpO2 在 94% 及以上、仰卧位以支撑血压、盖毯保暖、因精神状态改变使 NEXUS 的「意识正常」一条不成立而对这次无人目击的跌倒实施脊柱固定、测血糖、测体温，并快速转运加早期预报。血糖陷阱：她的血糖是 9.8，低血糖已被排除——口服葡萄糖没有指征；何况她无法可靠保护气道，本身就是禁忌。血糖正常偏高时 glucagon 同样没有指征。超出 EMR 范围、需要口头说明的：静脉通路和液体复苏，以及她真正需要的抗生素——这些由会合的 PCP 和医院提供，且都不足以成为拖长现场时间的理由。

expected.actionEn: Measure the blood glucose before attributing the altered LOC to infection, and correctly withhold oral glucose and glucagon with a BGL of 9.8 - giving glucose here would be initiating a protocol without indications
expected.actionZh: 在把意识改变归因于感染之前先测血糖；血糖 9.8 时正确地不给口服葡萄糖、不给 glucagon——在这里给糖属于「无指征启动处置方案」。

expected.actionEn: Spinal management applied correctly for the unwitnessed fall with altered mental status: manual stabilization, sized hard collar, moved as a unit onto the stretcher, head not taped
expected.actionZh: 针对「无人目击跌倒 + 精神状态改变」正确实施脊柱固定：徒手固定、选对尺寸的硬颈托、整体移上担架床，不用胶带缠头。

expected.actionEn: Airway management: suction at the head and a plan to tip the whole device if she vomits
expected.actionZh: 气道管理：吸引器放在头侧，并预先想好一旦呕吐就整体侧倾固定装置。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen and positioning per the hypovolemia approach: supine to support blood pressure, oxygen to SpO2 94% or above, kept covered and warm
expected.actionZh: 按低血容量处置原则给氧和摆位：仰卧位支撑血压，给氧维持 SpO2 94% 及以上，盖好保暖。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that IV fluid and antibiotics are outside EMR scope, and that the treatment an EMR controls here is oxygen, position, warmth and speed
expected.actionZh: 口头说明静脉补液和抗生素超出 EMR 范围；EMR 在这一场能掌控的治疗只有给氧、体位、保暖和速度。

expected.actionEn: Treat her with dignity throughout: explain each step even though she is confused, keep her covered during exposure, and bring the medication list
expected.actionZh: 全程尊重患者：即便她意识模糊也要逐步解释，暴露检查时注意遮盖，并带走用药清单。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after every move and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1): GCS 12 (E3 V3 M6); BP 84/50; pulse 122 weak; respirations 28 shallow; skin unchanged - hot trunk, cold mottled hands; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 95% on 15 L; temperature 38.9 C. She is deteriorating: the correct response is to keep her supine, keep the oxygen on, protect the airway, update the hospital and keep driving - not to stop and repeat the physical examination.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已做的处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟）：GCS 12（E3 V3 M6）；血压 84/50；脉搏 122 次/分、细弱；呼吸 28 次/分、浅表；皮肤同前——躯干发烫，双手发凉有花斑；瞳孔等大有反应；15 L 氧下 SpO2 95%；体温 38.9 摄氏度。她在恶化：正确的反应是保持仰卧、继续吸氧、保护气道、向医院更新病情并继续赶路——而不是停下来重做体格检查。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和全部已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes, and interpret the falling GCS with falling blood pressure out loud as worsening septic shock
expected.actionZh: 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读「GCS 下降合并血压下降」这一趋势：脓毒性休克正在加重。

expected.actionEn: Protect the airway as the GCS falls: suction in hand, ready to tip the device, ready to assist ventilation if the respirations become inadequate
expected.actionZh: GCS 下降时保护气道：吸引器拿在手边，随时可整体侧倾，一旦呼吸不足立即辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Keep her supine and covered, and update the receiving hospital with the deterioration rather than stopping to re-examine
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧并盖好，向接收医院更新恶化情况，而不是停车重新检查。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the emergency department en route so sepsis care can start on arrival. The hand-off must state the baseline mental status, the 48-hour trajectory, the urinary symptoms, the anticoagulant, the unwitnessed fall, and the vital sign trend. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中就向急诊预报，让脓毒症处置在她到院时即可启动。交接必须说明基线精神状态、48 小时的病情演变、泌尿系症状、抗凝药、无人目击的跌倒，以及生命体征趋势。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification describing a hypotensive febrile elderly patient with an altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：一名发热、低血压且意识改变的老年患者。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off including the baseline mental status, the suspected urinary source, the anticoagulant and the unwitnessed fall
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接，包含基线精神状态、疑似泌尿系感染源、抗凝药，以及那次无人目击的跌倒。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR 书面记录。

vitalsSets.skin: trunk hot flushed, peripheries cool mottled, CR 4 s
trunk hot, hands cold and mottled

criticalPitfallsEn: Accepting 'she has dementia, she is always like this' - the aide's baseline of full orientation makes this an acute change; without a baseline you cannot call anything confusion

Skipping the blood glucose in a patient with a decreased LOC, or giving oral glucose or glucagon reflexively when the BGL is 9.8 - initiating a protocol without indications is a 100% deduction, and oral glucose in a patient who cannot protect her airway is contraindicated
Calling her stable because she talks to you - altered LOC and cool clammy skin from suspected shock are both listed unstable findings; a transport category error is a 25% deduction
Missing the shock because the trunk is hot and flushed - perfusion is judged at the peripheries and by the capillary refill, not by how warm the forehead feels

Skipping spinal precautions after the unwitnessed fall because 'she has no neck pain' - a confused patient fails the NEXUS alertness criterion, and failing to initiate C-spine control when indicated is a 100% deduction
Failing to ask about anticoagulants, so the receiving team is not warned about intracranial bleeding risk after an unwitnessed fall
Waiting on scene for the PCP car to start an IV - fluids and antibiotics are hospital-side definitive care and nothing about them justifies delaying transport
criticalPitfallsZh: 接受「她有痴呆，一向就这样」的说法——护理员给出的基线是定向力完全正常，说明这是急性变化；没有基线就无从判断什么叫「意识混乱」。
意识水平下降却不测血糖，或看到血糖 9.8 还条件反射地给口服葡萄糖或 glucagon——无指征启动处置方案扣 100%，而且对无法保护气道的患者用口服葡萄糖本身就是禁忌。
因为她还能和你说话就判为稳定——意识改变和怀疑休克引起的皮肤湿冷都在官方不稳定表现之列；转运分类错误扣 25%。
因为躯干又热又红就漏掉休克——灌注要看四肢和毛细血管再充盈，而不是摸额头有多热。
因为「她不喊脖子疼」就在这次无人目击的跌倒后省掉脊柱防护——意识混乱的患者不满足 NEXUS 的「意识正常」一条；有指征却不启动 C-spine 控制扣 100%。
没有问抗凝药，导致接收团队没有被提醒无人目击跌倒后的颅内出血风险。
留在现场等 PCP 车来上静脉通路——补液和抗生素属于医院端的确定性治疗，任何理由都不足以拖延转运。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR runs this as a recognition-and-speed call: establish the baseline mental status from the aide, measure the blood glucose to exclude hypoglycemia and then correctly withhold glucose, oxygen to SpO2 94% or above, supine positioning with blankets, spinal motion restriction because the confused patient fails the NEXUS alertness criterion after an unwitnessed fall, suction at the head, a temperature that supports the infective picture, and rapid transport with early notification. IV fluids and antibiotics are outside EMR scope - the EMR contribution to this patient's outcome is early recognition and a short scene time.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 跑这一场靠的是「识别 + 速度」：向护理员问清基线精神状态；测血糖排除低血糖并据此正确地不给糖；给氧维持 SpO2 94% 及以上；仰卧位加盖毯；因意识混乱使 NEXUS 的「意识正常」一条不成立，对这次无人目击的跌倒实施脊柱固定；吸引器放在头侧；测体温以支持感染的判断；然后快速转运并早期预报。静脉补液和抗生素超出 EMR 范围——EMR 对这名患者预后的贡献，就是早识别和短现场时间。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry and vascular access en route with a fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L, reassessed every 500 mL and titrated to a systolic of 90 - this patient is hypotensive with clinical signs of shock and 24 hours of almost no intake. PCP would also consider dimenhydrinate or ondansetron if she vomits, weighing ondansetron's cautions in the elderly.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊，并在途中建立静脉通路，按 20 mL/kg（最多 2 升）快速补液，每 500 mL 复评一次、滴定至收缩压 90——本例存在低血压和临床休克表现，且 24 小时几乎没有摄入。若出现呕吐，PCP 还可考虑 dimenhydrinate 或 ondansetron，但须权衡 ondansetron 在老年患者中的注意事项。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is an 82-year-old woman from an assisted-living residence who is normally fully oriented and independent with a walker. Over the past 48 hours she has had burning on urination and increased frequency, has eaten and drunk almost nothing, and this morning became acutely confused. She also had an unwitnessed fall in her bathroom this morning and takes apixaban, so occult head injury is a concern - our examination found no scalp injury and her pupils are equal and reactive. On arrival she was drowsy, opening her eyes to voice and disoriented, GCS 13 falling to 12. Respirations 26 rising to 28 and shallow, radial pulse 116 rising to 122 and weak, blood pressure 88/52 falling to 84/50, trunk hot and flushed with cold mottled hands and a capillary refill of 4 seconds. Temperature 38.7 rising to 38.9. Blood glucose 9.8, so no glucose was given. Suprapubic tenderness on palpation, chest clear, no focal neurological deficit. History: hypertension, atrial fibrillation, osteoarthritis, two previous urinary infections that also presented as confusion. Medications apixaban, bisoprolol and acetaminophen - note the beta blocker may be blunting her heart rate response. Allergic to sulfa. Last real intake 24 hours ago. Treatments: oxygen at 15 litres with SpO2 up to 95%, supine, blankets, spinal motion restriction for the unwitnessed fall, suction at hand, rapid transport.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名来自协助式养老公寓的 82 岁女性，平时定向力完全正常、靠助行器可以自理。过去 48 小时她出现排尿灼痛和尿频，几乎不吃不喝，今早突然变得意识混乱。今早她还在浴室里摔过一次、无人目击，且长期服用 apixaban，因此必须警惕隐匿性颅脑损伤——我们检查未发现头皮损伤，瞳孔等大、对光反应存在。我们到达时她嗜睡，能被言语唤醒但定向力障碍，GCS 13 降至 12。呼吸 26 升至 28、浅表；桡动脉搏动 116 升至 122、细弱；血压 88/52 降至 84/50；躯干发烫潮红而双手发凉、有花斑，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。体温 38.7 升至 38.9。血糖 9.8，因此未给任何葡萄糖。耻骨上区触痛，双肺清晰，无局灶性神经功能缺损。病史：高血压、心房颤动、骨关节炎，此前两次尿路感染同样表现为意识混乱。用药为 apixaban、bisoprolol 和 acetaminophen——请注意 β 受体阻滞剂可能压低了她的心率反应。磺胺类过敏。上一次正经进食是 24 小时前。我们的处置：15 L 给氧、SpO2 升至 95%，仰卧，盖毯保暖，因无人目击跌倒实施脊柱固定，吸引器备在手边，快速转运。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Acute confusion, fever and hypotension in a previously oriented 82-year-old
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: 48 hours of dysuria, frequency and strong-smelling urine with almost no oral intake; acute confusion this morning; unwitnessed fall in the bathroom on apixaban; baseline per care aide is fully oriented and independent; two previous urinary infections presenting as confusion
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Hypertension, atrial fibrillation, osteoarthritis, mild cognitive impairment but oriented at baseline
treatments: Oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above (92% RA to 95-96% on 15 L)
Supine positioning to support blood pressure, blankets for warmth
Spinal motion restriction for the unwitnessed fall - NEXUS alertness criterion not met due to altered mental status
Suction at the head with a plan to tip the device if she vomits
BGL 9.8 measured - hypoglycemia excluded, oral glucose and glucagon correctly withheld
Temperature measured tympanically; medication list brought to hospital
RTC transport with early ED notification; IV fluids and antibiotics verbalized as out of EMR scope
findings: GCS 13 falling to 12 against a documented baseline of 15
Hypotension 88/52 falling to 84/50 with a weak pulse of 116 to 122
Hot flushed trunk with cool mottled peripheries and capillary refill of 4 seconds
Temperature 38.7 rising to 38.9; suprapubic tenderness; chest clear
No focal neurological deficit, no scalp injury found despite the unwitnessed fall on an anticoagulant
Dry mucous membranes and reduced skin turgor consistent with 24 hours of poor intake

scenarios.titleEn: Roofer Down in a Heat Wave - Exertional Heat Stroke
scenarios.titleZh: 热浪中倒下的屋顶工——劳力型热射病
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1505 hrs on the fourth day of a heat wave, 38 degrees C in the shade. Code 3 to a residential re-roofing job in Kelowna. A 34-year-old roofer has become confused and collapsed on the driveway. Coworkers have moved him into the shade of the garage. Kelowna General Hospital is 14 minutes away; the nearest PCP car is 18 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 15:05，热浪第四天，阴凉处气温 38 摄氏度。Code 3 前往 Kelowna 一处住宅翻新屋顶的工地。一名 34 岁屋顶工出现意识混乱并倒在车道上。工友已把他移到车库的阴凉处。Kelowna General 医院距离 14 分钟车程；最近的 PCP 车 18 分钟后到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: he has been on the roof since 0700 and stopped sweating about an hour ago according to a coworker. He is awake but 'talking nonsense'. Nobody saw him fall from any height - he walked down the ladder and collapsed on the driveway.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：他从 07:00 起就在屋顶上作业，一名工友说他大约一小时前就不出汗了。他还清醒，但「说胡话」。没有人看到他从高处坠落——他是自己爬下梯子后倒在车道上的。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan cooling equipment before arrival: cold packs, water, sheets or towels that can be soaked, the ambulance air conditioning set to maximum cold, oxygen, blood glucose meter and thermometer
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并在到场前规划降温装备：冰袋、水、可以浸湿的床单或毛巾、救护车空调开到最冷、氧气、血糖仪和体温计。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the pattern from dispatch: prolonged exertion in extreme heat, altered mental status, and reported cessation of sweating - this is heat stroke until proven otherwise, and heat stroke is an unstable finding
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息识别出这个组合：极端高温下长时间劳作、精神状态改变、据报已停止出汗——在排除之前一律按热射病对待，而热射病本身就是官方列出的不稳定表现。

expected.actionEn: Pre-cool the patient compartment on the way so the ambulance itself becomes a cooling tool on arrival
expected.actionZh: 在路上就把患者舱预先降温，让救护车本身一到场就是一件降温工具。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Open garage, shaded, still very hot - about 33 degrees C inside. Hazards: a ladder against the eaves and roofing debris on the driveway; the crew has stopped work. One patient: a 34-year-old man supine on a tarp, in long pants, a long-sleeved shirt, boots and a hard hat, skin flushed and dark red. He is moving restlessly and answering questions incorrectly. Two coworkers are with him; one has a jug of ice water from the cooler.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：敞开的车库内有阴凉，但依然很热——室内约 33 摄氏度。危险源：屋檐下靠着一把梯子，车道上散落着屋顶施工碎料；工班已停工。只有一名患者：34 岁男性仰卧在防水布上，穿着长裤、长袖衬衫、工靴，戴着安全帽，皮肤潮红发暗。他躁动不安，回答问题答非所问。两名工友在旁，其中一人手里拿着从冷藏箱取出的一壶冰水。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (ladder, roofing debris - work stopped), environment (extreme heat, this is the mechanism), nature of illness (heat illness after prolonged exertion), people (one patient plus two coworkers who can help cool him) and resources
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（梯子、屋顶碎料——已停工）、环境（极端高温，这正是致病机制）、疾病性质（长时间劳作后的中暑）、人员（一名患者加两名可以协助降温的工友）以及所需资源。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜。

expected.actionEn: First look: young man, flushed dark red, restless and answering incorrectly, over-dressed for the conditions - start stripping the clothing as part of the first hands-on approach
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：年轻男性，皮肤潮红发暗，躁动、答非所问，衣着完全不适应当前气温——上手的第一步就应包括去除衣物。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: eyes open, restless, pulls at his shirt, answers 'Tuesday... shingles... I'm fine' and cannot say his own address; obeys simple commands inconsistently. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway patent but he needs repositioning as he thrashes; respirations 30, shallow, clear air entry both sides; radial pulse 138, weak, regular; skin very hot to touch, flushed dark red, still slightly moist from earlier sweating - NOTE: hot dry skin is NOT required for the diagnosis in exertional heat stroke. RAPID BODY SURVEY: no head injury, no neck tenderness, moves all four limbs, no deformity, no bleeding; he did not fall from height. SpO2 96% on room air. UNSTABLE: heat stroke and altered LOC are both listed unstable findings.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：睁着眼，躁动不安，扯自己的衬衫，回答「星期二……瓦片……我没事」，说不出自己家的地址；对简单指令时听时不听。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，但他挣扎时需要反复调整体位；呼吸 30 次/分、浅表，双肺进气清晰；桡动脉搏动 138 次/分，细弱、规则；皮肤摸上去极烫，潮红发暗，因先前出汗仍略有湿润——注意：劳力型热射病并不要求皮肤「又热又干」才能诊断。快速体格检查：无头部外伤，颈部无压痛，四肢均能活动，无畸形，无出血；他并没有从高处坠落。室内空气 SpO2 96%。不稳定判定：热射病与意识改变都是官方列出的不稳定表现。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: awake but disoriented and restless - central nervous system dysfunction is what separates heat stroke from heat exhaustion
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：清醒但定向力障碍、躁动——中枢神经系统功能障碍正是热射病区别于热衰竭的关键。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and keep repositioning it as he thrashes; suction available
expected.actionZh: 评估气道，并在他挣扎时持续维持气道通畅；备好吸引器。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: 30 and shallow, auscultate both sides
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：30 次/分、浅表，双侧听诊。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: weak radial pulse of 138 - heat stroke produces a distributive and hypovolemic shock picture
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动 138 次/分、细弱——热射病同时表现为分布性和低血容量性休克。

expected.actionEn: Perform a full rapid body survey - a collapse on a work site still needs an injury sweep even when the cause looks medical
expected.actionZh: 完成完整的快速体格检查——即便病因看起来是内科性的，工地上倒地仍必须做一遍外伤排查。

expected.actionEn: Identify heat stroke as the life threat and begin cooling immediately as a primary survey intervention - rapid cooling is the indicated intervention for hyperthermia and it starts now, not after the secondary survey
expected.actionZh: 把热射病认定为致命威胁，并把快速降温作为初级评估中的干预立即启动——高热的指征性干预就是快速降温，它现在就要开始，而不是等二次评估之后。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: very hot, flushed dark red, slightly moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：极烫，潮红发暗，略带湿润。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen for the altered LOC and shock picture, titrated to keep SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 因意识改变和休克表现给氧，滴定维持 SpO2 在 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Position supine to support the blood pressure, out of the sun, with dignity maintained while the clothing comes off
expected.actionZh: 取仰卧位以支撑血压，移离日晒；脱除衣物时注意保护患者尊严。

phases.infoEn: Decision point and the timing trap of this scenario. Heat stroke is an unstable finding, so this is a Rapid Transport Category call. BUT the guideline also requires cooling efforts to continue for a MINIMUM of 10 minutes before beginning conveyance, and the most aggressive available cooling method must then continue during transport. The right answer is not 'scoop and run' and not 'stay and play': cool aggressively from the first minute, run the history and vitals while cooling, leave for hospital once at least 10 minutes of cooling has been delivered, and keep cooling all the way in with the ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold.
phases.infoZh: 决策点，也是这一场的时序陷阱。热射病属不稳定表现，因此本场属 RTC。但考纲同时要求：开始转运之前，降温措施至少要持续 10 分钟，之后还必须用现有最强的降温手段在转运途中继续降温。正确答案既不是「抬起就跑」，也不是「留在现场慢慢做」：从第一分钟就开始积极降温，一边降温一边采集病史和生命体征，累计降温满 10 分钟后即出发，路上把救护车空调开到最冷继续降温直到到院。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC out loud: heat stroke with an altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 明确口头判定为 RTC：热射病合并意识改变。

expected.actionEn: State and follow the timing rule: continue cooling for a minimum of 10 minutes before beginning conveyance, using that time for the history and the first set of vitals rather than standing still
expected.actionZh: 说出并执行时序规则：开始转运前降温至少持续 10 分钟，并利用这段时间采集病史和第一组生命体征，而不是干等着。

expected.actionEn: Continue the most aggressive available cooling during transport - the ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold plus soaked towels to head, torso and thighs
expected.actionZh: 转运途中继续使用现有最强的降温手段——救护车空调开到最冷，并在头部、躯干和大腿覆盖浸湿的毛巾。

expected.actionEn: Do not delay departure to wait for the PCP car - cooling is the treatment and an EMR can deliver all of it
expected.actionZh: 不要为了等 PCP 车而推迟出发——降温就是治疗，而 EMR 完全可以独立完成全部降温措施。

phases.infoEn: COWORKERS ANSWER, patient contributes fragments: on the roof since 0700 with two short breaks; he drank 'maybe one bottle of water all day' and a large energy drink at lunch; the crew has worked through four days of the heat wave; he complained of a headache and cramps at about 1300, seemed vague by 1400, stopped sweating around 1400, then came down the ladder and collapsed on the driveway at about 1455 - he did NOT fall. No seizure witnessed. No drugs or alcohol known. PMHx: none known, no diabetes. Meds: none, no supplements other than the energy drink. Allergies: unknown - the crew does not know. LOI: half a sandwich at 1200, minimal fluid.
phases.infoZh: 工友回答，患者偶尔冒出零星几句：他从 07:00 起就在屋顶上，中途只休息过两次；「一整天大概只喝了一瓶水」，午饭时喝了一大罐能量饮料；整个工班已经在这波热浪里连干四天。他约 13:00 诉头痛和肌肉抽筋，14:00 左右显得反应迟钝，同时不再出汗，随后自己爬下梯子，约 14:55 倒在车道上——他没有坠落。无人目击抽搐。无已知吸毒或饮酒。既往史：无已知疾病，无糖尿病。用药：无，除能量饮料外无任何补剂。过敏史：不详——工友也不知道。最后进食：12:00 吃了半个三明治，饮水极少。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: confusion and collapse after prolonged work in extreme heat
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：极端高温下长时间作业后出现意识混乱并倒地。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C: hours of exposure and exertion, fluid intake, clothing, when symptoms started, when sweating stopped, whether anyone saw a fall or a seizure, and how long he has been down
expected.actionZh: 采集现病史：暴露和劳作时长、饮水量、着装、症状何时出现、何时停止出汗、有没有人看到坠落或抽搐，以及倒地已多久。

expected.actionEn: Ask about the earlier headache and cramps and score them - these were the warning signs of heat illness hours before the collapse
expected.actionZh: 追问并评估此前的头痛和肌肉抽筋——那是倒地前数小时就已出现的中暑预警信号。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history from the coworkers, and document that it is second-hand
expected.actionZh: 向工友采集既往病史，并注明这是转述来的信息。

expected.actionEn: Medications and any supplements or stimulants, including the energy drink
expected.actionZh: 用药史以及任何补剂或兴奋类饮品，包括那罐能量饮料。

expected.actionEn: Allergies - document as unknown rather than assuming none
expected.actionZh: 过敏史——如实记录为「不详」，不要想当然写成「无」。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake, quantifying the fluid deficit across the shift
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮，并量化整个班次的液体缺口。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (taken while cooling is already running, completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 11 (E3 V3 M5); BP 96/54; pulse 138 weak regular; respirations 30 shallow; skin very hot, flushed dark red, slightly moist; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 96% on room air; BGL 5.1 mmol/L - MANDATORY here, because the guideline requires a blood glucose in the initial vital signs of any heat patient with a decreased LOC; temperature 41.2 C. As a priority patient the second set is due 7-8 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（在降温已经开始的同时测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 11（E3 V3 M5）；血压 96/54；脉搏 138 次/分，细弱规则；呼吸 30 次/分、浅表；皮肤极烫、潮红发暗、略湿；瞳孔等大有反应；室内空气 SpO2 96%；血糖 5.1 mmol/L——本例为必查项，因为考纲规定意识水平下降的中暑患者首组生命体征必须包含血糖；体温 41.2 摄氏度。作为优先患者，第二组生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character with both lung fields auscultated
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双侧肺野。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on - and do not let the residual moisture talk you out of heat stroke
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤——不要因为皮肤还有点湿就否定热射病。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded and monitored
expected.actionZh: 记录并持续监测 SpO2。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - explicitly required in the initial vital signs of a heat patient with a decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 血糖——考纲明确要求：意识水平下降的中暑患者首组生命体征必须含血糖。

expected.actionEn: Temperature measured and repeated - it is the number that drives the cooling and the endpoint
expected.actionZh: 测量并反复复测体温——降温力度和终点都由这个数字决定。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, mostly from the coworkers. General - fit, works outdoors year round, no recent illness; CNS - headache since 1300, confusion, no witnessed seizure, restlessness; respiratory - no cough or SOB; cardiovascular - no chest pain reported, heart racing; GI/GU - nauseated earlier, no vomiting, has not urinated all afternoon; integumentary - dark red flushed skin, sunburn on the forearms; musculoskeletal - leg cramps at 1300; endocrine - no known diabetes; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，在途中进行，信息主要来自工友。全身情况——身体健康，常年户外作业，近期无疾病；中枢神经——13:00 起头痛、意识混乱、躁动，无人目击抽搐；呼吸——无咳嗽、无气促；心血管——未诉胸痛，自觉心跳很快；消化/泌尿——先前恶心，无呕吐，整个下午没有排尿；皮肤——皮肤潮红发暗，前臂晒伤；肌肉骨骼——13:00 出现小腿抽筋；内分泌——无已知糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (headache, confusion and restlessness define heat stroke rather than heat exhaustion)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（头痛、意识混乱和躁动正是热射病而非热衰竭的定义性表现）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (no urine output all afternoon quantifies the dehydration)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（整个下午无尿，可用来量化脱水程度）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal (the 1300 cramps were the first stage of heat illness)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统（13:00 的抽筋就是中暑的第一阶段）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe carried out WHILE cooling continues: head/neck - no injury from the collapse, mucous membranes very dry, no neck tenderness; chest - equal air entry, no crackles; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - inspected during the transfer, skin hot everywhere; upper extremities - sunburn on the forearms, weak radial pulses bilaterally, no tremor at rest; lower extremities - calf muscles tight and tender from cramps, pedal pulses weak but present, all limbs move.
phases.infoZh: 在降温持续进行的同时完成从头到脚检查：头颈——倒地未造成外伤，黏膜非常干燥，颈部无压痛；胸部——双肺进气对称，无湿啰音；腹部——柔软，无压痛；背部——转移时视诊，全身皮肤均发烫；上肢——前臂晒伤，双侧桡动脉搏动细弱，静息无震颤；下肢——小腿肌肉因抽筋而紧绷压痛，足背动脉搏动细弱但可及，四肢均能活动。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined, including mucous membranes as a hydration marker
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部，包括把黏膜干湿作为脱水指标。

expected.actionEn: Chest auscultated at all six sites
expected.actionZh: 胸部六个听诊点全部听诊。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the transfer
expected.actionZh: 转移时检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with pulses and skin condition documented
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查并记录脉搏和皮肤情况。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with cramping muscles and pedal pulses documented
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查并记录肌肉抽筋和足背动脉搏动。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE - COOLING IS THE TREATMENT and every part of it is within EMR practice: move him to the coolest available area; remove ALL clothing while protecting his dignity with a sheet that can then be soaked; begin convective cooling with air conditioning on maximum cold in conjunction with everything else; apply cold wet towels to the head, torso and thighs for evaporative cooling; immerse the feet and lower legs in a basin of ice water if one can be improvised - the coworkers' cooler and water jug make this possible; continue cooling for a minimum of 10 minutes before beginning conveyance, then keep the most aggressive available method running all the way to hospital. Oxygen to SpO2 94% or above, supine positioning, airway watched with suction ready, and repeated temperature checks. DO NOT give oral fluids to a patient who cannot protect his airway, and do not give oral analgesia or antipyretics - antipyretics do not work on heat stroke because the problem is heat load, not a raised set point. OUT OF EMR SCOPE and verbalized: intravenous fluid replacement, which the PCP or the hospital provides.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围——降温本身就是治疗，而且每一步都在 EMR 的执业范围内：把他移到现有最凉爽的地方；脱去全部衣物，同时用床单遮挡保护尊严（这条床单之后可以打湿使用）；开启对流降温，把空调开到最冷并与其他措施同时进行；在头部、躯干和大腿覆盖冷湿毛巾以促进蒸发散热；如能就地取材，把双足和小腿浸入冰水盆——工友的冷藏箱和水壶正好可以做到；开始转运前降温至少持续 10 分钟，之后用现有最强的手段一路降温到医院。给氧维持 SpO2 94% 及以上，仰卧位，盯住气道并备好吸引器，反复复测体温。不要给无法保护气道的患者口服液体，也不要给口服镇痛药或退热药——退热药对热射病无效，因为问题在于热负荷而不是体温调定点升高。超出 EMR 范围、需要口头说明的：静脉补液，由 PCP 或医院提供。

expected.actionEn: Move him to the coolest available area and remove all clothing, using a sheet to preserve dignity
expected.actionZh: 把他移到现有最凉爽的地方并脱去全部衣物，用床单遮挡以保护尊严。

expected.actionEn: Apply cold wet towels to the head, torso and thighs and run convective cooling with the air conditioning on maximum cold, combining methods rather than using one alone
expected.actionZh: 在头部、躯干和大腿覆盖冷湿毛巾，同时把空调开到最冷做对流降温——多种方法叠加，而不是只用一种。

expected.actionEn: Improvise ice-water immersion of the feet and lower legs using the coworkers' cooler, and delegate the coworkers to help
expected.actionZh: 利用工友的冷藏箱就地做双足和小腿的冰水浸泡，并分派工友协助。

expected.actionEn: Deliver a minimum of 10 minutes of cooling before beginning conveyance, and continue the most aggressive available cooling throughout transport
expected.actionZh: 开始转运前完成至少 10 分钟降温，并在转运全程继续使用现有最强的降温手段。

expected.actionEn: Withhold oral fluids and oral antipyretics: he cannot reliably protect his airway, and antipyretics do not lower temperature in heat stroke
expected.actionZh: 不给口服液体和口服退热药：他无法可靠保护气道，而且退热药对热射病降不下体温。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that intravenous fluid replacement is outside EMR scope and does not justify delaying cooling or transport
expected.actionZh: 口头说明静脉补液超出 EMR 范围，并且不构成推迟降温或转运的理由。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, interventions and TEMPERATURE after every intervention and at least every 5 minutes. Set 2 (en route, 8 minutes after set 1, after roughly 12 minutes of cooling): GCS 13 (E4 V4 M5); BP 104/62; pulse 124 stronger; respirations 26; skin still hot but less flushed; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 97% on oxygen; temperature 39.4 C - down 1.8 degrees and cooling continues. He is improving. Watch for shivering as he cools, and for a seizure, which is common in heat stroke - if he seizes, protect the airway, keep cooling and do not restrain his limbs.
phases.infoZh: 每次干预后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC、已做的处置和体温。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 8 分钟，累计降温约 12 分钟）：GCS 13（E4 V4 M5）；血压 104/62；脉搏 124 次/分，较前有力；呼吸 26 次/分；皮肤仍烫但潮红减轻；瞳孔等大有反应；吸氧下 SpO2 97%；体温 39.4 摄氏度——已下降 1.8 度，降温继续。他在好转。降温过程中要留意寒战，也要警惕抽搐（热射病中很常见）——一旦抽搐，保护气道、继续降温，不要按住他的四肢。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each intervention and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次干预之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes with a repeat temperature, and interpret the falling temperature and improving GCS out loud
expected.actionZh: 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征并复测体温，口头解读体温下降和 GCS 回升的趋势。

expected.actionEn: Keep cooling through transport and re-check the temperature repeatedly - improvement is not a reason to stop cooling
expected.actionZh: 转运全程继续降温并反复复测体温——病情好转不是停止降温的理由。

expected.actionEn: State the seizure plan: protect the airway, keep cooling, do not restrain the limbs, and reassess breathing afterwards
expected.actionZh: 说出抽搐预案：保护气道、继续降温、不要按住四肢，发作后复评呼吸。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the emergency department en route that a heat stroke with an altered LOC is coming in and cooling is under way. The hand-off must state the exposure and exertion history, the initial temperature and the temperature trend, the cooling methods used and for how long, and the blood glucose. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中向急诊预报：一名意识改变的热射病患者即将到达，降温已在进行中。交接必须说明暴露与劳作史、初始体温及体温变化趋势、使用了哪些降温方法及持续时长，以及血糖值。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification of heat stroke with an altered LOC and active cooling
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：热射病伴意识改变，正在积极降温中。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off with the temperature trend and the cooling methods and duration
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接，包含体温变化趋势以及降温方法和持续时间。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR 书面记录。

vitalsSets.timeHint: baseline while cooling is already running, within 3 minutes
vitalsSets.skin: very hot, flushed dark red, slightly moist

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 8 minutes later, after ~12 minutes of cooling - improving

criticalPitfallsEn: Loading and leaving immediately because it is an RTC call - the guideline requires a minimum of 10 minutes of cooling before conveyance begins, and cooling is the treatment for this patient
The opposite error: cooling on scene for 25 minutes and blowing the transport window - cool aggressively, do the history and vitals while cooling, and go once the 10 minutes are delivered
Ruling out heat stroke because the skin is still slightly moist - hot dry skin is not required in exertional heat stroke; the diagnosis is heat exposure plus central nervous system dysfunction
Leaving his clothing and boots on, or cooling with a single method - the guideline calls for the most aggressive combination available
Skipping the blood glucose - it is explicitly required in the initial vital signs of any heat patient with a decreased LOC
Giving oral fluids or oral antipyretics to a confused patient - the airway is at risk and antipyretics do not lower temperature in heat stroke
Stopping cooling once he starts talking sense - cooling continues to the hospital with repeated temperature checks
criticalPitfallsZh: 因为是 RTC 就立刻装车走人——考纲要求开始转运前至少降温 10 分钟，而降温正是这名患者的治疗本身。
反向错误：在现场降温 25 分钟、把转运窗口拖没了——正确做法是积极降温、同时完成病史和生命体征，满 10 分钟就出发。
因为皮肤还有点湿就否定热射病——劳力型热射病并不要求「皮肤又热又干」；诊断依据是高热暴露加中枢神经系统功能障碍。
不脱衣服不脱鞋，或者只用一种降温方法——考纲要求使用现有最强的组合手段。
漏测血糖——考纲明确规定意识水平下降的中暑患者首组生命体征必须含血糖。
给意识模糊的患者口服液体或口服退热药——气道有风险，而且退热药对热射病降不下体温。
看他说话变清楚了就停止降温——降温要一直做到医院，并反复复测体温。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Every element of definitive prehospital care here is EMR-level: recognition of heat stroke by exposure plus central nervous system dysfunction, moving him to the coolest area, complete undressing with dignity preserved, combined evaporative and convective cooling with soaked towels to head, torso and thighs plus maximum-cold air conditioning, improvised ice-water immersion of the feet and lower legs, a minimum of 10 minutes of cooling before conveyance with cooling continued all the way in, oxygen to 94% or above, supine positioning, airway watch with suction, a mandatory blood glucose, and repeated temperatures. Only intravenous fluid replacement sits outside EMR scope.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一场院前的确定性处置全都在 EMR 级别内：凭「高热暴露 + 中枢神经功能障碍」识别热射病；把他移到最凉爽处；在保护尊严的前提下完全脱衣；把浸湿毛巾覆盖头部、躯干和大腿的蒸发降温与空调开到最冷的对流降温叠加使用；就地取材做双足和小腿冰水浸泡；转运前至少降温 10 分钟并一路继续降温；给氧维持 94% 及以上；仰卧位；盯住气道并备吸引器；必查血糖；反复复测体温。唯一超出 EMR 范围的只有静脉补液。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry and considers fluid replacement for the signs and symptoms of dehydration - no urine output all afternoon, dry mucous membranes and a weak pulse of 138 after a shift with roughly one bottle of water. Cooling remains the priority and is identical at both levels; fluids are given en route without slowing the cooling.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊，并针对脱水的症状体征考虑补液——整个下午无尿、黏膜干燥、一个班次只喝了大约一瓶水且脉搏细弱达 138。降温仍是首要任务，两个级别完全一致；补液在途中进行，且不得因此放慢降温。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 34-year-old roofer who had been working on a roof since 0700 on the fourth day of the heat wave, 38 degrees in the shade, in long sleeves and long pants, with roughly one bottle of water all day. He had a headache and leg cramps at 1300, became vague and stopped sweating around 1400, then walked down the ladder and collapsed on the driveway at 1455 - no fall from height, no witnessed seizure. On our arrival he was awake but disoriented and restless, GCS 11 improving to 13. Initial temperature 41.2 with skin very hot, flushed dark red and slightly moist; pulse 138 weak, BP 96/54, resps 30 shallow, SpO2 96% on room air, blood glucose 5.1. We stripped him, applied cold wet towels to the head, torso and thighs, immersed his feet and lower legs in ice water from the crew's cooler, and ran the ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold. Cooling has been continuous for about 12 minutes; his temperature is now 39.4, pulse 124, BP 104/62, resps 26, SpO2 97% on oxygen. Cooling is still running. He has had no oral fluids and no antipyretics. History is second-hand from coworkers: no known medical history, no medications, allergies unknown, half a sandwich at noon.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 34 岁屋顶工，热浪第四天、阴凉处 38 摄氏度，他从 07:00 起穿着长袖长裤在屋顶作业，一整天大约只喝了一瓶水。13:00 出现头痛和小腿抽筋，14:00 左右反应变迟钝并停止出汗，随后自己爬下梯子，14:55 倒在车道上——无高处坠落，无人目击抽搐。我们到达时他清醒但定向力障碍、躁动不安，GCS 11 回升至 13。初始体温 41.2，皮肤极烫、潮红发暗、略带湿润；脉搏 138 细弱，血压 96/54，呼吸 30 浅表，室内空气 SpO2 96%，血糖 5.1。我们脱去他全部衣物，在头部、躯干和大腿覆盖冷湿毛巾，用工班冷藏箱的冰水浸泡他的双足和小腿，并把救护车空调开到最冷。降温已持续约 12 分钟；目前体温 39.4，脉搏 124，血压 104/62，呼吸 26，吸氧下 SpO2 97%。降温仍在继续。全程未给口服液体、未给退热药。病史由工友转述：无已知既往史，无用药，过敏史不详，中午吃了半个三明治。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Confusion and collapse after a full shift roofing in extreme heat
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: On the roof from 0700 in long sleeves on day four of a heat wave, 38 C in shade; roughly one bottle of water all shift plus an energy drink; headache and leg cramps 1300, vague and stopped sweating ~1400, walked down ladder and collapsed 1455; no fall from height, no witnessed seizure, no urine output all afternoon
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: None known (second-hand from coworkers), no diabetes
pcrKeyPoints.meds: None; large energy drink at lunch
treatments: Moved to coolest available area; all clothing removed with dignity preserved
Evaporative cooling with cold wet towels to head, torso and thighs
Convective cooling with ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold, pre-cooled en route to scene
Improvised ice-water immersion of feet and lower legs using the crew's cooler
Minimum 10 minutes of cooling delivered before conveyance; cooling continued throughout transport
Oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above; supine; suction at hand
No oral fluids and no antipyretics given - altered LOC and antipyretics ineffective in heat stroke
IV fluid replacement verbalized as out of EMR scope

GCS 11 improving to 13; restless, disoriented, obeying commands inconsistently
Pulse 138 weak improving to 124, BP 96/54 to 104/62, resps 30 to 26
