scenarios.titleEn: Type 1 Diabetic With Kussmaul Respirations - Suspected Diabetic Ketoacidosis
scenarios.titleZh: 1 型糖尿病青年出现 Kussmaul 呼吸——疑似糖尿病酮症酸中毒
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1120 hrs. Code 2 to a student residence at a college in Prince George. A 19-year-old man with type 1 diabetes has been vomiting since yesterday and his roommate says he is 'breathing weird'. University Hospital of Northern BC is 9 minutes away. No PCP car is available in town this morning.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 11:20，Code 2 前往 Prince George 一所学院的学生宿舍。一名 19 岁 1 型糖尿病男性从昨天起持续呕吐，室友说他「呼吸怪怪的」。University Hospital of Northern BC 距离 9 分钟车程。今天上午镇上没有可派的 PCP 车。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: he is awake and answering the phone questions himself. His insulin pump alarm has been going off since last night. He has had flu-like symptoms for three days.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：他神志清楚，能自己在电话里回答问题。他的胰岛素泵从昨晚起一直在报警。三天来一直有类似流感的症状。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan equipment: blood glucose meter, oxygen, suction, thermometer, emesis bags, blankets and the stretcher
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并规划装备：血糖仪、氧气、吸引器、体温计、呕吐袋、毯子和担架。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the pattern from dispatch: a type 1 diabetic with an insulin delivery failure, days of illness and vomiting, and abnormal breathing - suspect ketoacidosis before you walk in
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息识别出这个组合：1 型糖尿病、胰岛素输注故障、病了几天并持续呕吐、呼吸异常——进门之前就该怀疑酮症酸中毒。

expected.actionEn: Plan to bring the insulin pump and his glucose log with the patient - the receiving team needs to know how long insulin delivery has failed
expected.actionZh: 计划把胰岛素泵和他的血糖记录一并带走——接收团队需要知道胰岛素中断了多久。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Small dorm room, tidy enough, no hazards, one window open. One patient: a 19-year-old man sitting on the edge of his bed, leaning forward, breathing deeply and rapidly without any obvious struggle. A bucket beside him holds clear vomit. His roommate is present and worried. There is an insulin pump clipped to his waistband with a red alarm light flashing, and a glucose meter on the desk.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：宿舍房间不大但还算整洁，无危险源，一扇窗开着。只有一名患者：19 岁男性坐在床沿，身体前倾，呼吸又深又快，但看不出明显费力挣扎。他身边的桶里是清亮的呕吐物。室友在场，很担心。他腰带上别着一台胰岛素泵，红色报警灯在闪，书桌上放着一台血糖仪。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment, nature of illness (three days of illness with vomiting in a type 1 diabetic), people (one patient plus a roommate who can give collateral history) and resources (no PCP available - this is an EMR-only call)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无）、环境、疾病性质（1 型糖尿病患者病了三天并持续呕吐）、人员（一名患者加一位能提供旁证病史的室友）以及资源（本地没有 PCP——这是一场只能靠 EMR 的出车）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection - he is actively vomiting
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜——他正在反复呕吐。

expected.actionEn: First look: young man, alert, deep rapid unlaboured breathing, dry lips, sunken eyes, a flashing pump alarm - and note the sweet acetone smell on his breath
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：年轻男性，清醒，呼吸又深又快但不费力，口唇干裂，眼窝凹陷，胰岛素泵报警灯在闪——并注意到他呼气中的烂苹果样丙酮味。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and fully oriented, GCS 15, tired and thirsty. 'I've been throwing up since yesterday. My pump kept alarming and I couldn't get it working. I'm so thirsty.' EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway patent, speaking full sentences between deep breaths; respirations 32, DEEP and regular with no accessory muscle use and clear air entry both sides - this is Kussmaul respiration, a compensation for acidosis, not respiratory distress; radial pulse 118, present and regular, slightly thready; skin warm, dry, flushed, with poor turgor and very dry mucous membranes; sweet acetone odour on the breath. RAPID BODY SURVEY: no trauma, abdomen generally tender without guarding or rebound, no rash, no calf tenderness. SpO2 98% on room air. STABLE by the exam criteria: he is alert, radial pulses are present, there is no respiratory distress and no hypotension.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：清醒、定向力完整，GCS 15，疲惫且口渴。「我从昨天就一直在吐。泵一直报警，我怎么弄都弄不好。我渴得不行。」考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，在两次深呼吸之间能说完整句子；呼吸 32 次/分，深大而规则，无辅助呼吸肌参与，双肺进气清晰——这是 Kussmaul 呼吸，是对酸中毒的代偿，不是呼吸窘迫；桡动脉搏动 118 次/分，可及、规则，略显细弱；皮肤温暖、干燥、潮红，弹性差，黏膜非常干燥；呼气有烂苹果样丙酮味。快速体格检查：无外伤，腹部弥漫性压痛但无肌卫和反跳痛，无皮疹，小腿无压痛。室内空气 SpO2 98%。按考试标准判定为稳定：他神志清醒、桡动脉搏动可及、无呼吸窘迫、无低血压。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: alert and fully oriented, GCS 15 - and state that any drop from this is the finding that would change everything
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：清醒、定向力完整，GCS 15——并说明只要从这个水平往下掉，整场处置的性质就变了。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway; keep suction beside him because he is vomiting repeatedly
expected.actionZh: 评估气道；因他反复呕吐，把吸引器放在他身边随手可取。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing and interpret it correctly: 32 per minute, deep, regular, no accessory muscle use, clear air entry - Kussmaul respiration compensating for acidosis, NOT respiratory distress and NOT a reason for assisted ventilation
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸并正确解读：32 次/分，深大、规则，无辅助呼吸肌参与，进气清晰——这是代偿酸中毒的 Kussmaul 呼吸，不是呼吸窘迫，也不构成辅助通气的指征。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse 118, present and slightly thready with poor skin turgor - volume depletion from osmotic diuresis and vomiting
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动 118 次/分，可及但略细弱，皮肤弹性差——渗透性利尿加呕吐造成的血容量不足。

expected.actionEn: Perform the rapid body survey including a gentle abdominal examination - abdominal pain is common in ketoacidosis but a surgical abdomen must not be assumed away
expected.actionZh: 完成快速体格检查，包括轻柔的腹部检查——酮症酸中毒常伴腹痛，但不能就此想当然地排除外科急腹症。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: warm, dry, flushed, poor turgor, very dry mucous membranes
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：温暖、干燥、潮红，弹性差，黏膜非常干燥。

expected.actionEn: Reason the oxygen decision out loud: his SpO2 is 98% and his tachypnea is compensatory, not hypoxic, so oxygen is titrated only to keep SpO2 at or above 94% and is not required now - reassess with every set of vitals
expected.actionZh: 把给氧决策口头讲清楚：SpO2 98%，呼吸增快属代偿而非缺氧，因此只需按「维持 SpO2 94% 及以上」滴定，目前无需给氧——每组生命体征后都要重新评估。

expected.actionEn: Position of comfort, sitting or semi-reclined with an emesis bag and suction, ready to move him lateral if his LOC falls
expected.actionZh: 舒适体位：坐位或半卧位，备好呕吐袋和吸引器；一旦意识水平下降，立即改为侧卧位。

phases.infoEn: Decision point, and the judgement this scenario tests. He is genuinely unwell, but measure him against the unstable criteria: he is alert, his airway is his own, there is no respiratory distress or accessory muscle use, radial pulses are present, his systolic is above 90 and his skin is warm and dry rather than cool and clammy. He meets NONE of them, so this is a NON-RTC call: 30 minutes to be ready for transport, secondary survey completed on scene. Say the decision out loud AND say what would flip it instantly: any drop in LOC, a systolic below 90, loss of radial pulses, or the deep breathing slowing as he tires. Do not confuse non-RTC with unhurried - this patient is deteriorating on a timescale of hours.
phases.infoZh: 决策点，也是这一场真正考的判断力。他确实病得不轻，但要逐条对照不稳定标准：他神志清醒、气道自主可控、无呼吸窘迫和辅助呼吸肌参与、桡动脉搏动可及、收缩压高于 90、皮肤是温暖干燥而不是湿冷。他一条都不符合，因此属非 RTC：有 30 分钟完成打包，二次评估可以在现场做完。请把决策口头说出来，同时说出什么情况会立刻推翻它：意识水平任何下降、收缩压低于 90、桡动脉搏动消失，或者深大呼吸随着体力耗竭而变慢。但非 RTC 不等于可以慢悠悠——这名患者是在以「小时」为尺度持续恶化。

expected.actionEn: Correctly categorize as non-RTC and justify it against the unstable criteria one by one
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC，并逐条对照不稳定标准说明理由。

expected.actionEn: State the findings that would upgrade him immediately: falling LOC, systolic below 90, absent radial pulses, or slowing respirations from fatigue
expected.actionZh: 说出哪些发现会让他立刻升级：意识水平下降、收缩压低于 90、桡动脉搏动消失，或因体力耗竭而呼吸变慢。

expected.actionEn: Ready for transport within 30 minutes without dawdling, and take the insulin pump and glucose meter with the patient
expected.actionZh: 30 分钟内完成可转运准备、不拖沓，并把胰岛素泵和血糖仪一起带走。

phases.infoEn: PATIENT ANSWERS, roommate fills in: type 1 diabetes since age 11, on an insulin pump for three years. Three days of sore throat, fever and poor appetite; he 'ate almost nothing so I turned the pump down'. Yesterday afternoon the pump started alarming - the roommate says the infusion site looks red - and he could not fix it. Vomiting started yesterday evening, now more than ten times. Constant thirst, urinating large volumes all night, then hardly at all this morning. Abdominal ache 4 out of 10, generalized, no radiation. Blurred vision, weakness, no chest pain, no headache. He tested his glucose last night and it read 'HI'. PMHx: type 1 diabetes, one previous admission for ketoacidosis at 15. Meds: insulin by pump only. Allergies: none. LOI: sips of water this morning, nothing solid since yesterday morning.
phases.infoZh: 患者回答，室友补充：11 岁起患 1 型糖尿病，用胰岛素泵已经三年。三天来咽痛、发热、食欲很差；他说「我几乎没吃东西，就把泵的量调低了」。昨天下午泵开始报警——室友说输注部位看起来发红——他怎么也弄不好。昨晚开始呕吐，到现在已经吐了十多次。一直口渴，整夜大量排尿，今早却几乎没有尿。腹部隐痛 4/10，弥漫性，无放射。视物模糊、乏力，无胸痛，无头痛。昨晚测血糖，仪器显示「HI」（超出量程）。既往史：1 型糖尿病，15 岁时曾因酮症酸中毒住院一次。用药：仅泵入胰岛素。过敏史：无。最后进食：今早喝了几口水，固体食物自昨天早上起就没吃过。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: vomiting, thirst and abnormal breathing in a type 1 diabetic with a failed insulin pump
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：1 型糖尿病患者在胰岛素泵故障后出现呕吐、口渴和呼吸异常。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C: how long insulin delivery has been interrupted, the precipitating illness, vomiting frequency, thirst, urine output overnight and today, and the last glucose reading
expected.actionZh: 采集现病史：胰岛素输注中断了多久、诱发疾病是什么、呕吐次数、口渴程度、昨夜与今晨的尿量，以及最后一次血糖读数。

expected.actionEn: Score the abdominal pain and characterize it - abdominal pain is common in ketoacidosis but must still be described properly
expected.actionZh: 为腹痛评分并描述其性质——酮症酸中毒常有腹痛，但仍必须完整描述。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history, including the previous ketoacidosis admission
expected.actionZh: 既往病史，包括此前那次酮症酸中毒住院。

expected.actionEn: Medications - insulin by pump only, and when the last effective dose was actually delivered
expected.actionZh: 用药史——只有泵入胰岛素，并问清最后一次真正有效给药是什么时候。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (on scene, completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 104/68; pulse 118 regular, slightly thready; respirations 32, deep and regular; skin warm, dry, flushed, poor turgor; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; BGL reads HI - above the meter's range, so document it as 'above meter range' rather than inventing a number; temperature 37.6 C - indicated because a precipitating infection is suspected. As a non-priority patient the second set is due within 17-18 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（现场测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 104/68；脉搏 118 次/分，规则、略细弱；呼吸 32 次/分，深大而规则；皮肤温暖、干燥、潮红，弹性差；瞳孔等大有反应；室内空气 SpO2 98%；血糖仪显示 HI——超出量程，因此如实记录为「超出仪器量程」，绝不要自己编一个数字；体温 37.6 摄氏度——怀疑有诱发感染，故有测量指征。作为非优先患者，第二组生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation - 104/68 is above the hypotension threshold but low for a 19-year-old and must be trended
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压——104/68 虽在低血压阈值之上，但对 19 岁年轻人偏低，必须持续追踪。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character with both lung fields auscultated, and describe the pattern as deep and regular rather than laboured
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双侧肺野；把这一呼吸型态描述为「深大而规则」而不是「费力」。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on including turgor and mucous membranes
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤，包括皮肤弹性和黏膜干湿。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded - and not used as evidence that the breathing is fine, because a normal saturation does not exclude a severe metabolic acidosis
expected.actionZh: 记录 SpO2——但不能拿它当作「呼吸没问题」的证据，因为血氧正常并不能排除严重的代谢性酸中毒。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose measured and documented honestly as above the meter's range
expected.actionZh: 测量血糖并如实记录为「超出仪器量程」。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated because an infection appears to have precipitated this episode
expected.actionZh: 体温——本次发作很可能由感染诱发，故有测量指征。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, on scene since this is a non-priority patient. General - well controlled until this illness, three days of sore throat and fever; CNS - weak and tired, no confusion, no headache, no focal weakness; respiratory - no cough, no chest pain on breathing, breathing 'feels like I can't get enough air' although it is not laboured; cardiovascular - heart pounding, no chest pain; GI/GU - vomiting more than ten times, generalized abdominal ache, huge urine volumes overnight then almost none this morning; integumentary - dry skin, red and tender pump infusion site on the abdomen; musculoskeletal - generalized weakness and leg cramps; endocrine - type 1 diabetes with a failed pump for about 18 hours; EENT - sore throat, blurred vision.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，因属非优先患者可在现场完成。全身情况——这次生病之前血糖控制良好，三天来咽痛发热；中枢神经——乏力疲倦，无意识混乱，无头痛，无局灶性无力；呼吸——无咳嗽，呼吸时无胸痛，自觉「怎么吸都不够气」，但看起来并不费力；心血管——心跳很重，无胸痛；消化/泌尿——呕吐十多次，弥漫性腹部隐痛，昨夜尿量极大而今早几乎无尿；皮肤——皮肤干燥，腹部胰岛素泵输注部位发红压痛；肌肉骨骼——全身乏力，小腿抽筋；内分泌——1 型糖尿病，泵故障已约 18 小时；眼耳鼻喉——咽痛，视物模糊。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (no confusion yet - this is the system to watch)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（目前尚无意识混乱，但这正是最需要盯住的系统）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (air hunger without laboured breathing is the classic ketoacidosis description)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统（「空气饥饿感」却不费力，正是酮症酸中毒的典型描述）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (the swing from polyuria overnight to almost no urine this morning quantifies the volume loss)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（从昨夜多尿到今晨几乎无尿的转变，可用来量化失水量）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (inspect the pump infusion site - a red tender site explains the insulin failure)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤（检查泵的输注部位——发红压痛正好解释了胰岛素为什么没进去）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine (how long insulin delivery has been interrupted is the key number)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统（胰岛素中断了多久是最关键的一个数字）。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe on scene: head/neck - very dry lips and tongue, sunken eyes, sweet acetone odour on the breath, throat red, neck supple; chest - clear and equal air entry, deep regular respirations, no accessory muscle use; abdomen - soft, generally tender without guarding or rebound, red tender pump site in the left lower quadrant, bowel sounds present; back - nil; upper extremities - skin tenting on the forearm, radial pulses present bilaterally, capillary refill 3 seconds; lower extremities - calf cramping, pedal pulses present, no swelling and no tenderness suggesting clot.
phases.infoZh: 现场从头到脚检查：头颈——口唇和舌面非常干燥，眼窝凹陷，呼气有烂苹果样丙酮味，咽部充血，颈部柔软；胸部——双肺进气清晰对称，呼吸深大而规则，无辅助呼吸肌参与；腹部——柔软，弥漫性压痛但无肌卫和反跳痛，左下腹泵输注部位发红压痛，肠鸣音存在；背部——无异常；上肢——前臂皮肤捏起后回弹缓慢，双侧桡动脉搏动可及，毛细血管再充盈 3 秒；下肢——小腿抽筋，足背动脉搏动可及，无肿胀、无提示血栓的压痛。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined, including mucous membranes and the breath odour
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部，包括黏膜情况和呼气气味。

expected.actionEn: Chest auscultated at all six sites to confirm the lungs are clear - the tachypnea is metabolic, not pulmonary
expected.actionZh: 胸部六个听诊点全部听诊以确认肺部清晰——呼吸增快源于代谢，不是肺部问题。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants, including inspection of the pump infusion site
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查，并查看胰岛素泵的输注部位。

expected.actionEn: Back examined
expected.actionZh: 检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with skin turgor and capillary refill documented as dehydration markers
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查，并把皮肤弹性和毛细血管再充盈作为脱水指标记录下来。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with pedal pulses documented
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查并记录足背动脉搏动。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call is deliberately narrow, and knowing that is the point: measure the blood glucose, keep the airway clear with suction and an emesis bag, position him upright or lateral, oxygen only if the SpO2 falls below 94%, keep him warm, and transport with everything documented. THE GLUCOSE TRAP: the Diabetic Emergencies protocol treats hypoglycemia below 4.0 mmol/L. His glucose is above the meter's range, so oral glucose and glucagon are both absolutely wrong here - giving either would be initiating a protocol without indications. THE FLUID TRAP: he is profoundly dehydrated and the treatment is intravenous fluid, which is outside EMR scope; do not give him oral fluids to drink while he is vomiting repeatedly. THE ANALGESIA TRAP: rule out the contraindications out loud before considering anything for the abdominal ache - he cannot keep oral medication down, and Entonox is cautioned in shock and abdominal distension. Withhold and say why. Also evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms, as the protocol requires for any diabetic emergency.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车 EMR 的授权范围刻意很窄，而「知道自己能做什么、不能做什么」正是这一场的考点：测血糖，用吸引器和呕吐袋保持气道清洁，取坐位或侧卧位，只有 SpO2 跌破 94% 才给氧，注意保暖，然后转运并把一切记录在案。血糖陷阱：糖尿病急症方案针对的是血糖低于 4.0 mmol/L 的低血糖。他的血糖已超出仪器量程，因此口服葡萄糖和 glucagon 在这里都是彻底错误的——给任何一种都属于「无指征启动处置方案」。补液陷阱：他严重脱水，真正的治疗是静脉补液，而这超出 EMR 范围；也不要让一个反复呕吐的患者大口喝水。镇痛陷阱：在考虑给腹痛用任何药之前，先把禁忌逐条口头排除——他根本留不住口服药，而 Entonox 在休克和腹部胀气时属慎用。请明确不给药并说明理由。此外，按糖尿病急症方案要求，还要评估有无卒中的症状体征。

expected.actionEn: Measure the blood glucose and correctly withhold oral glucose and glucagon with a reading above the meter's range - giving glucose to a hyperglycemic patient is initiating a protocol without indications
expected.actionZh: 测量血糖，并在读数超出量程时正确地不给口服葡萄糖和 glucagon——给高血糖患者补糖属于无指征启动处置方案。

expected.actionEn: Rule out and verbalize the analgesia contraindications before considering anything for the abdominal pain: he cannot retain oral medication while vomiting, and Entonox is cautioned in shock and abdominal distension
expected.actionZh: 在考虑给腹痛用药之前，先逐条排除并口头说明镇痛禁忌：他持续呕吐、留不住口服药，而 Entonox 在休克和腹部胀气时属慎用。

expected.actionEn: Evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms as the Diabetic Emergencies protocol requires
expected.actionZh: 按糖尿病急症方案的要求评估有无卒中的症状体征。

expected.actionEn: Airway management: emesis bag and suction within reach, positioned upright or lateral, with a stated plan to go fully lateral if the LOC falls
expected.actionZh: 气道管理：呕吐袋和吸引器放在伸手可及处，取坐位或侧卧位，并说明一旦意识下降就完全改为侧卧。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that intravenous fluid and insulin are outside EMR scope and are the reason he is going to hospital now rather than later
expected.actionZh: 口头说明静脉补液和胰岛素超出 EMR 范围，这正是他必须现在就去医院而不是再等等的原因。

expected.actionEn: Bring the insulin pump, the infusion set and the glucose meter with the patient and document the infusion site appearance
expected.actionZh: 把胰岛素泵、输注装置和血糖仪一并随患者带走，并记录输注部位的外观。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after every move and at regular intervals. Set 2 (en route, 16 minutes after set 1): GCS 15 still; BP 100/64; pulse 124; respirations 34, still deep and regular; skin warm, dry, poor turgor; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; temperature 37.6 C. He has vomited twice more. He is slowly worsening but has still not met any unstable criterion - keep him non-RTC, keep the airway protected, and update the hospital. Watch specifically for the deep breathing slowing down: a tiring ketoacidotic patient whose respiratory rate falls is decompensating and needs assisted ventilation, not reassurance.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动后并按规定间隔复评 ABC 和已做的处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 16 分钟）：GCS 仍为 15；血压 100/64；脉搏 124 次/分；呼吸 34 次/分，仍深大而规则；皮肤温暖干燥、弹性差；瞳孔等大有反应；室内空气 SpO2 98%；体温 37.6 摄氏度。途中又吐了两次。他在缓慢加重，但仍未达到任何不稳定标准——继续按非 RTC 处理，保护好气道，并向医院更新病情。要特别盯住深大呼吸是否变慢：酮症酸中毒患者一旦力竭、呼吸频率下降，就是失代偿，需要的是辅助通气而不是安慰。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each move and at regular intervals
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后并按规定间隔复评 ABC 和已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 17-18 minutes and interpret the trend out loud as slow worsening that still does not meet unstable criteria
expected.actionZh: 17–18 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读趋势：在缓慢加重，但仍未达到不稳定标准。

expected.actionEn: State the decompensation trigger: if the deep respirations slow as he tires, that is respiratory failure and assisted ventilation with a BVM begins immediately
expected.actionZh: 说出失代偿触发条件：如果深大呼吸随体力耗竭而变慢，那就是呼吸衰竭，必须立即用 BVM 开始辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Protect the airway through repeated vomiting, with suction in hand and a plan to go lateral if the LOC falls
expected.actionZh: 在反复呕吐中保护气道：吸引器拿在手边，并预先想好一旦意识下降就改为侧卧。

phases.infoEn: Non-priority patient, but the hand-off is time-critical information: state how long insulin delivery has been interrupted, the precipitating illness, the vomiting count, the glucose reading above meter range, the respiratory pattern, and that no glucose or fluids were given. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 虽属非优先患者，但交接内容本身很关键：说明胰岛素中断了多久、诱发疾病是什么、呕吐次数、血糖超出仪器量程、呼吸型态，以及全程没有给过任何葡萄糖或液体。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Notify the receiving hospital of a suspected ketoacidosis so intravenous fluid and insulin can be prepared
expected.actionZh: 向接收医院预报疑似酮症酸中毒，以便提前准备静脉补液和胰岛素。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off including the duration of insulin interruption, the glucose reading and the respiratory pattern
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接，包含胰岛素中断时长、血糖读数和呼吸型态。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes, documenting the glucose as above meter range rather than a guessed number
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，血糖如实记为「超出量程」而不是随手填一个猜测值。

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 16 minutes later - slowly worsening, still no unstable criteria

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving oral glucose or glucagon because the patient is diabetic and unwell - the protocol treats hypoglycemia below 4.0 mmol/L, and this glucose is above the meter's range; initiating a protocol without indications is a 100% deduction
Never measuring the blood glucose at all in a diabetic emergency

Mistaking Kussmaul respiration for respiratory distress and starting assisted ventilation on an alert patient - deep regular breathing at 32 with no accessory muscle use and clear air entry is compensation, and taking it over would worsen his acidosis
The mirror-image error: missing the decompensation later when the deep breathing slows from fatigue - determining inadequate breathing and failing to intervene is a 100% deduction
Calling him RTC on gut feeling - he meets no unstable criterion, and a transport category error is a 25% deduction in either direction
Treating non-RTC as permission to be slow - he is deteriorating and the definitive treatment is only available at hospital
Giving oral fluids or oral analgesia to a patient who has vomited more than ten times
Inventing a glucose number when the meter reads HI - document what the meter actually displayed
criticalPitfallsZh: 因为「他是糖尿病人又不舒服」就给口服葡萄糖或 glucagon——该方案针对的是血糖低于 4.0 mmol/L 的低血糖，而他的血糖已超出仪器量程；无指征启动处置方案扣 100%。
糖尿病急症里干脆没测血糖。
把 Kussmaul 呼吸误当呼吸窘迫，对清醒患者开始辅助通气——32 次/分的深大规则呼吸、无辅助呼吸肌参与、进气清晰，那是代偿；接管他的呼吸只会让酸中毒更重。
反向错误：后期没有发现他力竭后深大呼吸变慢的失代偿——判断出呼吸不足却不干预，扣 100%。
凭感觉把他判成 RTC——他一条不稳定标准都不符合；转运分类判断错误，无论往哪个方向偏都扣 25%。
把非 RTC 当成「可以慢慢来」的许可——他在持续恶化，而确定性治疗只有医院才有。
给一个已经吐了十多次的患者口服液体或口服镇痛药。
血糖仪显示 HI 时自己编一个数字——必须如实记录仪器实际显示的内容。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: The EMR contribution here is judgement rather than intervention: measure the glucose and correctly do nothing with it, read the respiratory pattern as compensation rather than distress, keep the airway clean through repeated vomiting, apply the transport criteria honestly and arrive at non-RTC while still moving with purpose, withhold oral glucose, glucagon, oral fluids and oral analgesia with the reasons stated, take the pump and meter along, and hand over a history precise enough that the emergency department can start fluid and insulin immediately.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 在这一场的贡献是判断而不是操作：测了血糖并正确地什么都不给；把呼吸型态读作代偿而非窘迫；在反复呕吐中保持气道清洁；诚实地对照转运标准得出非 RTC 的结论，同时保持利落的节奏；口服葡萄糖、glucagon、口服液体和口服镇痛药全都不给并说明理由；带上胰岛素泵和血糖仪；最后交出一份精确到能让急诊立刻开始补液和用胰岛素的病史。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry and vascular access en route with a fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L, reassessed every 500 mL, for the volume depletion; ondansetron or dimenhydrinate may be considered for the vomiting. Insulin is not carried at either level - the acidosis is corrected in hospital.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊，并在途中建立静脉通路，针对血容量不足按 20 mL/kg（最多 2 升）快速补液、每 500 mL 复评一次；呕吐可考虑 ondansetron 或 dimenhydrinate。两个级别都不配备胰岛素——酸中毒要到医院才能纠正。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 19-year-old man with type 1 diabetes since age 11, on an insulin pump. He has had three days of sore throat and fever with very poor intake, and turned his pump down because he was not eating. Yesterday afternoon the pump began alarming and he could not fix it - the infusion site in his left lower quadrant is red and tender, so we believe he has had no effective insulin for roughly 18 hours. He has vomited more than ten times since last night, is extremely thirsty, passed large volumes of urine overnight and almost none this morning. He remains alert and fully oriented, GCS 15 throughout, with deep regular respirations of 32 rising to 34, no accessory muscle use and clear air entry - a Kussmaul pattern. Acetone odour on his breath. Pulse 118 rising to 124, BP 104/68 falling to 100/64, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 37.6, and his glucose meter reads HI - above its range. Skin is warm, dry and flushed with poor turgor and very dry mucous membranes. Abdomen is generally tender with no guarding. He met no unstable criteria so we transported non-RTC while monitoring closely. No glucose, no glucagon, no oral fluids and no analgesia were given - all withheld for stated reasons. We have his pump, infusion set and meter with us.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 19 岁男性，11 岁起患 1 型糖尿病，使用胰岛素泵。他咽痛发热已三天、进食极少，因为吃不下就自行把泵的输注量调低了。昨天下午泵开始报警，他修不好——左下腹的输注部位发红压痛，因此我们判断他已经约 18 小时没有获得有效胰岛素。他从昨晚起呕吐十多次，极度口渴，昨夜尿量很大而今早几乎无尿。他全程清醒、定向力完整，GCS 一直是 15，呼吸深大规则，由 32 次/分升至 34 次/分，无辅助呼吸肌参与、进气清晰——是 Kussmaul 型态。呼气有丙酮味。脉搏 118 升至 124，血压 104/68 降至 100/64，室内空气 SpO2 98%，体温 37.6，血糖仪显示 HI——超出量程。皮肤温暖、干燥、潮红，弹性差，黏膜非常干燥。腹部弥漫性压痛，无肌卫。他不符合任何不稳定标准，因此我们按非 RTC 转运并全程密切监测。全程未给葡萄糖、未给 glucagon、未给口服液体、未给镇痛药——每一项都有明确的不给理由。他的胰岛素泵、输注装置和血糖仪我们都带来了。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Vomiting, thirst and abnormal deep breathing in a type 1 diabetic with a failed insulin pump
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Three days of sore throat and fever with poor intake, pump rate reduced by the patient; pump alarming since yesterday afternoon with a red tender infusion site - no effective insulin for ~18 hours; vomited 10+ times since last night; polyuria overnight then almost anuric this morning; generalized abdominal ache 4/10; last self-test read HI; previous DKA admission at age 15
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Type 1 diabetes since age 11, one previous admission for ketoacidosis
treatments: Blood glucose measured - above meter range; oral glucose and glucagon correctly withheld
Airway kept clear with emesis bag and suction; positioned upright with a plan to go lateral if LOC fell
Oxygen not required at SpO2 98%; reassessed with every set of vitals, titration threshold 94% stated
Oral fluids and oral analgesia withheld with reasons stated; Entonox cautions verbalized
Stroke signs and symptoms evaluated as required by the Diabetic Emergencies protocol
Insulin pump, infusion set and glucose meter transported with the patient
Non-RTC transport with upgrade triggers stated and monitored; IV fluid and insulin verbalized as out of EMR scope
findings: GCS 15 throughout; alert and fully oriented
Kussmaul respirations 32 rising to 34 - deep, regular, no accessory muscle use, clear air entry
Pulse 118 to 124, BP 104/68 to 100/64, SpO2 98% RA, temperature 37.6
Glucose above meter range; acetone breath odour
Severe dehydration: dry mucous membranes, poor skin turgor, capillary refill 3 seconds, near-anuria this morning
Red tender pump infusion site in the left lower quadrant explaining the insulin failure
Generalized abdominal tenderness without guarding or rebound

scenarios.titleEn: Agitated and Hyperthermic in a Parkade - Suspected Stimulant Toxicity
scenarios.titleZh: 停车场内躁动伴高热——疑似兴奋剂中毒
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0340 hrs. Code 3 to an underground parkade in downtown Victoria. Security reports a man in his twenties shouting at cars, sweating heavily and refusing to sit down. Police are en route and will arrive before you. Royal Jubilee Hospital is 11 minutes away; a PCP car is 20 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 03:40，Code 3 前往 Victoria 市中心一处地下停车场。保安报告一名二十多岁的男子朝着车辆大喊大叫，大汗淋漓，不肯坐下。警方已出动，会比你们先到。Royal Jubilee 医院距离 11 分钟车程；PCP 车 20 分钟后到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: security says he has been there about 40 minutes and has become more agitated, not less. He has not threatened anyone but will not let anybody near him. Police ETA is 2 minutes ahead of yours.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：保安说他已经在那里待了约 40 分钟，而且越来越躁动、没有平静下来的迹象。他没有威胁任何人，但不让任何人靠近。警方预计比你们早 2 分钟到达。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and stage: do not enter the parkade until police confirm the scene is secure - your own safety is the first item of the rescue scene evaluation
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并原地待命：警方确认现场安全之前不进入停车场——救援现场评估的第一项就是自身安全。

expected.actionEn: Plan equipment for a possible medical cause of agitation: blood glucose meter, thermometer, oxygen, BVM, suction, and cooling supplies
expected.actionZh: 按「躁动可能有内科病因」规划装备：血糖仪、体温计、氧气、BVM、吸引器，以及降温物资。

expected.actionEn: Build the differential before contact: hypoglycemia, hypoxia, head injury, hyperthermia, infection, psychiatric illness, and drug toxicity - agitation is a presentation, not a diagnosis
expected.actionZh: 接触患者前先建立鉴别诊断：低血糖、缺氧、颅脑损伤、高热、感染、精神疾病和药物中毒——躁动只是一种表现，不是诊断。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Concrete parkade, poor lighting, cold air, a low ceiling and cars parked on both sides. Two police officers are already with the patient and tell you the scene is secure; he is not armed and they have found no weapons. One patient: a man in his mid-twenties, stripped to the waist despite the cold, pacing, sweating heavily, shouting at nobody in particular, then abruptly sitting on the floor. A backpack and a scattered set of belongings are nearby. Security stands back. There is one exit route behind you and it stays clear.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：混凝土停车场，照明很差，空气阴冷，层高低，两侧都停着车。两名警员已经在患者身边，告诉你现场安全；他没有携带武器，也没搜出任何凶器。只有一名患者：二十多岁男性，天气很冷却光着上身，来回踱步，大汗淋漓，对着空气大喊，随后突然坐到地上。旁边有一个背包和散落的个人物品。保安站在稍远处。你身后有一条撤离通道，且必须始终保持畅通。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (agitated patient, poor lighting, moving vehicles, unknown items in the belongings - never search a bag or pockets yourself), environment (cold parkade), nature of illness (agitation with heavy sweating), people (one patient, two officers, security) and resources
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（躁动患者、照明差、有车辆通行、随身物品中可能有不明物件——绝不自己去翻包或掏口袋）、环境（阴冷的停车场）、疾病性质（躁动伴大汗）、人员（一名患者、两名警员、保安）以及所需资源。

expected.actionEn: Confirm with police that the scene is secure before approaching, and position yourself with an unobstructed exit behind you throughout the call
expected.actionZh: 接近患者前先向警方确认现场安全，并在整场处置中始终让自己背后留有一条畅通的撤离通道。

expected.actionEn: First look: young man, undressed in the cold, flushed and drenched in sweat, restless and non-conversational, pupils obviously large - a sympathomimetic picture, and hyperthermia is the immediate threat
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：年轻男性，在寒冷环境中衣不蔽体，面色潮红、浑身湿透，躁动且无法正常交谈，瞳孔明显散大——典型的拟交感神经中毒表现，而高热是眼下最直接的威胁。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: eyes open, looking past you, answers in fragments - 'they're in the walls... don't touch me... I'm hot'. Does not know the day or where he is. Allows a wrist to be held for a pulse if you approach slowly, from the front, one crew member speaking, in a calm low voice. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway patent, speech clear but disorganized; respirations 28, unlaboured, clear air entry both sides; radial pulse 148, strong, regular; skin hot, flushed and drenched with sweat. RAPID BODY SURVEY, done as he permits: no head injury found, no neck tenderness, no needle marks on the arms, no wounds, no medical-alert jewelry, tremor in both hands. SpO2 97% on room air. UNSTABLE: altered LOC, and hyperthermia once the temperature is taken.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：睁着眼但目光越过你，只能零碎作答——「他们在墙里面……别碰我……我好热」。说不出今天是几号、也说不出自己在哪里。如果你放慢动作、从正面接近、只由一名组员用平缓低沉的声音说话，他会允许你握住手腕数脉搏。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，吐字清楚但内容混乱；呼吸 28 次/分、不费力，双肺进气清晰；桡动脉搏动 148 次/分，有力、规则；皮肤发烫、潮红、被汗浸透。在他允许的范围内完成快速体格检查：未发现头部外伤，颈部无压痛，双臂无针孔，无伤口，无医疗警示饰物，双手震颤。室内空气 SpO2 97%。不稳定判定：意识改变；测出体温后还要加上高热。

expected.actionEn: Use a calm de-escalating approach: one crew member speaks, approach slowly from the front, keep your distance and hands visible, give simple choices, and never crowd or corner him
expected.actionZh: 采用平静的降级沟通方式：只由一名组员说话，从正面缓慢接近，保持距离、双手可见，给他简单的选择，绝不围堵他或把他逼到角落。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: awake but disoriented with disorganized speech - this is an altered level of consciousness and it makes him an unstable patient
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：清醒但定向力障碍、言语混乱——这就是意识水平改变，据此他属于不稳定患者。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway; keep suction available
expected.actionZh: 评估气道；备好吸引器。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: 28 and unlaboured with clear air entry - specifically note that his respiratory drive is INTACT, which is the finding that rules naloxone out
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：28 次/分、不费力，进气清晰——特别指出他的呼吸驱动完好，这一点正是排除 naloxone 的依据。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: strong regular radial pulse of 148
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉搏动 148 次/分，有力、规则。

expected.actionEn: Perform the rapid body survey as far as he permits, looking specifically for occult head injury as an alternative cause of the agitation, and do not search his pockets or bag - that is a police function
expected.actionZh: 在他允许的范围内完成快速体格检查，重点排查可能导致躁动的隐匿性颅脑损伤；不要翻他的口袋或背包——那是警方的职责。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: hot, flushed and drenched with sweat - and recognize hyperthermia in an agitated patient as an immediate life threat requiring cooling
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤情况：发烫、潮红、被汗浸透——并认识到躁动患者出现高热是紧迫的致命威胁，必须立即降温。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen titrated to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, offered in the least confrontational way he will accept
expected.actionZh: 给氧滴定维持 SpO2 在 94% 及以上，并用他最不抵触的方式提供。

expected.actionEn: Position: let him sit or lie where he chooses as long as it is safe; never place or leave any patient face-down
expected.actionZh: 体位：只要安全，让他自己选择坐或躺；任何情况下都不得让患者俯卧或把他保持在面朝下的姿势。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Altered LOC is an unstable finding and his temperature is 39.6 - this is a Rapid Transport Category call, ready to load within 15 minutes. THE LEGAL AND SCOPE BOUNDARY: physical restraint is a police function, not an EMA intervention - you do not apply restraints, and no sedating medication exists in either the EMR or the PCP drug list. If police restrain him for everyone's safety, they must remain with the patient, he is never transported face-down, and his airway and breathing are monitored continuously and documented. Consent: he cannot consent because his condition has removed his capacity, so treatment proceeds on the basis of implied consent for a patient in a life-threatening state - document your reasoning. If he refuses transport outright, an agitated hyperthermic patient with an altered LOC is not competent to refuse; involve police and document.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。意识改变属不稳定表现，且体温已达 39.6——本场属 RTC，15 分钟内完成打包达到可装载状态。法规与授权范围的边界：身体约束是警方的职责，不属于 EMA 的干预手段——你不施加约束，而且 EMR 和 PCP 的药物目录中都没有任何镇静类药物。如果警方为了各方安全对他实施约束，警员必须全程随行，患者绝不可俯卧转运，并且必须持续监测并记录他的气道与呼吸。知情同意：他的病情已经使他丧失判断能力，无法有效同意，因此按「危及生命状态下的推定同意」继续救治——并把你的判断理由写进记录。若他明确拒绝转运：一名躁动、高热且意识改变的患者并不具备拒绝治疗的能力，此时应请警方介入并做好记录。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC out loud: altered LOC plus hyperthermia
expected.actionZh: 明确口头判定为 RTC：意识改变合并高热。

expected.actionEn: State the scope boundary: restraint is a police function, an EMA does not apply restraints, and there is no sedating medication at either EMR or PCP level
expected.actionZh: 说清授权边界：约束是警方的职责，EMA 不施加约束，而且 EMR 和 PCP 级别都没有任何镇静药物。

expected.actionEn: If police restrain him: never face-down, an officer travels with the patient, and airway, breathing and circulation are monitored continuously and documented
expected.actionZh: 若警方实施约束：绝不俯卧，须有警员随车，并持续监测和记录气道、呼吸与循环。

expected.actionEn: Address consent explicitly: he lacks capacity because of his condition, so treatment and transport proceed under implied consent, and the reasoning is documented
expected.actionZh: 明确处理知情同意问题：他因病情丧失判断能力，故按推定同意进行治疗和转运，并把判断依据记录在案。

phases.infoEn: COLLATERAL HISTORY - the patient gives only fragments. Security says he arrived about 0300 and has been getting worse. A friend arrives during the call and tells you: he has been awake for two days, used 'a lot' of crystal methamphetamine last night, has no history of seizures and is not diabetic, takes no prescription medication, and has never been like this before. She says he had a beer earlier but no opioids that she knows of - 'he doesn't touch that stuff'. No head injury witnessed, no fall. PMHx: none known. Meds: none. Allergies: unknown. LOI: unknown, and the friend says he has barely eaten in two days.
phases.infoZh: 旁证病史——患者本人只能给出零碎信息。保安说他约 03:00 到达，之后越来越糟。处置期间一名女性朋友赶到，告诉你：他已经两天没睡，昨晚用了「很多」冰毒，没有癫痫病史，也不是糖尿病，不服任何处方药，以前从没这样过。她说他早些时候喝过一瓶啤酒，但据她所知没有用阿片类——「他从不碰那个」。无人目击头部外伤，也没有摔倒。既往史：无已知疾病。用药：无。过敏史：不详。最后进食：不详，朋友说他两天来几乎没吃东西。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: acute agitation with hyperthermia and an altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：急性躁动，伴高热和意识改变。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C from collateral sources: what was taken, how much, by what route, when, whether anything else was used, how long he has been awake, whether there was any head injury, seizure or fall, and how his behaviour has trended
expected.actionZh: 向旁证采集现病史：用了什么、多少量、什么途径、什么时候用的、有没有混用其他物质、已经多久没睡、有无头部外伤/抽搐/摔倒，以及行为变化的趋势。

expected.actionEn: Take a non-judgemental substance history and document it as reported - the receiving team needs it and the way you ask determines whether you get it
expected.actionZh: 以不带评判的方式采集用药物质史，并按「据述」如实记录——接收团队需要这些信息，而你问的方式直接决定你能不能问到。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history from the friend, including any seizure or psychiatric history
expected.actionZh: 向朋友采集既往病史，包括癫痫和精神科病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史。

expected.actionEn: Allergies - document as unknown
expected.actionZh: 过敏史——如实记录为不详。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - unknown, with almost no food for two days
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮——不详，且两天来几乎没有进食。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (taken as he permits, completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 13 (E4 V3 M6); BP 158/98; pulse 148 strong regular; respirations 28 unlaboured; skin hot, flushed, drenched in sweat; pupils equal, dilated at about 6 mm and reactive - dilated pupils here point away from an opioid, whose hallmark is pinpoint pupils; SpO2 97% on room air; BGL 6.4 mmol/L - MANDATORY because his LOC is altered, and it excludes hypoglycemia as the cause of the agitation; temperature 39.6 C - the single most dangerous number on this call. As a priority patient the second set is due 7-8 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（在他允许的范围内测量，3 分钟内完成）：GCS 13（E4 V3 M6）；血压 158/98；脉搏 148 次/分，有力规则；呼吸 28 次/分、不费力；皮肤发烫、潮红、被汗浸透；瞳孔等大、散大约 6 毫米、对光反应存在——瞳孔散大这一点正好把阿片类排除在外，阿片中毒的标志是针尖样瞳孔；室内空气 SpO2 97%；血糖 6.4 mmol/L——因意识改变而属必查项，结果排除了低血糖作为躁动的原因；体温 39.6 摄氏度——这是本场最危险的一个数字。作为优先患者，第二组生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character with both lung fields auscultated - document that the respiratory drive is intact
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双侧肺野——记录呼吸驱动完好这一事实。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on - hot and drenched
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤——发烫且被汗浸透。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction; dilated and reactive pupils argue against an opioid
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应；瞳孔散大且有反应，与阿片类中毒不符。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded and monitored
expected.actionZh: 记录并持续监测 SpO2。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - mandatory in any patient with an altered LOC, and it excludes hypoglycemia as the cause of the agitation
expected.actionZh: 血糖——所有意识改变的患者都必须测，本例结果排除了低血糖导致躁动。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - the agitated hyperthermic patient is the one who dies, so this reading is not optional
expected.actionZh: 体温——躁动合并高热的患者才是真正会死的那个，所以这一项绝不可省。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, mostly from the friend. General - awake two days, barely eating; CNS - hallucinating, agitated, no witnessed seizure, no known head injury; respiratory - no cough or SOB; cardiovascular - heart racing, no chest pain reported although he cannot reliably report it; GI/GU - unknown intake, no vomiting seen; integumentary - drenched in sweat, no needle marks, some abrasions on the knuckles; musculoskeletal - tremor in both hands, muscles feel rigid to touch; endocrine - not diabetic per the friend; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，在途中进行，信息主要来自朋友。全身情况——已两天没睡，几乎不吃东西；中枢神经——有幻觉、躁动，无人目击抽搐，无已知头部外伤；呼吸——无咳嗽、无气促；心血管——自觉心跳很快，未诉胸痛（但他也无法可靠表达）；消化/泌尿——摄入情况不详，未见呕吐；皮肤——浑身是汗，无针孔，指关节有几处擦伤；肌肉骨骼——双手震颤，肌肉摸上去发硬；内分泌——据朋友说不是糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (hallucinations and agitation, and screen for an unwitnessed seizure)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（幻觉与躁动，并排查有无无人目击的抽搐）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (stimulant toxicity can cause cardiac ischemia even in young patients)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统（兴奋剂中毒即使在年轻人身上也可引发心肌缺血）。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (check for injection sites and injuries)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤（查看注射痕迹和外伤）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal (rigidity and sustained exertion drive the hyperthermia and muscle breakdown)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统（肌肉僵硬加持续用力，正是高热和肌肉损伤的来源）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe completed as he tolerates, in the ambulance with an officer present: head/neck - no scalp laceration or hematoma, no blood or fluid from the ears, pupils 6 mm and reactive, no neck tenderness; chest - clear and equal air entry, no injury; abdomen - soft, no guarding; back - inspected during the move to the cot, no injury; upper extremities - abrasions over the knuckles, tremor, no needle tracks, strong radial pulses; lower extremities - no injury, strong pedal pulses, muscles tight to palpation.
phases.infoZh: 在他能配合的范围内，于救护车内、有警员在场的情况下完成从头到脚检查：头颈——无头皮裂伤或血肿，耳道无血液或液体流出，瞳孔 6 毫米、对光反应存在，颈部无压痛；胸部——双肺进气清晰对称，无外伤；腹部——柔软，无肌卫；背部——移上担架床时视诊，无外伤；上肢——指关节擦伤，有震颤，无静脉注射痕迹，桡动脉搏动有力；下肢——无外伤，足背动脉搏动有力，肌肉触诊紧绷。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined for occult injury - a head injury can look exactly like drug-induced agitation
expected.actionZh: 检查头颈部有无隐匿性损伤——颅脑损伤看起来可以和药物性躁动一模一样。

expected.actionEn: Chest auscultated
expected.actionZh: 听诊胸部。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined
expected.actionZh: 检查腹部。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the move to the cot
expected.actionZh: 移上担架床时检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities examined for injection sites and injuries
expected.actionZh: 检查上肢有无注射痕迹和外伤。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities examined with pulses documented
expected.actionZh: 检查下肢并记录脉搏。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: scene safety and staging, verbal de-escalation, oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above, a mandatory blood glucose, temperature measurement, and ACTIVE COOLING for a temperature of 39.6 - cold packs to the neck, armpits and groin, cold wet towels to the head, torso and thighs, and the ambulance air conditioning on maximum cold; hyperthermia in an agitated patient is what turns this call fatal. THE NALOXONE TRAP: naloxone is indicated to reverse respiratory depression or a depressed mental status caused by actual or suspected narcotic use. This patient has a respiratory rate of 28, an SpO2 of 97% and 6 mm reactive pupils - there is no respiratory depression and no opioid picture, so naloxone is NOT indicated and giving it here would be initiating a protocol without indications. His glucose is 6.4, so oral glucose and glucagon are likewise not indicated - and he could not safely take anything by mouth anyway. Do not restrain him, do not search his belongings, do not transport anyone face-down, and never leave the crew alone with him in a moving ambulance if police have restrained him. Keep the interaction quiet, dim and unhurried - stimulation makes agitation worse.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：现场安全与待命、口头降级沟通、给氧滴定至 SpO2 94% 及以上、必测血糖、测体温，以及针对 39.6 摄氏度体温的主动降温——冰袋敷颈部、腋下和腹股沟，冷湿毛巾覆盖头部、躯干和大腿，救护车空调开到最冷；躁动患者身上的高热，正是把这场出车变成死亡事件的关键。naloxone 陷阱：naloxone 的指征是逆转实际或怀疑由阿片类引起的呼吸抑制或意识抑制。本例呼吸 28 次/分、SpO2 97%、瞳孔 6 毫米且有对光反应——既无呼吸抑制，也没有阿片类中毒的表现，因此 naloxone 没有指征，在这里给它就属于「无指征启动处置方案」。他的血糖是 6.4，口服葡萄糖和 glucagon 同样没有指征——何况他也无法安全经口摄入任何东西。不要约束他，不要翻他的随身物品，不要让任何人俯卧转运；若警方已实施约束，绝不能让救护组独自和他待在行驶中的车厢里。整个互动保持安静、光线柔和、节奏从容——外界刺激只会让躁动更重。

expected.actionEn: Measure the blood glucose before attributing the agitation to drugs, and correctly withhold oral glucose and glucagon at 6.4 mmol/L
expected.actionZh: 在把躁动归因于药物之前先测血糖；血糖 6.4 时正确地不给口服葡萄糖和 glucagon。

expected.actionEn: Withhold naloxone and state why: his respirations are 28 with an SpO2 of 97% and dilated reactive pupils - there is no respiratory depression and no opioid picture, so the protocol has no indications
expected.actionZh: 不给 naloxone 并说明理由：呼吸 28 次/分、SpO2 97%、瞳孔散大且有对光反应——既无呼吸抑制也无阿片类中毒表现，该方案没有指征。

expected.actionEn: Begin active cooling for a temperature of 39.6: cold packs to the neck, armpits and groin, cold wet towels to head, torso and thighs, air conditioning on maximum cold, with the temperature re-checked
expected.actionZh: 针对 39.6 摄氏度立即开始主动降温：冰袋敷颈部、腋下和腹股沟，冷湿毛巾覆盖头部、躯干和大腿，空调开到最冷，并反复复测体温。

expected.actionEn: Do not apply restraints and do not search his belongings; if police restrain him, an officer travels with him and he is never positioned face-down
expected.actionZh: 不施加约束、不翻查他的随身物品；若警方实施约束，须有警员随车，且绝不让他保持俯卧姿势。

expected.actionEn: Reduce stimulation: dim lights, no sirens where avoidable, one voice, calm movements
expected.actionZh: 降低刺激：调暗灯光、能不鸣笛就不鸣笛、只由一个人说话、动作放缓。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that no sedating medication exists at either EMR or PCP level, and that IV fluids for the muscle breakdown are a PCP and hospital intervention
expected.actionZh: 口头说明 EMR 和 PCP 级别都没有任何镇静药物，而针对肌肉损伤的静脉补液属于 PCP 和医院的干预。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, interventions and the temperature after every intervention and at least every 5 minutes, and document each reassessment because this call may be reviewed. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1, cooling running): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6); BP 146/90; pulse 138 strong; respirations 24; skin hot but less flushed; pupils 6 mm and reactive; SpO2 98% on oxygen; temperature 39.0 C. He is settling. WATCH FOR THE COLLAPSE PATTERN: a patient who suddenly goes quiet after prolonged agitation may be deteriorating, not calming - reassess the pulse and breathing immediately every time the agitation stops, and be ready for a seizure or a cardiac arrest.
phases.infoZh: 每次干预后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC、已做的处置和体温，并把每次复评都记录下来，因为这类出车事后很可能被复核。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟，降温进行中）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6）；血压 146/90；脉搏 138 次/分，有力；呼吸 24 次/分；皮肤仍烫但潮红减轻；瞳孔 6 毫米、对光反应存在；吸氧下 SpO2 98%；体温 39.0 摄氏度。他正在平静下来。警惕「突然安静」这一崩溃前兆：长时间躁动后突然安静下来的患者，可能是在恶化而不是在平复——每一次躁动停止，都要立即复查脉搏和呼吸，并做好抽搐或心脏骤停的准备。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each intervention and at least every 5 minutes, documenting each reassessment
expected.actionZh: 每次干预之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已实施的处置，并逐次记录。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes including a repeat temperature, with the trend interpreted out loud
expected.actionZh: 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征并复测体温，口头解读变化趋势。

expected.actionEn: State and act on the sudden-quiet rule: any abrupt drop in agitation triggers an immediate pulse and breathing check, because collapse follows prolonged agitation with hyperthermia
expected.actionZh: 说出并执行「突然安静」原则：躁动一旦骤然减轻，立即复查脉搏和呼吸——长时间躁动合并高热之后，紧接着往往就是循环崩溃。

expected.actionEn: Keep cooling running with repeated temperatures until the temperature is controlled
expected.actionZh: 持续降温并反复复测体温，直到体温得到控制。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the emergency department en route that an agitated hyperthermic patient with a suspected stimulant toxicity is coming in with police, so security and staff can be ready. The hand-off must state the reported substance and timing, the temperature and its trend, the blood glucose, that naloxone was withheld and why, and any police restraint applied and for how long. PCR within 5 minutes, factual and non-judgemental, recording the history as reported.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中向急诊预报：一名躁动、高热、疑似兴奋剂中毒的患者将在警方陪同下到达，让安保和医护提前准备。交接必须说明据述使用的物质和时间、体温及其变化趋势、血糖值、naloxone 未给及其理由，以及警方是否实施约束、持续了多久。5 分钟内完成 PCR，内容客观、不带评判，病史按「据述」记录。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification: agitated hyperthermic patient with suspected stimulant toxicity, arriving with police
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：躁动、高热、疑似兴奋剂中毒患者，将由警方陪同到达。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off stating the temperature trend, the blood glucose, that naloxone was withheld and why, and any restraint applied by police
expected.actionZh: 完整口头交接，说明体温趋势、血糖、naloxone 未给及其理由，以及警方是否施加约束。

expected.actionEn: Accurate, factual and non-judgemental PCR within 5 minutes, documenting the substance history as reported, the consent reasoning, and every reassessment
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确、客观、不带评判的 PCR，把用药物质史按「据述」记录，并写明知情同意的判断依据和每一次复评。

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 7 minutes later with cooling running - settling

criticalPitfallsEn: Walking into the parkade before police confirm the scene is secure - scene safety comes before patient contact every time

Giving naloxone because 'drugs are involved' - the protocol treats respiratory depression from suspected narcotic use, and this patient breathes 28 times a minute with 6 mm reactive pupils; initiating a protocol without indications is a 100% deduction
Skipping the blood glucose in a patient with an altered LOC, so a treatable hypoglycemia would have been missed
Never taking a temperature - hyperthermia is the finding that kills the agitated patient, and it cannot be treated if it is not measured
Applying restraints yourself, or transporting a restrained patient face-down - restraint is a police function and prone positioning kills
Searching his pockets or backpack for drugs - that is a police function and a needle-stick risk
Treating the sudden quiet as success and stopping the reassessment - collapse follows prolonged agitation with hyperthermia
Writing a judgemental PCR - record the substance history as reported, factually, because this call is likely to be reviewed
criticalPitfallsZh: 警方确认现场安全之前就走进停车场——现场安全永远排在接触患者之前。
因为「跟毒品有关」就给 naloxone——该方案针对的是怀疑阿片类引起的呼吸抑制，而这名患者呼吸 28 次/分、瞳孔 6 毫米且有对光反应；无指征启动处置方案扣 100%。
意识改变的患者不测血糖，结果漏掉了本可治疗的低血糖。
全程没量体温——高热才是躁动患者真正的致死因素，而没测出来就无从处理。
自己动手施加约束，或让被约束的患者俯卧转运——约束是警方职责，而俯卧位会致命。
为找毒品去翻他的口袋或背包——那是警方的职责，而且有针刺伤风险。
把突然安静当成好转而停止复评——长时间躁动合并高热之后紧接着就是循环崩溃。
写一份带评判色彩的 PCR——用药物质史应按「据述」客观记录，因为这类出车事后很可能被复核。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR provides everything this patient needs before hospital: staging until police secure the scene, verbal de-escalation with one voice and an open exit, a rapid body survey looking for the head injury that mimics drug agitation, a mandatory blood glucose that excludes hypoglycemia, a temperature that reveals the real emergency, active cooling with packs, wet towels and maximum-cold air conditioning, oxygen to 94% or above, continuous monitoring for the sudden-quiet collapse, and a factual hand-off. Naloxone is deliberately withheld because there is no respiratory depression and no opioid picture. No sedating medication exists at either licence level, and restraint remains a police function.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 在到院之前，这名患者需要的一切 EMR 都能提供：警方确认安全前原地待命；用一个人的声音做降级沟通并始终留好退路；做快速体格检查，排查那种会伪装成药物性躁动的颅脑损伤；必测血糖以排除低血糖；测体温从而发现真正的急症；用冰袋、湿毛巾和最冷空调主动降温；给氧维持 94% 及以上；持续监测「突然安静」式的崩溃；最后交出一份客观的交接。naloxone 被有意识地不给，因为既无呼吸抑制也无阿片类中毒表现。EMR 和 PCP 级别都没有任何镇静药物，约束始终是警方的职责。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry and vascular access en route with a fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 L, reassessed every 500 mL, for the dehydration and muscle breakdown of prolonged agitation with hyperthermia. There is still no sedating medication at the PCP level, and cooling remains the priority intervention at both levels.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊，并在途中建立静脉通路，针对长时间躁动合并高热造成的脱水和肌肉损伤，按 20 mL/kg（最多 2 升）快速补液、每 500 mL 复评一次。PCP 级别同样没有任何镇静药物，两个级别的首要干预都仍然是降温。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a man in his mid-twenties found agitated in an underground parkade at 0340. Police secured the scene before our contact. A friend reports he has been awake for two days, used a large amount of crystal methamphetamine last night and one beer, no opioids that she is aware of, no seizure history, not diabetic, on no medications, and has never presented like this before. On our assessment he was awake but disoriented with disorganized speech and hallucinations, GCS 13 improving to 14, hot, flushed and drenched in sweat. Respirations 28 unlaboured with clear air entry, SpO2 97% on room air, pulse 148 strong, BP 158/98, pupils 6 millimetres and reactive, blood glucose 6.4, and temperature 39.6. Naloxone was not indicated and was withheld - his respiratory drive was intact and his pupils were dilated. We began active cooling with packs to the neck, armpits and groin, cold wet towels to the head, torso and thighs, and the air conditioning on maximum cold. On our latest set he is settling: GCS 14, pulse 138, BP 146/90, resps 24, SpO2 98% on oxygen, temperature down to 39.0. Cooling is still running. He was not restrained by us; an officer has travelled with us and he has never been positioned face-down. No head injury was found and there are no needle marks. He lacks capacity to consent because of his condition, so we have treated and transported under implied consent.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名二十多岁男性，03:40 在地下停车场被发现时处于躁动状态。我们接触患者之前，警方已确认现场安全。一名朋友提供的信息：他已两天没睡，昨晚用了大量冰毒并喝了一瓶啤酒，据她所知没有用阿片类，无癫痫史，不是糖尿病，不服任何药物，以前从未出现过这种情况。我们评估时他清醒但定向力障碍，言语混乱并有幻觉，GCS 13 回升至 14，皮肤发烫、潮红、被汗浸透。呼吸 28 次/分、不费力，进气清晰，室内空气 SpO2 97%，脉搏 148 有力，血压 158/98，瞳孔 6 毫米、对光反应存在，血糖 6.4，体温 39.6。naloxone 无指征，因此未给——他呼吸驱动完好、瞳孔散大。我们已开始主动降温：颈部、腋下、腹股沟放置冰袋，头部、躯干和大腿覆盖冷湿毛巾，空调开到最冷。最新一组显示他正在平复：GCS 14，脉搏 138，血压 146/90，呼吸 24，吸氧下 SpO2 98%，体温降至 39.0。降温仍在继续。我们没有对他施加任何约束；有一名警员全程随车，他也从未被置于俯卧姿势。未发现头部外伤，皮肤无针孔。因病情所致他不具备同意能力，我们按推定同意进行治疗和转运。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Acute agitation with hyperthermia and an altered level of consciousness in an underground parkade
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: As reported by a friend: awake two days, large amount of crystal methamphetamine last night plus one beer, no opioids known, agitation worsening over 40 minutes per security; no witnessed seizure, no witnessed head injury or fall; no seizure history, not diabetic, no prescription medications
treatments: Staged until police confirmed the scene secure; exit route kept clear throughout
Verbal de-escalation: one speaker, slow front approach, reduced stimulation, dim light
Blood glucose 6.4 measured - hypoglycemia excluded; oral glucose and glucagon correctly withheld
Naloxone withheld - no respiratory depression, RR 28, SpO2 97%, pupils 6 mm reactive; protocol indications absent
Active cooling for 39.6 C: packs to neck, armpits and groin, cold wet towels to head, torso and thighs, air conditioning on maximum cold, temperature re-checked
Oxygen titrated to SpO2 94% or above
No restraints applied by the crew; officer travelled with the patient; never positioned face-down
Treated under implied consent with the capacity reasoning documented; belongings left for police
findings: GCS 13 improving to 14; disoriented with disorganized speech and hallucinations
Temperature 39.6 C falling to 39.0 C with active cooling
Pulse 148 to 138, BP 158/98 to 146/90, respirations 28 to 24, SpO2 97-98%
Pupils 6 mm and reactive - inconsistent with an opioid; respiratory drive intact throughout
Skin hot, flushed and drenched; bilateral hand tremor; muscles tight on palpation
No head injury, no needle marks, knuckle abrasions only
